filter-due-any: Nobe nguluphi lusuku lwekucedza (kufaka nalamanye langanalo)
filter-column-age-hint: Fihla emakhadi langene kuloluhla sekwendlule emalanga langetulu kwalelinani. Letinye tinhluhla nemakhadi lokungatiwa tinsuku tekungena kwawo kuhlala kubonakala. Kuhlela likhadi akucali kabusha sikhatsi salo eluhlwini.
filter-on-desc: Uhlunga emakhadi kulelibhodi. Chafata lapha kuze uhlele sihlungi.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hlunga tinsuku temakhadi usebentisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt nobe @listEnteredAt. Sibonelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' nobe @endAt = none. Faka ligama lendzawo leyentiwe ngekwakho lelicala nga-@ emkhatsini wetimphawu tekucaphuna.
advanced-filter-description: Sihlungi Lesitfutfukile sivumela kubhala luchungechunge lolunalaba basebenti: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sikhala sisetjentiswa njengesehlukanisi emkhatsini Webasebenti. Ungahluza tonkhe Tindzawo Letikhetsekile ngekubhala emagama nemagugu ato. Sibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Caphela: Uma tindzawo noma emagugu anetikhala, kufanele uwavale ngemacaphuno lamancane. Sibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kuze wece tinhlavu tekulawula letisodvwa (' /), ungasebentisa \. Sibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa nemibandzela leminyenti. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngalokuvamile bonkhe basebenti bahunyushwa kusuka ngesancele kuya ngesekudla. Ungashintja kuhleleka ngekufaka tibiyelo. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungaphindze useshe tindzawo tembhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Ihambisana nabe lidalwa likhadi, nobe sihloko sayo nobe incazelo yayo yishintjwe, futsi umbhalo lomusha unalokhu (akukho mehluko emkhatsini wemagama lamakhulu nalamancane).
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namatsisela i-JSON letfunyelwe yi-Kanboard: intfo lena-"columns" (noma imisebenti lena-column_name) kanye neluhlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Emakholomu aba tinhlu nemisebenti iba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Namatsisela i-JSON yelibhodi le-NextCloud Deck (libhodi leline-"stacks", sitaki ngasinye siphetse ema-"cards" aso). Titaki tiba tinhlu nemakhadi aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namatsisela i-JSON yelicembu lemaphakheji emsebenti we-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Timo tiba tinhlu nemaphakheji emsebenti aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namatsisela luhlu lwe-JSON lwetinkinga te-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Tinkinga tiba emakhadi lahlelwe etinhleni Letivulekile / Letivaliwe.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kwemisebenti ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } kusuka ekutfumeleni kwe-Asana noma GET /tasks). Imisebenti ihlelwa ngetigaba (memberships); imisebenti lecedziwe iya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kweluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Tigaba tiba tinhlu netintfo tiba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela luhlu lwemisebenti lwe-markdown (indlela lesetjentiswa ngemathulusi ye-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): tinhloko "## Ligama lwelluhlu", netintfo "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngentasi. Tinhloko tiba luhlu naletintfo tibe emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namatsisela sakhiwo se-Leo (lifayela le-.leo). Tincenye letisezingeni lelisetulu tiba tinhla, tincenye letingaphansi kwato ngalokucondzile tiba ngemakhadi, bese umbhalo wencenye uba yinchazelo yelikhadi. Tincenye letisemazingeni lajulile tiba tinhla tekuhlola. Tincenye letiphawuliwe tingeniswa njengaleticedziwe.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namatsisela luhlaka lwe-OPML, njengobe Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq nalabanye bakutfumela. Tintfo tesigaba sekucala tiba luhlu, bantfwana bato baba emakhadi lanelinothi njengenchazelo, kantsi tintfo letijulile tiba luhlu lwekuhlola. Tintfo letiphelile tingena njengaletiphelile.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namatsisela lifayela le-Org mode, njengobe Emacs, Orgzly noma Beorg ilibhala. Tihloko tesigaba sekucala tiba luhlu kantsi tihloko tesigaba sesibili tiba emakhadi. TODO na-DONE, kubaluleka, ematheg, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na-CLOSED kuyagcinwa, kantsi emabhokisi ekuhlola netihloko letijulile kuba luhlu lwekuhlola.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namatselisa lifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenti munye emgceni ngamunye, ngendlela luhlelo lwe-todo.txt netinhlelo letihambisanako letibhala ngayo. Imisebenti lephelile ("x") iya kulokuphelile, +project na-@context kuba ngemalebula, (A) iba lilebula lekubaluleka, kantsi due: na-t: kuba tinsuku tekugcina netekucala.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namatselisa umphumela we-task export: luhla lwe-JSON noma umsebenti munye emgceni ngamunye. Imisebenti lephelile iya ku-Done, project ne-priority kuba emalebula, annotations iba imibono, kantsi depends iba kwetsemba imisebenti levimbako.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha lifayela le-.boardarchive endzaweni lecindzetelwe bese unamatselisa lokuse-board.jsonl yebhodi, nemugca wenguqulo noma ngaphandle kwawo. Sici sekuhlanganisa ngemacembu ekubukweni kwebhodi siba tinhla, letinye tici tekukhetsa tibe emalebula, emabhulokhi embhalo nemabhokisi ekumaka abe inchazelo neluhla lwekuhlola, bese imibono iyagcinwa. Titfombe netinamatsiselo atingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Ku-Azure DevOps, vula i-Boards, bese i-Queries, wenta umbuto lokhombisa emakholamu lowafunako, ukhetse i-Export to CSV; bese ukhetsa lelo fayela le-.csv. I-Board Column (nome i-State) iba tinhla ne-Board Lane imitsandvo; tintfo temsebenti tiba ngemakhadi nelutfo lwato nema-tags njengemalebula, i-Assigned To, emalanga, inchazelo nemtali, futsi lamanye emakholamu aba tikhala takho.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Ku-Microsoft Lists, vula luhla, ukhetse i-Export, bese i-Export to CSV, ukhetse lelo fayela le-.csv. Likholamu le-Status (nome i-Progress) liba tinhla futsi intfo ngayinye iba likhadi, nesihloko sayo, inchazelo, bantfu, emalanga nema-tags; lamanye emakholamu aba tikhala takho.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Ku-Microsoft Project, khetsa i-File, bese i-Save As, ngeluhlobo lwe-XML Format (*.xml), ukhetse lelo fayela. Imisebenti yesifinyeto iba yimitsandvo futsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi ku-Not started, In progress nome Completed, nemalanga ayo, emanothi, tinsita, imisebenti lemincane nalephambilini.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Ku-Outlook, dvonsa imilayeto uyifake kufolda kukhompyutha yakho, nome uyigcine nge-File, bese i-Save As, njenge-Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Khetsa lifayela linye le-.msg, nome i-.zip yemafayela e-.msg ne-.eml. Inkhulumo ngayinye iba likhadi ku-Board View / Email, netimphendvulo tayo njengemibono naloko lokunamatsiselwe njengemafayela.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ku-MeisterTask, chafata libito lephrojekthi, khetsa Export project bese utfumela i-CSV, bese uyanamatsisela. Tigaba tiba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba emakhadi, kanye nemanotsi ayo, lusuku lwekuphela, lonikwe umsebenti nematheg; imisebenti lephelile igcina lusuku lwayo lwekuphela. I-CSV lebhalelwe kungenisa kwa-MeisterTask nayo iyasebenta.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ku-Obsidian, vula lifayela lelibhodi le-Kanban njenge-Markdown (noma vula lifayela le-.md kusihleli sembhalo), bese unamatsisela konkhe. Imizila iba luhlu kanye nemikhawulo yemakhadi, emakhadi agcina ematheg, emalanga, kubaluleka, tindzawo neluhlu lwekuhlola, kantsi i-Archive iba ngemakhadi laseNgobolweni.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ku-Linear, tfumela tinkinga njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noma kutfumela kwekubuka), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, emacembu aba yimizila, kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi kanye nalonikwe umsebenti, emalebula, emalanga, inkinga lengumtali, kubaluleka, kulinganisa, iphrojekthi nesiyingi.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ku-TickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import bese wenta likhophi lekulondoloza, bese unamatsisela lifayela le-CSV. Luhlu ngalunye lwe-TickTick luba ngumzila kantsi tinsika talo tiba luhlu; imisebenti igcina ematheg, emalanga, luhlu lwekuhlola, kubaluleka nemisebenti lemincane.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ku-ClickUp, tfumela imisebenti njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noma kutfumela kwekubuka kwe-List noma Table kanye nato tonkhe tinsika), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, luhlu lwe-ClickUp luba yimizila, kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi kanye nemisebenti lemincane, labanikwe umsebenti, ematheg, emalanga, kubaluleka nesikhatsi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ku-Nullboard, vula libhodi, khetsa Export this board... kumenyu, vula lifayela le-.nbx kusihleli sembhalo bese unamatsisela lokukulo. Luhlu luba luhlu kantsi emanotsi aba ngemakhadi: umugca wekucala welinotsi usihloko selikhadi kantsi lokusele kuyinchazelo yalo. Linotsi lelingakalungiswa litfola ilebula raw. Lifayela lelinemabhodi lamanyenti lingenisa libhodi lalo lekucala.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ku-Kanri, vula Import & Export bese ukhetsa Export individual board (noma Export all data), bese unamatsisela lifayela le-.json. Tinsika tiba luhlu kantsi emakhadi aba ngemakhadi, kanye nenchazelo yawo, lusuku lwekuphela, ematheg nemibala; imisebenti yelikhadi iba luhlu lwekuhlola. Ekutfumeleni yonkhe idatha kungeniswa libhodi lekucala.
import-board-instruction-planka: Bhala likheli le-Planka yakho (sibonelo https://planka.example.com), ligama lemsebentisi neliphasiwedi le-Planka, bese ucindzetela «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa». Kusetjentiswa kuphela kutsatsa libhodi futsi akugcinwa. Khetsa libhodi bese ucindzetela «Tsatsa»: i-WeKan iyalifundza ku-API ye-Planka kanye neluhla lwalo, emakhadi, timphendvulo, emalanga ekugcina, emalebula, emalunga, luhla lwemisebenti nemibono, bese uchubeka nekungenisa njengoba kujwayelekile. Emakhadi lasesigcinweni se-Planka angeniswa agciniwe; lokunamatsiselwe nemakhadi lasemgcomeni wendoti akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ku-Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), ngena, uvume imvume ye-Tasks.Read bese ukopisha i-token kuthebhu ye-Access token. Yinamatsisele lapha bese uchofoza «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa»; i-token isetjentiswa kuphela kulokutsatsa futsi ayigcinwa. Khetsa luhla lonkhe noma lunye bese uchofoza «Tsatsa». Luhla ngalunye lwe-To Do luba luhla nemsebenti ngamunye ube likhadi, kanye nemanothi, emalanga ekugcina nekucala, tinyatselo njengeluhla lwekuhlola, tigaba njengemalebula, kubaluleka lokuphakeme nesimo njengemalebula; imisebenti leceditwe iyagcinwa. Tikhumbuto nekuphindvwaphindvwa akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Ku-Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), ngena, uvume imvume ye-Notes.Read ukopishe i-token kuthebhu ye-Access token. Yinamatsisele lapha uchofote «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa»; i-token isetjentiswa kulokutsatsa kuphela futsi ayigcinwa. Khetsa incwadzi yemanothi uchofote «Tsatsa». Tigaba tiba tinhla futsi emakhasi aba ngemakhadi, nembhalo wawo, emabhokisi etintfo letentiwako njengeluhla lwekuhlola nemakhasi lamancane njengemisebenti lemincane.
import-board-instruction-teams: Namatsisela i-token yekungena ye-Microsoft Graph lene-Chat.Read (levela ku-Graph Explorer, i-akhawunti yemsebenti nome yesikolwa) uchofote «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa», bese ukhetsa inkhulumo nome sitesheni uchofote «Tsatsa»; i-token ayigcinwa. Nome ukhetse lifayela: i-.tar yekutfumela kwakho kwemuntfu ku-teams.live.com/dataexport, nome i-.json yemilayeto yenkhulumo. Inkhulumo ngayinye iba likhadi ku-Board View / Chat, futsi imilayeto yayo iba yimibono.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Ku-Sandstorm, vula i-grain ye-__app__, khetsa "Download backup" kubha lengetulu ye-grain, bese ukhetsa lelo fayela le-.zip. Lokukuyo i-grain kuba libhodi, tintfo tayo tibe ngemakhadi kanye nalokho i-app lekugcinako ngato. Khetsa i-app leyo i-grain leyayo: i-grain ye-app lenye iyaliwa, futsi itsi ngubani i-app.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ku-KanbanFlow, vula imenyu yelibhodi, ukhetse Settings → API & Webhooks bese ukopisha i-API token yelibhodi. Namatsisela i-token lapha, uchofoze «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa», ukhetse libhodi bese uchofoza «Tsatsa»; i-token isetjentiswa kuphela kuloko kutsatsa futsi ayigcinwa. Tinsika tiba luhla, timtsandvo tihlala timtsandvo; imisebenti igcina incazelo, umbala, emalebula, lilanga lekugcina, imisebentana njengeluhla lwekuhlola, sikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe, linani lelilinganiswako, bantfu nemibono.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Bhala i-ID ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Basecamp (inombolo lelandzela basecamp.com/ kulikheli) ne-token yekungena (levela ku-app ye-OAuth 2 lebhaliswe ku-launchpad.37signals.com, noma leyo kuhlanganiswa lokukhona sekunayo), uchofoze «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa», ukhetse liphrojekthi bese uchofoza «Tsatsa». I-token isetjentiswa kuphela kuloko kutsatsa futsi ayigcinwa. Lithebula ngalinye lemakhadi liba ngumtsandvo lonetinsika talo njengeluhla, neluhla lwetintfo letentiwako luba ngumtsandvo «To-dos»; emakhadi netintfo letentiwako kugcina umbhalo, emalanga, labanikwe umsebenti nemibono, tinyatselo telikhadi tiba luhla lwekuhlola, leticeditwe tiyagcinwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Tfola i-token yekungena ku-OAuth 2.0 Playground: ngaphansi kwe-Tasks API v1 khetsa tasks.readonly, uchofoze Authorize APIs, bese Exchange authorization code for tokens, ukopishe i-token yekungena. Yinamatsisele lapha bese uchofoza «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa», ukhetse luhla lonkhe lwemisebenti noma lunye, bese «Tsatsa». I-token isetjentiswa kuphela kulokutsatsa futsi ayigcinwa. Luhla lwemisebenti luba luhla nemisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemanothi, tixhumanisi nelilanga lekugcina; imisebentana iba luhla lwekuhlola nemisebenti leceditwe ingeniswa igciniwe.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: I-API ye-Google Keep ingeyema-akhawunti e-Google Workspace kuphela. Tfola i-token yekungena ye-OAuth 2.0 lenelibanga https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ku-OAuth 2.0 Playground uma umphatsi we-Workspace yakho avuma, noma ku-akhawunti yensita lenemvume kuyo yonkhe idomeni), uyinamatsisele, uchofoze «Khombisa loko lokungangeniswa» bese «Tsatsa». I-token isetjentiswa kuphela kulokutsatsa futsi ayigcinwa. Emanothi embhalo aba ngemakhadi eluhlwini «Notes», nemanothi eluhla lwekuhlola aba ngemakhadi eluhlwini «Lists» kanye netintfo tawo njengeluhla lwekuhlola. Emanothi lasemgcomeni wendoti, lokunamatsiselwe nekwabelana akungeniswa.
api-import-desc: Kutsatse ensizeni nge-akhawunti yakho. Loko lokubhala lapha kusetjentiswa kuphela kulokutsatsa futsi akugcinwa.
api-import-fetched: Kutsetsiwe. Hlola emalunga langentasi bese uyangenisa.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ku-Pivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ye-MORE yephrojekthi bese ukhetsa Export CSV (noma khetsa tindzaba bese ukhetsa Bulk Actions, CSV), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Simo ngasinye sendzaba siba luhlu kantsi tindzaba tiba ngemakhadi, kanye nelUhlobo lwato nemalebula, banikati, locelako, emalanga, imibono, imisebenti netivimbeli; Estimate iba ngemaphoyinti endzaba kantsi tikhatsi tiba ngema-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ku-Tasks.org, vula Settings, Backups bese ukhetsa Export tasks, bese unamatsisela lokukulelo lifayela le-.json. Luhlu luba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemanotsi ayo, ematheg, emalanga, imibono nemisebenti lemincane; imisebenti lephelile igcina lusuku lwayo lwekuphela, kantsi kubaluleka kuba yindzawo lekhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ku-monday.com, vula imenyu yelibhodi, khetsa More actions na-Export board to Excel (kanye netibuyekezo netintfo letincane uma ufuna), bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Insika ye-Status iba luhlu kantsi emacembu aba yimizila; bantfu, emalanga, umugca wesikhatsi nematheg kugcina tindzawo tako, letinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile kantsi tibuyekezo tiba yimibono.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ku-Super Productivity, vula Settings, bese kuba Sync & Backup, khetsa Export Data bese unamatsisela lokukulifayela le-sp-backup .json. Iphrojekthi ngayinye iba ngumzila kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi ku-To Do, In Progress, Backlog noma Done, kanye nemanotsi ayo, ematheg, lusuku lwekuphela, sikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe nemisebenti lemincane; imisebenti leseNgobolweni iba ngemakhadi laseNgobolweni.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ku-Taiga, vula Admin > Project > Export bese ulanda ikhophi yephrojekthi (vula kuqala lifayela le-.json.gz), bese unamatsisela i-JSON yalo. Timo tetindzaba temsebentisi tiba luhlu, tindzaba temsebentisi tiba ngemakhadi kanye nemisebenti yato njengemisebenti lemincane, ema-epic netinkinga kutfola imizila yako, kantsi ema-sprint, ematheg, imibono netimfanelo letikhetsekile kuyeta. Lokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ku-Vikunja, vula Settings, khetsa Data Export bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip lelikutfumelako, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela, noma unamatsisele i-data.json lengekhatsi kwalo. Emabhakede e-Kanban aba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemalebula, labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga, inchazelo, luhlu lwemisebenti njengeluhlu lwekuhlola nemibono; kubaluleka, liphesenti lelentiwe na-done kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Lokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ku-Quire, vula imenyu yephrojekthi bese ukhetsa Export CSV, bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemisebenti lemincane njengemakhadi labantfwana, labanikwe umsebenti, ematheg njengemalebula, emalanga ekucala, ekuphela nalocedziwe, inchazelo nekubaluleka njengendzawo lekhetsekile. Imibono nalokunamatselwe akukho ku-CSV ya-Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ku-Wrike, tfumela iphrojekthi noma lifolda ku-Excel, noma gcwalisa sibonelo sekungenisa se-Excel sa-Wrike, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Imigca yelifolda neyephrojekthi iba yimizila, i-Status iba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye ne-Key yayo, umsebenti lomtali, labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga ekucala nekuphela, kuncikana nenchazelo; Priority, Duration naletinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ku-Teamwork.com, gcwalisa sibonelo sekungenisa imisebenti se-Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) bese usigcina njenge-.xlsx, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela. Luhlu lwemisebenti luba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi; umsebenti locala nga -, # noma > uba ngumsebenti lomncane wemsebenti longenhla kwawo (--, ## noma >> sigaba sinye lesijulile). Labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga nematheg kugcina tindzawo tako; Priority, Estimated time na-Complete kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ku-Businessmap (lebekade iyi-Kanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetsa Configure results kute ukhetse tinsika, landa lifayela le-Excel, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Tinsika tifundvwa ngemabito ato esiNgisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): uma i-akhawunti yakho isebentisa lolunye lulwimi, cala ushintje libito lemugca wetihloko libe ngesiNgisi. I-Column iba luhlu kantsi i-Lane iba yimizila; banikati, ematheg, umbala, emalanga, imibono netihlanganisi letingumtali kugcina tindzawo tako, kantsi Priority, Size, Type naletinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ku-Redmine, vula ema-Issues ephrojekthi, khetsa Also available in: CSV ngentansi yeluhlu, khetsa tinsika (All columns, kanye ne-Description) bese uyatfumela, bese unamatsisela i-CSV. I-Redmine itsa tinsika ngelulwimi lwakho, ngako setha lulwimi lwakho lube sisiNgisi ku-My account ngaphambi kwekutfumela. Simo ngasinye siba luhlu kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi, kanye ne-tracker njengelebula, lonikwe umsebenti, umbhali, emalanga, umsebenti lomtali netinkinga letihlobene; kubaluleka, sigaba, inguculo lehlosiwe, sikhatsi lesilinganisiwe, % Done netindzawo letikhetsekile kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ku-Notion, vula i-database njengelikhasi lonkhe, khetsa ••• na-Export, khetsa Markdown & CSV, bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.zip lelilandwako, noma i-CSV yinye ye-database leyiphuma kulo, noma unamatsisele leyo CSV. Insika lebitwa ngekutsi Status iba luhlu (uma ingekho, insika yekucala lebukeka njengekukhetsa iba yiyo, kantsi umbiko wekungenisa usho kutsi nguyiphi); imigca iba ngemakhadi kanye nesihloko sawo, ematheg njengemalebula, bantfu njengemalunga, emalanga, kanye nembhalo welikhasi njengenchazelo; letinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Kuhlobana, titfombe nalokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ku-Plane, vula Workspace Settings, khetsa Exports, tfumela ema-phrojekthi njenge-JSON, CSV noma Excel bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela, noma lifayela linye lelingekhatsi kwalo, noma unamatsisele i-JSON noma i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, ema-phrojekthi aba yimizila, kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi kanye nesihlonzi sato, umtali, labanikwe umsebenti, emalebula, emalanga, tihlanganisi nemibono; kubaluleka, kulinganisa, siyingi nemojuli kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Kutfumela kwa-Plane akunato tinchazelo noma lokunamatselwe, ngako akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Ku-Fizzy, khipha i-akhawunti ku-"Account settings", nome emakhadi akho nge-"Download my data", bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.zip Fizzy lekutfumelela lona, nome lifayela le-.json lelikhadi linye. Emabhodi aba yimitsandvo futsi emakholomu aba tinhla, ne-"Maybe?", "Not now" na-"Done" njengaku-Fizzy; emakhadi agcina inchazelo yawo, emalebula, labanikwe umsebenti, tinyatselo njengeluhla lwekuhlola, imibono nemafayela.
import-board-instruction-mail: Khetsa lifayela le-.mbox, njengobe Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt nome Gmail ngeGoogle Takeout kulilondoloza, nome umlayeto lowodvwa we-.eml, nome unamatsisele umbhalo wawo. Yonkhe inkhulumiswano iba likhadi linye kuluhla lwe-Inbox, nalotfumelako, labamukelako kanye nesihloko sayo, kuze ivele embukweni we-Email; timphendvulo tiba yimibono yayo. Emalebula e-Gmail aba ngemalebula. Lokunamatsiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-ical: Khetsa lifayela lelikhalenda le-.ics, njengobe Google Calendar, Apple Calendar nome Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud nome Outlook kulikhipha, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Imisebenti iya ku-To Do, In Progress, Done nome Cancelled ngekwesimo sayo, futsi imicimbi iya ku-Events, kanye netinsuku tayo tekucala netekugcina, kuze ivele emibukweni ye-Calendar ne-Gantt. Tigaba nekubaluleka kuba ngemalebula. Tintfo letiphindvwako tingeniswa kanye.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Ku-takeout.google.com, khetsa Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar ne-Google Chat, wente kukhipha bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip, bese ulikhetsa lapha. Wonkhe umkhicito uba ngumtsandvo: liposi lembuko we-Email, tinhla temisebenti nemanothi kanye netinhla tawo tekuhlola, imicimbi yekhalenda nemisebenti lenetinsuku, netindzawo tekuchata lapho imilayeto iba yimibono yembuko we-Chat. Leminye imikhicito nalokunamatsiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-slack: Ku-Slack, vula tilungiselelo tendzawo yemsebenti, khetsa Import/Export Data, khipha indzawo yemsebenti bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip, bese ulikhetsa lapha. Yonkhe isiteshi iba likhadi ku-Channels, Groups nome Direct messages, futsi imilayeto yaso netimphendvulo temtsetfo kuba yimibono yelikhadi, ngembhali wako, kuze umbuko we-Chat ukhombise isiteshi. Emafayela akangeniswa.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Khipha nge-mmctl export create, landa lokukhishiwe bese ukhetsa lifayela lako le-.jsonl, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Yonkhe isiteshi nemlayeto locondzile kuba likhadi, futsi tinkhulumo netimphendvulo takho kuba yimibono yelikhadi, kuze umbuko we-Chat ukhombise isiteshi. Emacembu aba yimitsandvo. Emafayela akangeniswa.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Ku-Telegram Desktop, vula Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, khetsa simo se-JSON bese uyakhipha, bese ukhetsa lifayela le-result.json, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Yonkhe inkhulumo iba likhadi ku-Direct messages, Groups nome Channels, futsi imilayeto yayo iba yimibono yelikhadi, kuze umbuko we-Chat ukhombise inkhulumo. Titfombe nemafayela akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Ku-WhatsApp, vula inkhulumo, khetsa Export chat ngaphandle kwemidiya, bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.txt lapha, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Inkhulumo iba likhadi lelinemilayeto leyimibono yalo, ngalotfumelako nesikhatsi, kuze umbuko we-Chat uyikhombise. Imidiya nemilayeto yesistimu akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-discord: Khipha isiteshi se-Discord nge-DiscordChatExporter ngesimo se-JSON bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.json, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Isiteshi siba likhadi esigabeni saso, futsi imilayeto yaso iba yimibono yelikhadi, kuze umbuko we-Chat ukhombise isiteshi. Iseva iba ngumtsandvo. Lokunamatsiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Ku-Rocket.Chat, khipha idatha yakho njenge-JSON ku-"My Data" bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.zip lelikutfumelela lona, nome lifayela le-.json lelikhishiwe lelikamelo linye. Likamelo ngalinye liba likhadi futsi imilayeto yalo iba yimibono yelikhadi, kuze umbuko we-Chat ukhombise likamelo. Ne-.zip WeKan leyikhiphela singenisi se-CSV se-Rocket.Chat iyafundvwa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Ku-Evernote, khipha emanothi nome libhuku lemanothi njengelifayela le-.enex bese ulikhetsa lapha, nome unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Lonkhe lithothi liba likhadi nembhalo walo, emabhokisi alo ekwenta njengeluhla lwekuhlola, ematheka alo njengemalebula nesikhumbuto salo njengelusuku lwekugcina; emanothi lanesikhumbuto lesesentiwe aya ku-Done. Titfombe nemafayela lanamatsiselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ebhodini lakho le-Trello, iya ku-'Menu', bese ku-'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', bese ukopisha umbhalo lovelako.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namatsisela Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngakhoma (CSV)/Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngemathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Namatsisela i-JSON kusuka ekusesheni tinkinga kwe-Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), noma intfo lefananako lena-{ "issues": [...] }. Timo te-Jira tiba tinhlu netinkinga tiba emakhadi. Ngekutikhetsela faka luhlu lwe-"automationRules" kuze ungenise imitsetfo.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetsa liphepha le-.xlsx lesitayela se-WeKan (emakholomu lafananako nekutfunyelwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugca wekucala uyinhloko.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ebhodini lakho, iya ku-'Menu', bese ku-'Export board', bese ukopisha umbhalo efayeleni lelilandziwe.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Uma utfola emaphutsa nawungenisa libhodi, ngaletinye tikhatsi kungenisa kuyasebenta, futsi libhodi lisekhasini Lawo Onkhe Emabhodi.
import-members-mode-map: Khetsa umsebentisi lokhona kulowo nalowo wabo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengebasebentisi bendzawo ngemabito abo, kute ubahlanganise nebasebentisi bangempela ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi
csv-mapping-description: Khetsa insika yelifayela lephetse indzawo ngayinye yelikhadi. Kukhetsa kwentiwe ngekwemabito etinsika; shintja lokungalungi, bese ukhetsa (akukho kulifayela) endzaweni lelifayela lingenayo.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Lifayela alinayo insika yeluhlu. Khetsa leyinye ngenhla, noma bhala libito leluhlu lunye lapho onkhe emakhadi aya khona.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Letinye tinsika letingeniswa njengetindzawo letikhetsekile tembhalo:
csv-mapping-list-required: Bhala libito leluhlu lapho onkhe emakhadi aya khona, noma khetsa insika lephetse luhlu.
import-many-boards-hint: Khetsa emafayela lamanyenti ekutfumela alelithulusi, noma i-.zip yinye leyiphetse wona: lifayela ngalinye liba libhodi lalo, lingeniswe ngaphandle kwekuhlanganisa emalunga. I-.zip lekukutfumela kunye ngekwayo (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, noma WeKan kanye nalokunamatselwe) ilibhodi linye. Nangabe emafayela akhetfwa lapha, i-Ngenisa ingenisa wona esikhundleni sendzawo lengenhla.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila ngamunye kungenisa lobekungawenta (iphrojekthi, lifolda noma luhlu lwelithulusi) uba libhodi lawo. Emakhadi labatali nekuncikana emkhatsini walawo mabhodi kubhalwe embikweni wekungenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Onkhe libhodi longalitfumela, ekulandeni kunye: i-Excel njengencwadzi yemsebenti yinye lenelishidi ngelibhodi ngalinye leliletsa libito lalo, lonkhe lolunye luhlobo njenge-.zip lenelifayela ngelibhodi ngalinye.
import-json-placeholder: Namatsisela idatha yakho ye-JSON levumelekile lapha
import-csv-placeholder: Namatsisela idatha yakho ye-CSV/TSV levumelekile lapha
import-attachments-zip: I-ZIP yalokunamatsiselwe kwe-Trello (ngekutikhetsela, kusuka ku-Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Libhodi linye le-Trello lelitfunyelwe njenge-.json. Uma ulondvolote sikhiya se-Trello API nethokheni, lokunamatsiselwe kwalo, lingemuva lelibhodi netitfombe temalunga kuyalandwa nako.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: I-.zip lenelifayela linye noma langetulu le-.json lemabhodi kanye nalokunamatsiselwe kwawo emigodleni lengephansi yemagama emabhodi (kusuka ku-Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Onkhe emabhodi ayangeniswa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Kute emafayela e-.json emabhodi e-Trello latfolakele ku-.zip.
import-trello-zip-progress: Kungeniswa emabhodi kusuka ku-.zip, uyacelwa ulindze…
import-timeout: Kungenisa kutsatse sikhatsi lesidze kakhulu kwase kuyamiswa. Uyacelwa uphindze wetame; uma kuchubeka, libhodi lingaba likhulu kakhulu noma silondvoloti sedatha singaba matasa.
import-too-large: Lifayela likhulu kakhulu kutsi lingeniswe kanye kanye. Lehlukanise libe ngemafayela lamancane, sibonelo ngeliphrojekthi noma ngelilanga, bese ungenisa ngalinye.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: I-.zip inemafayela lamanyenti kakhulu kutsi angeniswe.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Lifayela lelingekhatsi kwe-.zip likhulu kakhulu kutsi lingeniswe.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: I-.zip inetindlela temafayela letingakapheleli futsi yaliwe.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Lokutfunyelwe ngaphandle kubita emagama alokunamatsiselwe kodvwa akutsatsi emafayela. Kute uwalete, nika likheli lensita nekungena: kusetjentiswa kulokungenisa kuphela, kutfunyelwa kulelo kheli kuphela, futsi akugcinwa nanini. Shiya kungenalutfo kute ungenise ngaphandle kwemafayela.
import-attachment-auth-token: Lithokheni le-API, sikhiya se-API nobe liphasiwedi le-app
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Libhodi lelingenisiwe libekwa ngaphansi kwalendzawo yekusebenta, ledalwa uma ingekho
import-trello-parent-workspace: Beka tindzawo tekusebenta letingenisiwe ngaphansi kwa
trello-api-import: Ngenisa ngco kusuka ku-Trello ngesikhiya se-API nethokheni
trello-api-import-desc: Namatsisela sikhiya sakho se-Trello API nethokheni kuze uhlele tindzawo tekusebenta nemabhodi akho e-Trello, bese ungenisa lokukhetsiwe nalokunamatsiselwe kwako.
trello-api-token: Ithokheni ye-Trello API (leyakhiwa ngesandla ngaphansi kwesikhiya se-API)
trello-api-credentials-required: Uyacelwa ufake kokubili sikhiya se-Trello API nethokheni.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Sikhiya se-Trello API nethokheni kulondvolotiwe. Ungahlela tindzawo tekusebenta ngaphandle kwekutifaka futsi.
trello-export-desc: Yakha likhophi lalelibhodi ku-Trello ngekusebentisa i-API ya-Trello, ngelukhiye lwakho lwe-API ya-Trello ne-token. Imizila iba ngemalebula labitwa ngekutsi "Swimlane: …", lekungenisa kwa-Trello kwa-WeKan kuyibuyisela kube yimizila.
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: I-grain ye-Sandstorm ayinayo i-Inthanethi yayo. Vumela lena grain kutsi ifinyelele ku-Trello kuqala.
trello-select-boards: Uyacelwa ukhetse lokungenani libhodi linye lelitawungeniswa.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: Khansela kungenisa bese ususa emabhodi lasangenisiwe ngulomsebenti? Loku akukwati kubuyiselwa emuva.
import-members-map: Libhodi lakho lelingenisiwe linemalunga. Uyacelwa umatanise emalunga lofuna kuwangenisa nebasebentisi bakho
import-members-map-note: Caphela: Emalunga langakamataniswa atawubelwa kumsebentisi wamanje.
import-user-select: Khetsa umsebentisi wakho lokhona lofuna kumsebentisa njengalelilunga
invalid-year: Umnyaka awukavumeleki. Uyacelwa ubhale tonkhe tinombolo letine, sibonelo 2026.
shared-labels-desc: Emalebula lagcinwe lapha angasetjentiswa emabhodini lamanyenti, eceleni kwemalebula ebhodi ngalinye. Kuniketa libito lelisha nobe kushintja umbala welinye lapha kulishintja kuwo onkhe emabhodi lalisebentisako; kucisha linye kulishiya kulawo mabhodi njengelilebula lawo.
label-delete-pop: Kute kubuyisela emuva. Loku kutawususa lelebula kuwo onkhe emakhadi kuphindze kubhubhise umlandvo wayo.
last-admin-desc: Angeke ushintje tindzima ngoba kufanele kube khona lokungenani umphatsi munye.
hide-board: Shiya leli bhodi: lifihle ku-Onkhe emabhodi. Bulunga bakho beliqembu nobe inhlangano buyahlala, futsi Tilungiselelo telilunga / Emabhodi lafihliwe liyalibuyisela.
group-members-read-only: Baphatsi baleli licembu kuphela labangashintja kutsi ngubani lolikulo. Licembu leliphuma ku-LDAP nobe kulolunye luhla lwemagama lishintjwa khona, hhayi ku-WeKan.
leave-board-pop: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kushiya __boardTitle__? Utawususwa kuwo onkhe emakhadi akulelibhodi.
list-archive-cards-pop: Loku kutawususa onkhe emakhadi akuloluhlu ebhodini. Kuze ubuke emakhadi laseNgobolweni uphindze uwabuyisele ebhodini, chafata “Imenyu” > “Ingobolwane”.
list-delete-pop: Tonkhe tento titawususwa ekusakazeni kwemsebenti futsi angeke ukhone kubuyisela luhlu. Kute kubuyisela emuva.
list-delete-suggest-archive: Ungayisa luhlu Engobolweni kuze ulususe ebhodini bese ugcina umsebenti.
log-out-everywhere-confirm: Loku kukukhipha kuwo wonkhe ema-browser, emafoni nema-app lowangene kuwo, kufaka ekhatsi lena.
passkeys-description: Sikhiye sekungena sikuvumela kutsi ungene ngesigcivito somunwe, buso, kukhiya sikrini nobe sikhiye sekuvikela salesisetjentiswa esikhundleni seliphasiwedi lakho. Sihlala esisetjentisweni sakho; i-WeKan igcina sikhiye saso semphakatsi kuphela.
passkey-sign-in-failed: Kungena ngesikhiye sekungena akuzange kusebente. Phindze uzame, nobe ungene ngalenye indlela.
passkey-expired: Loko kutsetse sikhatsi lesidze kakhulu. Phindze uzame.
passkey-too-many: Unetikhiye tekungena letinyenti kakhulu i-akhawunti lengaba nato. Susa sinye kucala.
passkey-needs-https: Tikhiye tekungena tidzinga i-WeKan ekhelini le-https://.
name: Ligama
normal-desc: Angabuka aphindze ahlele emakhadi. Akakhoni kushintja tilungiselelo.
normal-assigned-only-desc: Kubonakala kuphela emakhadi labelwe yena. Hlela njengemsebentisi Lovamile.
notify-participate: Tfola tibuyeketo temakhadi lowabambe lichaza kuwo njengemdali noma lilunga
notify-watch: Tfola tibuyeketo temabhodi, tinhlu noma emakhadi lowalandzelako
page-maybe-private: Lelikhasi lingaba ngasese. Ungakhona kulibuka ngeku-ngena.
paste-or-dragdrop: kuze unamatsisele, noma uhudvule bese ubeka lifayela lesitfombe kulo (sitfombe kuphela)
private-desc: Lelibhodi lingasese. Bantfu labangetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalibuka baphindze balihlele.
instance-desc: Wonkhe umsebentisi longenile kule WeKan angalibona lelibhodi. Alikhonjiswa nanini kubantfu labangangeni. Bantfu labengetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalihlela.
instance-editing-desc: Basebentisi labangenile labangasiwo emalunga bangengeta, bahlele, bahambise emakhadi futsi babeke imibono kuwo, futsi nababenta loko baba ngemalunga “Lokuvamile”.
public-desc: Lelibhodi lisesidlangalaleni. Libonakala kunoma ngubani lonesichumanisi futsi litawubonakala kutinjini tekusesha njenge-Google. Bantfu labangetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalihlela.
custom-private-desc-placeholder: Shiya ingenalutfo kute usebentise lesijwayelekile Kwangasese incazelo yebhodi
custom-public-desc-placeholder: Shiya ingenalutfo kute usebentise lesijwayelekile Kwemphakatsi incazelo yebhodi
quick-access-description: Faka inkhanyeti ebhodini kuze wengete indlela lefishane kulomugca.
remove-member-pop: Susa __name__ (__username__) ku-__boardTitle__? Lilunga litawususwa kuwo onkhe emakhadi akulelibhodi. Litawutfola satiso.
sandstorm-remove-member-warning: Loku kufihla lilunga kuphela ngaphakatsi kwe-WeKan. Akususi kufinyelela ku-grain ye-Sandstorm. Susa kufinyelela kwalo nasebhokisini le-Share access le-Sandstorm.
rescue-card-description: Khombisa libhokisi lekusindzisa ngaphambi kwekuvala tinchazelo temakhadi letingakalondvolotwa
rescue-card-description-dialogue: Bhala etulu inchazelo yelikhadi yamanje ngetingucuko takho?
search-cards: Sesha etihlokweni temakhadi/tinhlu, etinchazelweni nasetindzaweni letikhetsekile kulelibhodi
search-example: Bhala umbhalo lowufunako bese uchafata Enter
search-step: %s ku-%s - chafata Enter kuze ufike kulokulandzelako
set-wip-limit-value: Setha umkhawulo wenombolo lenkhulu yemisebenti kuloluhlu
list-permissions-desc: Loko indzima ngayinye lengakwenta kulolu luhla, ngetulu kwaloko lokuvunyelwa ngulibhodi. Baphatsi belibhodi bangahlela njalo.
show-cards-minimum-count: Khombisa sibalo semakhadi uma luhlu lunalamanyenti kuna
star-board-title: Chafata kuze ufake inkhanyeti kulelibhodi. Litawubonakala etulu eluhlwini lwemabhodi akho.
set-default-board-title: Chafata kuze uvule lelibhodi ngekutentakalela ngemuva kwekungena.
unset-default-board-title: Lelibhodi livuleka ngemuva kwekungena. Chafata kuze uyekise kulivula ngekutentakalela.
starred-boards-description: Emabhodi lanenkhanyeti abonakala etulu eluhlwini lwemabhodi akho.
title: Sihloko
toggle-assignees: Vula noma vala lababelwe 1-9 ekhadini (Ngekuhleleka kwekwengetwa ebhodini).
toggle-labels: Vula noma vala emalebula 1-9 ekhadini. Kukhetsa Lokunyenti kwengeta emalebula 1-9
tracking-info: Utawatiswa nganoma nguluphi lushintjo kulawo makhadi lohlanganyela kuwo njengemdali noma lilunga.
custom-top-left-corner-logo-image-url: I-URL Yesitfombe Seluphawu Lwekona Lelingetulu Ngesancele Lolukhetsekile
custom-top-left-corner-logo-link-url: I-URL Yesichumanisi Seluphawu Lwekona Lelingetulu Ngesancele Lolukhetsekile
custom-top-left-corner-logo-height: Kuphakama Kweluphawu Lwekona Lelingetulu Ngesancele Lolukhetsekile. Lokumisiwe: 27
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Tinhlelo te-URL letikhetsekile lokufanele tichafateke ngekutentakalela. Luhlelo lunye lwe-URL emgceni ngamunye
automatic-linked-url-schemes-hint: Ekucaleni kute lokubhaliwe, ngako tichumanisi tewebhu ne-imeyili kuphela letingachofozwa. Luhlobo ngalunye lwesichumanisi loluseluhlwini, njenge-thunderlink noma i-onenote, luvula luhlelo lolubhaliselwe lona. Tinhlobo javascript, data, vbscript naletinye letifana nato atentiwa tichumanisi nanini.
external-link-pattern-description: Ihlanganisa ngokutiphetsa titeleko letifaka "#1234" letitfolakala embhalweni wekhadi kubukeli bwetinkinga tangale. Shiya sigcamo lesisodva singenalutfo kutsi kuvinjelwe.
external-link-rules-description: Umtsetfo munye emgceni ngamunye: umbhalo lofunwako, " = ", nelikheli. Sebentisa {number} kumadijithi na-{identifier} egameni, kuko kokubili, sibonelo [{identifier}:{number}] = https://tracker.example.com/{identifier}/{number}.
wipLimitErrorPopup-dialog-pt1: Inombolo yemisebenti kuloluhlu ingetulu kwemkhawulo we-WIP lowuchazile.
wipLimitErrorPopup-dialog-pt2: Uyacelwa ususe leminye imisebenti kuloluhlu, noma usethe umkhawulo we-WIP lomkhulu.
attachment-retention-days-help: NjengaSula ekhadini: umlandvo wekhadi ungakubuyisela. Kute lutfo nobe 0: akusoze.
attachment-retention-purge-help: Emvakwaloko akusenakubuyiselwa. Kute lutfo nobe 0: akusoze.
attachment-retention-dry-run: Kuhlola: bala kuphela, kulogi yeseva, ungashintji lutfo
attachment-transfer-limits-description: Lungiselela imikhawulo yebungako bemafayela lamakhulu ekulayisheni nasekulandeni. Kubamba kudluliswa kwe-API kunemikhawulo yekuphepha leseva leyehlukile.
attachment-transfer-limits-invalid-value: Uyacelwa ufake ligugu lemkhawulo lelivumelekile nalelivumako
avatars-upload-blocked-description: Vimbela basebentisi ekulayisheni titfombe temsebentisi letisha (kulungele uma titfombe tivumelaniswa kulomunye umtfombo). Titfombe temsebentisi tivuliwe ngekwemisiwe.
smtp-host-description: Likheli leseva ye-SMTP lephatsa ema-imeyili akho.
smtp-port-description: Sikhumulo lesisetjentiswa yiseva yakho ye-SMTP kuma-imeyili laphumako.
email-invite-register-text:
Sawubona __user__,

__inviter__ ukumema kutsi ujoyine libhodi le-kanban kuze nibambisane.

Uyacelwa ulandzele sichumanisi lesingentasi:
__url__

Ikhodi yakho yesimemo ngu: __icode__

Siyabonga.
webhook-payload-description: Loko lokutfunyelwa ngema-webhook laphumako (Rocket.Chat, Slack, ...). Lokumisiwe kugcina silungiselelo lesitfolwe njengelifa; nangabe kute lokusetiwe, ema-webhook atfumela loko lebekasolo atfumela kona.
webhook-payload-field-people: Lilunga noma lonikwe umsebenti lokukhulunywa ngaye
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Kuhlelwe kahle: libhodi, ngubani, likhadi ngemabhalo lagcamile
webhook-mattermost-dm: Tfumela nemlayeto loncondzile we-Mattermost kumalunga nalabanikwe umsebenti welikhadi
webhook-mattermost-dm-desc: Wonkhe umlayeto mayelana nelikhadi uphindze uye kulelo nalelo lilunga nalonikwe umsebenti walo njengemlayeto loncondzile we-Mattermost, kuligama labo lemsebentisi ku-WeKan. Ku-Mattermost, i-webhook lengenako akufanele ivalelwe esiteshini sayo.

Sandstorm iyakugcina emvumweni futsi isayina sicelo ngasinye ngako; WeKan ayikuboni nanini.
webhooks-off-desc: Fihla yonkhe i-Webhook emabhodini nasePhaneli yemlawuli. Iseva ayitfumeli i-Webhook futsi iyala kwengeta noma kushintja yinye. Ema-Webhook alondvolotiwe ayahlala futsi asebenta kabusha uma loku kuvaliwe.

webhooks-disabled: Onkhe ema-Webhook avaliwe ku-Iphaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo / Tici.

Shiya kungenalutfo uma lenhlangano ingesiye umcashi.

r-workflow-help: Hudvula sicupho nesento ukufake kumakhi, bese wengeta umtsetfo. Hudvula sento usifake emtsetfweni lokhona kuze ushintje lokwentako.
r-import-trello: Ngenisa imitsetfo kusuka ku-Trello Butler (ngemandla onkhe)

r-import-workflow-note: Ngenisa kuhamba kwemsebenti lokubonakalako lokutfunyelwe kusuka ku-n8n noma Node-RED. Emanodi eticupho/tento latiwako amataniswa nemitsetfo ye-WeKan; emanodi langakamataniswa ayabikwa.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Indlela yemsebenti ya-Wrike luhlu lwetimo, ngasinye seliqenjini le-Active, Completed, Deferred noma Cancelled. Kutfumela kubhala luhlu lwalelibhodi njengayinye, leletsa libito lelibhodi, nge-JSON lebuyiswa yi-API ya-Wrike yetindlela temsebenti: yakha leyo ndlela yemsebenti ku-Wrike ngaphambi kwekungenisa kutfumela kwe-Excel ya-Wrike kwalelibhodi, kute timo tayo tisebente. Kungenisa kufundza leyo JSON lenamatsiselwe ngenhla, levela ku-WeKan noma ku-GET /workflows ya-Wrike, kulibhodi lelikhetsiwe: simo lesingenaluhlu siba luhlu, kantsi umtsetfo ubeka likhadi njengeliphelile nangabe lisiwa esimeni lesi-Completed noma Cancelled kantsi alikapheli esimeni lesi-Active noma Deferred. Imitsetfo yekusebenta ngekwako ya-Wrike angeke itfunyelwe ivela ku-Wrike.
r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Indlela yemsebenti ya-Wrike "__name__": luhlu lu-__lists__ nemitsetfo le-__rules__ kungetiwe, tincenye leti-__skipped__ atifundvwanga

board-table-card-title-wrap-on: Tinhloko temakhadi tigoqana emgceni lomunye kuya kwemunyenti. Chofoza kutsi utigcugcuve ngemachashazi lamatsatfu esikhundleni saloko.

board-table-group-by-swimlane-on: Emakhadi ahlelwe ngendlela yekubhukuda. Chofoza kutsi uwakhombise njengeluhlu lolucwebile esikhundleni saloko.
board-table-group-by-swimlane-off: Emakhadi akhonjiswa njengeluhlu lolucwebile. Chofoza kutsi uwahlele ngendlela yekubhukuda esikhundleni saloko.
dueCardsViewChange-choice-all-descriptio: Khombisa onkhe emakhadi langakapheli lanelilanga *Lekugcina* lasemabhodini umsebentisi lanemvume yawo.
globalSearchViewChange-choice-all-descri: Sesha onkhe emakhadi emabhodini lonemvume yawo. Khetsa *Emakhadi ami* kute unciphise imiphumela ibe ngemakhadi loyilunga noma lowabelwe wona.
operator-limit-invalid: %s akusiko umkhawulo lovumelekile. Umkhawulo kufanele ube yinombolo lephelele lenkhulu kunaziro.
globalSearch-instructions-description: Kusesha kungafaka tisebenti kute kucaciswe kusesha. Tisebenti tibhalwa ngekubhala ligama lesisebenti nelinani lehlukaniswe yikholoni. Sibonelo, kubhala sisebenti `list:Blocked` kungakhawulela kusesha kumakhadi laseluhlwini lolubitwa ngekutsi *Blocked*. Uma linani linetikhala noma timphawu letikhetsekile kufanele lifakwe etimphawini tekucaphuna (sib. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - emakhadi elibhodi lelabelwe inhlangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - emakhadi elibhodi lelabelwe licembu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - emakhadi lafanele kungakapheli emalanga langu-*<n>* kusukela nyalo. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ubala onkhe emakhadi laseendlulelwe lilanga lekugcina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - emakhadi lakhiwe emalangeni langu-*<n>* lendlulile noma ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - emakhadi lashintjwe emalangeni langu-*<n>* lendlulile noma ngaphansi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - lapho *<field>* kungulokunye kwa-`__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noma `__predicate_member__`. Kubeka `-` ngaphambi kwe-*<field>* kusesha kungabikho kwelinani kulendzawo (sib. `has:-due` kusesha emakhadi langenalo lilanga lekugcina).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - lapho *<sort-name>* kungulokunye kwa-`__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noma `__predicate_modified__`. Kute uhlele ngekuhlehla, beka `-` ngaphambi kweligama lekuhlela.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - lapho *<n>* kuyinombolo lephelele lenkhulu kunaziro lekhombisa linani lemakhadi latawukhonjiswa ekhasini ngalinye.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tisebenti letifanako tihlanganiswa nge-*OR*. Emakhadi lahambelana nanoma ngumuphi umbandzela atawubuyiswa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` kungabuyisa emakhadi lakunoma nguluphi luhlu lolubitwa ngekutsi *Blocked* noma *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tisebenti letehlukene tihlanganiswa nge-*AND*. Kubuyiswa kuphela emakhadi lahambelana nato tonkhe tisebenti letehlukene. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` kubuyisa kuphela emakhadi laseluhlwini *Available* lanelebula *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Emalanga angabalulwa ngenombolo lephelele lenhle noma lembi, noma ngekusebentisa `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noma `__predicate_year__` kulesikhatsi sanyalo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Kusesha umbhalo akunandzaba nekutsi tinhlavu tinkhulu noma tincane.

location-detect-from-map: Tfola indzawo kunoma ngusiphi sihlanganisi semephu

Sicela utfumele liphutsa lelakhiwe siphakeli.
Ekufakweni kwe-snap, sebentisa: `sudo snap logs wekan.wekan`
Ekufakweni kwe-Docker, sebentisa: `sudo docker logs wekan-app`
now-activities-of-all-boards-are-hidden: Nyalo yonkhe imisebenti yawo onkhe emabhodi ifihliwe
custom-field-stringtemplate-context-hint: Sebentisa %{card.title}, %{board.title}, %{list.title} noma %{swimlane.title}. Ngeta |urlencode kulokugucukako kuze kusetjentiswe njengepharamitha ye-URL, sibonelo %{value|urlencode}.
custom-field-stringtemplate-item-placeho: Chafata enter kute wengete tintfo letinyenti
creator: Umdali
office-report-desc: Lapho bantfu bangena khona, bahlelwe ngemuntfu. Likheli ngalinye le-IPv4 noma le-IPv6 likhombisa live, lidolobha kanye nelinani lekungena lokuphumelele lelikhona.
office-no-results: Kute losewungenile, noma kute kungena lokurekhodiwe.
api-report-desc: Ngutiphi tindzawo tekugcina te-REST API letisetjentiswako, ngubani, futsi kangakhi. Umugca munye nge-akhawunti nendzawo yekugcina, kanye nesikhatsi losihlanganisako - akusilo umugca ngesicelo ngasinye.
api-no-calls: Kute kubita kwe-REST API lokurekhodiwe. I-API ivaliwe ngaphandle nangabe WITH_API=true.
recovery-report-desc: Tento tekuphepha kwedatha nekulungisa letentakalelako: kutfola konakala, tilondvoloti tembhalo, kubuyisela, kufudvuka kabusha kusuka ku-MongoDB, nekulungisa ngekutentakalela silulu lesikhukhumukile.
recovery-no-events: Kute tehlakalo tekubuyisela letirekhodiwe. Silulu siphilile.
recovery-maintenance-note: Sicela ulindze — lelikhasi litawuchubeka ngekutentakalela uma kubuyisela sekuphelile.
delete-org-warning-message: Angeke usule lenhlangano, kunalokungenani umsebentisi munye loyilunga layo
delete-team-warning-message: Angeke usule lelicembu, kunalokungenani umsebentisi munye loyilunga lalo
subject: Sihloko
remove-team-from-table: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kususa lelicembu kulelibhodi?
filter-preset-replace-hint: Takho wedvwa kulelibhodi. Kugcina ngeligama lelifanako kufaka letinsha esikhundleni saletindzala.
filter-preset-error: Letihlungi atikakwati kugcinwa noma kusetjentiswa. Hlola ligama, umusho wesihlungi nemvume yakho yekungena ebhodini.
email-domain-allowed-to-invite: Indzawo ye-imeyili levunyelwe kumema bantfu uma kutibhalisa kuvaliwe
to-create-teams-contact-admin: Kute wakhe emacembu, sicela utsintsane nemphatsi.
Node_heap_total_heap_size_executable: Inqwaba ye-Node: samba semkhawulo wenqwaba losebentisekako
Node_heap_peak_malloced_memory: Inqwaba ye-Node: sicongo senkumbulo leyabelwe nge-malloc
Node_memory_usage_rss: Kusetjentiswa kwenkumbulo ye-Node: bukhulu besethi lehlala enkumbulweni
Node_memory_usage_heap_total: Kusetjentiswa kwenkumbulo ye-Node: samba sebukhulu benqwaba leyabelwe
Node_memory_usage_heap_used: Kusetjentiswa kwenkumbulo ye-Node: inkumbulo yangempela lesetjentisiwe
remove-organization-from-board: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kususa lenhlangano kulelibhodi?
to-create-organizations-contact-admin: Kute wakhe tinhlangano, sicela utsintsane nemphatsi.
newlineBecomesNewChecklistItem: Umugca ngamunye wombhalo uba yintfo yeluhlu lwekuhlola
newLineNewItem: Umugca munye wombhalo = intfo yinye yeluhlu lwekuhlola
newlineBecomesNewChecklistItemOriginOrde: Umugca ngamunye wombhalo uba yintfo yeluhlu lwekuhlola, ngekulandzelana kwekucala
move-all-attachments-of-board-to-fs: Hambisa konkhe lokunamatsiselwe kwelibhodi eluhlelweni lwemafayela
move-attachments-none-found: Kute lokugcinwe endzaweni yemtfombo lekhetsiwe, ngako kute lokungahanjiswa.
attachment-repair-locations-description: Tfola lokunamatsiselwe netitfombe temsebentisi lokugcinwa kwako lokurekhodiwe (luhlelo lwemafayela / GridFS / lifu) kungasahambelani nalapho lifayela likhona, bese ulungisa silulu sikhombe indzawo yangempela.
default-save-storage-description: Khetsa indzawo yekugcina lapho lokunamatsiselwe lokusha lokulayishiwe kutawulondvolotwa khona.
default-save-storage-save-failed: Kwehlulekile kulondvolota indzawo yekugcina lekhetfwa ngekutentakalela
mongodb-compact-description: Ngemuva kwekuhambisa emafayela aphume ku-MongoDB GridFS, lifayela lesilulu lelikudiski alinciphi ngekutentakalela. Kusebentisa Compact kubuyisa sikhala lesikhululiwe ngekubhala kabusha idatha yelicembu. Sebentisa loku kuphela ngemuva kwekutsi kuhambisa emafayela lamanyenti sekuphelile.
mongodb-compact-warning: Secwayiso: Compact ngumsebenti lovimbako longatsatsa emaminitsi lambalwa etilulwini letinkhulu. Kumasethi etifaniso, tonkhe tifaniso tesibili ticindzetelwa kucala (ngekutentakalela), bese kuba ngulesiyinhloko. Kumasethi etifaniso lanenodi yinye lasetjentiselwa i-oplog (kulungiselelwa kwe-Meteor lokuvamile), kucindzetelwa lesiyinhloko kuphela.
mongodb-compact-running: Compact iyasebenta, loku kungatsatsa emaminitsi lambalwa...
board-status-remaining-time-total: Sikhatsi lesisele kuze kube ngusuku lekugcina
password-pwned: Leliphasiwedi selivele ekuvuzeni kwedatha. Khetsa lelinye.
password-too-short: Liphasiwedi kufanele libe netinhlamvu letingu __min__ noma ngetulu.
password-length-report-desc: Ema-akhawunti langena ngeliphasiwedi lelifisha kunebudze lobuncane. Libhrawuza kuphela leyati kutsi liphasiwedi lidze kangakanani, ngako-ke libika lelifisha ngemuva kwekungena; liphasiwedi nebudze balo akukaze kuphume kulo. Kulungisiwe sikhatsi lapho liphasiwedi le-akhawunti lashintjwa - i-akhawunti lengena futsi ngeliphasiwedi lelifisha ikhonjiswa futsi njengalefisha kakhulu.
password-min-length-description: Kungena ngeliphasiwedi lelifisha kubhalwe ngentasi. Kungena akukaze kwaliwe ngenca yaloko.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Liphasiwedi lelisha lelifisha liyaliwa, futsi i-akhawunti lengena ngeliphasiwedi lelifisha kufanele ilishintje ngaphambi kwalokunye. Kulishintja kuphumisa onkhe emaseshini e-akhawunti. Emaphasiwedi e-LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS ne-Sandstorm ngewabaniketi bawo, futsi akahlolwa.
password-length-from-environment: Linani lelibekwe endzaweni yeseva liyasebenta; kugcina lapha kuyalitsatsela.
password-change-required-text: Lesayithi nyalo idzinga emaphasiwedi lanetinhlamvu letingu __min__ noma ngetulu, futsi lakho lifisha. Khetsa lelidze kute uchubeke. Bese onkhe emaseshini e-akhawunti yakho ayaphuma, futsi ungena futsi ngeliphasiwedi lelisha.
password-same-as-username: Liphasiwedi akukafaneli libe ligama lemsebentisi noma likheli le-imeyili.
invalid-file: Uma ligama lelifayela lingavumelekile, kulayisha noma kushintja ligama kuyakhanselwa.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Lidivayisi yakho ayikusekeli kubuka i-PDF kusengaphambili. Yetama kuyilandza esikhundleni saloko.
drag-board-to-workspace: Dvonsa libhodi kute ulabele ku-__workspaces__ (libeke endzaweni yekusebenta kubha yaseceleni)
delete-translation-confirm-popup: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kususa lomusho wekuhumusha lokukhetsekile? Akukho kubuyisela.
import-board-zip: Engeta lifayela le-.zip lelinemafayela e-JSON elibhodi netinkhomba letincane temagama emabhodi letinalokunamatsiselwe
share-target-empty: Kute lokwabeliwe. Yabelana ngelikhasi, linothi nobe umlayeto ne-WeKan kusuka kulenye i-app.
accounts-lockout-info: Letilungiselelo tilawula indlela imizamo yekungena levikelwa ngayo ekuhlaselweni ngekuzama ngemandla.
accounts-lockout-known-users: Tilungiselelo tebasebentisi labatiwako (ligama lemsebentisi lilungile, libitophawu alikalungi)
accounts-lockout-settings-updated: Tilungiselelo tekuvikela ekuhlaselweni ngekuzama ngemandla tibuyeketiwe
admin-audit-log-info: Loko lokwentiwe baphatsi besayithi: kushintjwa kwebasebentisi, kungena, kulondvolota nemakhophi esipele, lokusha kucala. Emaphasiwedi netimfihlo akusoze kwabhalwa. Kugcinwa umnyaka.
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: Basebentisi labavalelwe nyalo ngenca yemitamo leminyenti yekungena leyehlulekile
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock-all: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kuvula bonkhe basebentisi labavalelwe?
add-cron-job-placeholder: Kusebenta kwekwengeta Umsebenti Lohleliwe kutawuta masinyane
attachments-path-description: Indlela lapho emafayela lalokunamatsiselwe agcinwa khona
avatars-path-description: Indlela lapho emafayela etitfombe temsebentisi agcinwa khona
cron-job-delete-confirm: Ucinisekile yini kutsi ufuna kususa lomsebenti lohleliwe?
filesystem-enabled-description: Sebentisa sistimu yemafayela yalapha kugcina emafayela
s3-minio-storage-description: Indzawo yekugcina tintfo lehambisana ne-S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces nalabanye.
s3-force-path-style-description: Kudzingwa yi-MinIO kanye nemaseva lamanyenti lahambisana ne-S3 langesiwo e-AWS.
s3-sse-description: I-S3 ifihla ngekhodi konkhe lokunamatsiselwe, sitfombe semsebentisi nekhophi yesipele lekubhalwa yi-WeKan, futsi iyakuvula ku-WeKan nakufundvwa.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: I-ID yesikhiya se-KMS se-SSE-KMS (kungenalutfo = sikhiya lesimisiwe se-akhawunti)
azure-connection-string-description: Kungakhetfwa: sebentisa umusho wekuchumana lophelele esikhundleni seligama le-akhawunti nesikhiya.
database-migration-description: Tfutsela idatha lesekelwe embhalweni (konkhe ngaphandle kwetinanyatseliswa nema-avatar, lokuhlala kusistimu yemafayela) emkhatsini we-MongoDB ne-FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Lesinye sisekelo sedatha kufanele sisebente futsi sifinyeleleke (emachweba elijwayelekile: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; shintja nge-WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nasekuphelile, khomba i-MONGO_URL kulesinye sisekelo sedatha bese ucalisa kabusha i-WeKan (ku-Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb noma =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Kopisha onkhe emaqoqo lasekelwe embhalweni ku-__db__? Tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar lakusistimu yemafayela angeke atsintseke. Sisekelo sedatha lesicondziwe kufanele sisebente.
sandstorm-migration-description: Nangabe i-WeKan isebenta ekhatsi kwe-Sandstorm grain, sisekelo sayo lesidzala se-MongoDB 3 sitfutsela ku-FerretDB v1 (SQLite) nakucaliswa kwekucala, futsi tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar kususwa esisekelweni sedatha kuyiswe kumafolda e-grain files/attachments kanye ne-files/avatars. Loku kukhombisa kutsi lokutfutsela kuphumelele yini, kutsi emafayela lamadzala e-MongoDB asebentisa sikhala lesingakanani ku-grain, futsi kukuvumela kuwasusa kuze uvule sikhala.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Susa emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Ngemuva kwekutfutsela lokuphumelele, idatha ihlala ku-FerretDB nakusistimu yemafayela, ngako emafayela lamadzala laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB 3 angasuswa kuvula sikhala sediski ye-grain. Loku angeke kuhoxiswe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB 3 kuvula sikhala sediski? Idatha seyitfutselwe ku-FerretDB nakusistimu yemafayela. Loku angeke kuhoxiswe.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Emafayela laseluhlata esisekelo sedatha se-MongoDB asusiwe, kuvulwe
features-desc: Tici longatikhetsela letiniketwa yi-WeKan. Sici lesingakakhetfwa siyafihlwa kubo bonkhe basebentisi. Idatha yaso iyagcinwa futsi timvumo atigucuki.
feature-views-overview-desc: Tibalo, kuhlanganisa ngekwabelwa umuntfu, luhlelo lwemsebenti, lideshibhodi nelibhodi lelikhulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Umsebenti wemkhicito losalindzile, tikhatsi temsebenti letimfisha, umbiko waleso sikhatsi nelijubane lemsebenti.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Umsebenti losele, umsebenti lophelile, kugeleza lokucokelelwe, sikhatsi sekwenta nesekulindza, linani lemsebenti lophelile, sikhatsi umsebenti sewulindzile, tivimbelo, i-Monte Carlo naletinye tilinganiso tekugeleza kwemsebenti.
feature-approval-required: Gcina tici letingetwe kubuyeketwa kwe-WeKan tingasebenti aze umlawuli ativule
feature-preview-admins: Balawuli babona tici letingasebenti kute batihlole kucala
feature-profiles-desc: Iphrofayela ifihla tici letikhetsiwe kubasebentisi, emacembu netinhlangano leyabelwe kuto. Umsebentisi uyatjelwa kutsi uneliphi iphrofayela. Lote iphrofayela akatsintseki, kute lwatiso lolususwako futsi kute imvume lecunyiswako.
feature-profile-notice: Iphrofayela yakho yetici __name__ ifihla tici letingu-__count__. Buta umlawuli nangabe udzinga lesinye sato.
card-field-visibility-desc: Tindzawo te-Board Settings / Card letingakhonjiswa ngemabhodi. Indzawo lengakhetfwanga iyafihlwa kuwo onkhe emakhadi, emakhadi lamancane kanye ne-Board Settings / Card yalo lonkhe libhodi. Kute idatha yelikhadi noma silungiselelo selibhodi lesishintjako, futsi kuyikhetsa futsi kukhombisa libhodi ngalinye njengobe belisetiwe. Kuhleleka kwetindzawo kungekwelibhodi ngalinye.
cards-loading-description: I-WeKan ilayisha emakhadi ebhodi ngekuzenzakalela: libhodi lelikhulu (lelingetulu kwemkhawulo wesayizi) lilayisha kuphela emakhadi labonakalako nyalo (kuskrola lokungapheli) kanye nesibalo lesibukhoma, kuze lihlale lishesha futsi lisebentise imemori ne-bandwidth lencane, kantsi emabhodi lamancane alayisha onkhe emakhadi kuze kube lula futsi tonkhe tici tisebente. Kute lokudzingeka kulungiswe. Basebenti bangaphocelela indlela nge-CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) kanye nema-variable e-CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kulayisha emakhadi kancane kusahlolwa: tibali temakhadi nemikhawulo ye-WIP kunembile, kodvwa kubukwa kweKhalenda/Lithebula/Gantt kanye nekukhetsa lokunyenti kukhombisa kuphela emakhadi lasalayishiwe. Layisha kabusha emabhodi lavulekile ngemuva kwekushintja loku.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tixhumanisi (kokubili tixhumanisi te-markdown njenge-[label](url) nema-tag e-HTML langakalungiswa e-<a href>) tihlale tikhonjiswa njengembhalo lolula longacofeki kuyo yonkhe insimu yembhalo lonotsile (tihloko temabhodi nemakhadi, tinchazelo, imibono, tinhla tekuhlola, njll.). Loku kuvimbela tixhumanisi leticocekako letidukisako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngako tixhumanisi tihlala ticoceka.
always-show-code-as-text: Njalo khombisa yonkhe ikhodi njengembhalo lolula
always-show-code-as-text-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, umbhalo lonotsile awukhonjiswa njenge-markdown noma i-HTML: wonkhe umtfombo uhlale ukhonjiswa njengembhalo lolula kuyo yonkhe insimu yembhalo lonotsile (tihloko temabhodi nemakhadi, tinchazelo, imibono, tinhla tekuhlola, njll.). Loku kwembula lokucuketfwe lokufihlekile — imibono ye-HTML (<!-- -->), indzawo tixhumanisi te-markdown letiya kuyo, i-JavaScript kanye nanoma nguyiphi lenye ikhodi — kuze yonkhe ikhodi ihlale ibonakala, ingacofeki futsi ingasebenti. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe, ngako i-markdown ikhonjiswa ngendlela lejwayelekile.
disable-all-import-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tici tekungenisa tiyavalwa: kungenisa libhodi kusuka ku-WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne-Forgejo, kanye nekukopa libhodi. Tinkhetfo temenyu yekungenisa tiyafihlwa futsi iseva iyenqaba noma ngusiphi sicelo sekungenisa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
import-max-megabytes-description: Lifayela lelikhulu kakhulu lelemukelwa likhasi lekungenisa, ngemamegabhayithi. Lokungenalutfo kusho kutsi ate umkhawulo: lifayela lingaba likhulu ngendlela sikhala lesikhululekile kudiski lesivumela kutsi kungenisa kucedze. Konkhe lokulayishwako kubhalwa kudiski yeseva incenye ngencenye, futsi kungenisa lokungagcwalisa idiski kuyaliwa.
import-disk-full: Akukho sikhala lesanele kudiski yeseva salokungenisa.
disable-all-export-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, tonkhe tici tekukhipha tiyavalwa: kukhipha libhodi njenge-WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, noma ku-NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kanye nekukhipha sinanyatseliswa sinye. Tinkhetfo temenyu yekukhipha tiyafihlwa futsi iseva iyenqaba noma ngusiphi sicelo sekukhipha. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-import-avatars-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, ema-avatar (titfombe tephrofayela yemsebentisi) awakaze angeniswe. Loku kufaka kungenisa kwe-WeKan JSON, kungenisa kwe-Trello, nekuvumelanisa ema-avatar kubahlinzeki bangaphandle bemazisi nakungenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Emagama naleminye imininingwane kusangeniswa; ema-avatar kuphela langangeniswa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-export-avatars-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, ema-avatar (titfombe tephrofayela yemsebentisi) awakaze afakwe nakukhishwa libhodi (kukhipha kwe-WeKan JSON ne-CSV). Emagama ebantfu naleminye imininingwane kusakhishwa; ema-avatar kuphela langafakwa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-import-users-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kungenisa libhodi le-WeKan JSON kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi longeniswako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono lengenisiwe. Kute mazisi wangempela wemsebentisi lovela ebhodini lemtfombo logcinwako. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu longenisako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-export-users-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kukhipha libhodi kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi lokhishwako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono. Lifayela lelikhishiwe alinaso sikhombi sangempela semsebentisi. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu lokhiphako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Nangabe kuvuliwe, kukhipha libhodi kushintja ligama lemsebentisi, ligama leliphelele netinhlavu tekucala tawo wonkhe umsebentisi lokhishwako kube timphawu tekubala (user1, user2, ...), kususa i-avatar yakhe, futsi kubhala kabusha kukhulunywa nge-@username (kanye netinsimu te-requested-by / assigned-by) ekhatsi kwemakhadi nemibono. Lifayela lelikhishiwe alinaso sikhombi sangempela semsebentisi. Ligama lelitsi "umsebentisi" lilandzela lulwimi lwemuntfu lokhiphako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-activities-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, lokufakiwe ekusakazweni kwemisebenti akurekhodwa futsi akukhonjiswa ndzawo (ebhawulweni lelisecele lebhodi nasethebhu yemisebenti yekhadi). Kute umlandvo wekutsi ngubani lowente ini logcinwako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-notifications-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, i-WeKan ayitfumeli tatiso tekubukela (ekhatsi kweluhlelo, nge-imeyili noma ngaletinye tinsita) nganoma ngumuphi umsebenti. Imisebenti ingarekhodwa (ngaphandle nangabe nayo ivalwe ngenhla); tatiso kuphela leticindzetelwako. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
disable-watch-description: Nangabe kuvuliwe, sici sekubukela siyavalwa — basebentisi abakhoni kubhalisela emabhodi, tinhla noma emakhadi kutsi batfole tatiso, futsi noma ngumuphi umzamo wekushintja lizinga lekubukela uyenqatjwa. Ngekuzenzakalela kuvaliwe.
backup-description: Yenta ikhophi yesipele yeTinanyatseliswa, ema-Avatar kanye/noma Idatha (onkhe emaqoqo lasekelwe embhalweni langesito tinanyatseliswa noma ema-avatar). I-.zip isakazwa ngco kusitoreji lesikhetsiwe — kute lifayela lesikhashana — njenge-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, lelicuketse YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kanye /data. Titoreji telifu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) tisebentisa imininingwane yekungena lelungiswe kumathebhu ato esitoreji.
backup-scope-description: Sibonelo sonkhe, noma Inhlangano yinye. Ikhophi yesipele yeNhlangano icuketse emabhodi ayo nako konkhe lokukuwo, kufaka tinanyatseliswa talawo mabhodi — kodvwa kute ema-akhawunti ebantfu noma tilungiselelo tesibonelo, ngobe loko kwabelwana ngato tonkhe Tinhlangano. Kubuyisela ikhophi yesipele yeNhlangano kubhala kuphela emabhodini laphetfwe nguleyo Nhlangano.
continuous-backup-description: Itfumela lonkhe lushintjo lwesisekelo sedatha, tinanyatseliswa, ema-avatar nemarekhodi kufolda ngemizuzwana lembalwa, kuze kubuyiselwe kunoma ngusiphi sikhatsi. Isebenza kanye nekhophi yesipele lehleliwe, leyenta tigcini letiphelele.
continuous-backup-enabled: Sebentisa ikhophi yesipele lechubekako kule seva
continuous-backup-target: Ifolda lapho kutawugcinwa khona (indlela lephelele, kulenye idiski, endzaweni leyabiwe kunethiwekhi noma endzaweni lehlanganiswe nge-rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Emakhasi e-SQLite (emakhasi lashintjile kuleso naleso sikhatsi lesibekiwe)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Kute injini yesisekelo sedatha lengasebenta kule seva
continuous-backup-base-every: Ikhophi lesisekelo lensha njalo ngemahora labekiwe
continuous-backup-key-file: Lifayela lesikhiya sekufihla ngekhodi (indlela lephelele ngaphandle kwefolda lapho kutawugcinwa khona; tinhlavu letingu-64 teluhlelo lwetinombolo lolusekelwe ku-16 noma umushwana loyimfihlo lonetinhlavu letingu-16 noma ngetulu). Gcina ikhophi: ngaphandle kwalelifayela ikhophi yesipele ngeke ibuyiselwe.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Kute indzawo (kufolda lapho kutawugcinwa khona kuphela)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Lifayela lesisekelo sedatha le-SQLite (lakhiwa eceleni kwekhophi yesipele, alibhalwa nanini etulu kwelifayela lelisetjentiswako)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Sebentisa sisekelo sedatha se-SQLite lesakhiwe kabusha ekucaleni kabusha lokulandzelako (sisekelo sedatha lesidzala lesitsatfwe indzawo sitawugcinwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela situkulwane lesikhetsiwe esikhatsini lesikhetsiwe? Ikhophi yesipele lechubekako iyema kwesikhashana ngesikhatsi sekubuyisela.
backup-restore-confirm: Buyisela ikhophi yesipele lekhetsiwe? Tinanyatseliswa/ema-avatar tibhalwa kusistimu yemafayela bese idatha ibhalwa esisekelweni sedatha ngekwendlela lekhetsiwe.
gcs-key-filename-description: Kungakhetfwa: indlela yelifayela lesikhiya le-JSON le-akhawunti yensita leseveni.
gcs-credentials-description: Kungakhetfwa: namatsisela sikhiya se-JSON se-akhawunti yensita. Shiya kungenalutfo kusebentisa lifayela lesikhiya noma imininingwane yekungena lejwayelekile.
gcs-permissions-note: Nika i-akhawunti yensita ye-WeKan imvume yekufundza/kubhala ebhakedeni: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → libhakede lakho → Permissions → Grant access. Ku-"New principals", namatsisela i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yensita — linani le-"client_email" lelikusikhiya sakho se-JSON — bese ukhetsa indzima ye-"Storage Object Admin" bese ugcina.
azure-container-description: Siqukatsi se-blob lapho kutawugcinwa khona emafayela.
gcs-bucket-description: Ligama lelibhakede le-Cloud Storage lapho kutawugcinwa khona emafayela.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: shiya kungenalutfo (kusebentisa indzawo yesifundza). Lokuhambisana ne-S3: i-Endpoint URL levela ku-console yakho ye-MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → libhakede lakho → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ligama lelibhakede lakho (noma Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → umsebentisi wakho → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → khetsa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Sikhonjiswa njenge-'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sikrini lesifanako ne-Access key ID; i-'Secret access key' ikhonjiswa kanye kuphela nakwakhiwa sikhiya — yikopishe lapho (noma Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → ligama lelikhonjiswa etulu (futsi ngaphansi kwe-Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → i-akhawunti yakho → Data storage → Containers → siqukatsi sakho (noma + Container kwenta lesisha).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → sikhetsi sephrojekthi etulu → i-ID yephrojekthi yakho (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ligama lelibhakede lakho (noma Create kwenta lelisha).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Indlela leseveni ye-WeKan leya efayeleni lesikhiya se-JSON le-akhawunti yensita lelandiwe (lelenziwe ngentansi). Sebentisa loku NOMA unamatsisele i-JSON ensimini lengentansi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → i-akhawunti yakho yensita → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kulandwa lifayela). Namatsisela lokucuketfwe ngulona lapha, noma ugcine lifayela bese ubeka indlela yalo ngenhla.
cloud-settings-desc: Nge WeKan ku Weddy, i Cloud Panel isebentela ema domain lamanyenti e WeKan kusuka ku server yinye, ngayinye inemininingwane yayo. Ku domain ye Cloud Panel, i SuperAdmin iphatsa ema domain ne CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: I Cloud Panel ngeye SuperAdmin kuphela, ku domain ye Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Nge sikhiya se CloudFlare API, i domain lene zone yayo ise-akhawunti yakho ye CloudFlare itfola irekhodi le DNS lele proxy kanye nesitifiketi se CloudFlare Origin. Letinye ema domain titfola sitifiketi se Let's Encrypt. Sikhiya sigcinwa ku server futsi angeke siphindze siveteke.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Akukho sikhiya se CloudFlare API lesigciniwe: yonkhe i domain itfola sitifiketi se Let's Encrypt.
migration-stop-confirm: Ucinisekile yini kutsi ufuna kumisa konkhe kutfutsela?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kuze tinanyatseliswa nema-avatar kubonakale, kutfutsele kusuka ku-CollectionFS kuye kunoma ngusiphi lesinye Sitoreji.
s3-enabled-description: Sebentisa i-AWS S3 noma i-MinIO kugcina emafayela
s3-endpoint-description: I-URL yendzawo yekugcina ye-S3 (sib., s3.amazonaws.com noma minio.example.com)
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kwenta kuhlola nekulungisa lokuphelele kwebucotfo bedatha yebhodi, kufaka kulandzelana kwetinhla, tindzawo temakhadi nesakhiwo semigca yekubhukusha.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Kususa ngekuphepha tinhla letingenalutfo letiphindziwe. Kususa kuphela tinhla letingenawo emakhadi FUTSI letinalolunye luhlu lolunesihloko lesifanako lolunemakhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Kutfola futsi kubuyisele emakhadi netinhla letishoda nge-swimlaneId noma listId. Kwakha umugca wekubhukusha 'Emakhadi lalahlekile' kuze tonkhe tintfo letilahlekile tiphindze tibonakale.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Kubuyisela yonkhe imigca yekubhukusha, tinhla nemakhadi lagcinwe kungobo yomlando. Kulungisa ngekuzenzakalela noma nguyiphi i-swimlaneId noma listId leshodayo kuze tintfo tibonakale.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Kutfola futsi kulungise tinhla letishodayo noma letonakele esakhiweni sebhodi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Kubuyeketa ema-URL ema-avatar emalunga ebhodi kutsi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina futsi kulungise tikhombi tema-avatar letiphukile.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kubuyeketa onkhe ema-URL etinanyatseliswa talelibhodi kutsi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina futsi kulungise tikhombi temafayela letiphukile.
migrations-description: Sebentisa kuhlolwa nekulungiswa kwebucotfo bedatha yalelibhodi. Kutfutsela ngakunye kungasebentiswa ngakodvwa.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Loku kutawenta kutfutsela lokuphelele kuhlola nekulungisa bucotfo bedatha yebhodi. Kungatsatsa sikhashana. Chubeka?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Loku kutawucala kugucule noma ngutiphi tinhla letabiwe tibe tinhla temugca ngamunye, bese kususa tinhla letingenalutfo letineluhlu loluphindziwe lolunesihloko lesifanako futsi lunemakhadi. Kutawususwa kuphela tinhla letingenalutfo letiphindzeke mbamba. Chubeka?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Loku kutawakha umugca wekubhukusha 'Emakhadi lalahlekile' futsi kubuyisele onkhe emakhadi netinhla letishoda nge-swimlaneId noma listId. Loku kutsintsa kuphela tintfo letingakagcinwa kungobo yomlando. Chubeka?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Loku kutawubuyisela YONKHE imigca yekubhukusha, tinhla nemakhadi lagcinwe kungobo yomlando, kuwenze abonakale futsi. Tintfo letinama-ID lashodayo titawulungiswa ngekuzenzakalela. Loku akulula kukuhlehlisa. Chubeka?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Loku kutawutfola futsi kulungise tinhla letishodayo noma letonakele esakhiweni sebhodi. Chubeka?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Loku kutawubuyeketa ema-URL ema-avatar emalunga ebhodi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina. Chubeka?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Loku kutawubuyeketa onkhe ema-URL etinanyatseliswa talelibhodi asebentise indzawo lefanele yekugcina. Chubeka?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Kute imigca yekubhukusha, tinhla noma emakhadi lalahlekile langabuyiselwa
migration-progress-note: Uyacelwa ulindze sisatfutsela libhodi lakho esakhiweni sakamuva...
conversion-info-text: Lokugucula kwentiwa kanye ebhodini ngalinye futsi kutfutfukisa kusebenta. Ungachubeka usebentisa libhodi ngendlela lejwayelekile.
converting-board-description: Kuguculwa sakhiwo sebhodi kuze sisebente kancono. Loku kungatsatsa sikhashana.
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Misa kwesikhashana kutfutsela nangabe kusetjentiswa kwe-CPU kwengca leliphesenti (10-90)
migration-info-text: Kutfutsela sisekelo sedatha kwentiwa kanye futsi kutfutfukisa kusebenta kweluhlelo. Inchubo ichubeka ngemuva ngisho noma uvala siphequluli sakho.
migration-warning-text: Uyacelwa ungavali siphequluli sakho ngesikhatsi sekutfutsela. Inchubo itawuchubeka ngemuva kodvwa kungatsatsa sikhatsi lesidze kutsi iphele.
account-locked: I-akhawunti ikhiywe kwesikhashana ngenca yemetamo leminyenti yekungena leyehlulekile. Uyacelwa uphindze wetame ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi.
username-too-short: Ligama lemsebentisi kufanele okungenani libe netinhlavu leti-3
problems-summary-help: Maka tindzawo tetinkinga lotibukete, bese uchafata Vuma kuze usethe kabusha sibalo setinkinga letisha.
problems-in-progress-help: Lokutfutsela noma lokulungisa kuyasebenta nyalo. Kungena kungahamba kancane, noma kukhombise "Kufanele ungene" noma sijikelezi se-"Kuyalayishwa, uyacelwa ulindze", kuze kuphele futsi i-CPU yehle.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Kulungiswe emakhadi langu-__fixed__. Emakhadi langu-__unfixable__ awanalo libhodi futsi awakhoni kulungiswa ngekuzenzakalela.
import-board-source: Ngenisa libhodi (Trello, Jira, lokukhishwe yi-WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Libhodi lakhiwe, kodvwa letinye tincenye telifayela atikakwati kudluliselwa. Umbiko lofanako ugcinwe ku-Iphaneli yemlawuli → Tinkinga → Kubuyisela.
import-parts-instruction: Kungeniswa kuphela tincenye letimakiwe. Kukhetsa lokufanako kusetjentiswa nakukhishwa.
import-wekan-file: Ngenisa kusuka efayeleni le-.json noma .zip lelikhishiwe:
import-file-label: Khetsa lifayela lekutfumela, noma unamatsisele umbhalo walo ngentansi:
sum-of-number-fields: Inhlanganisela yemasimu enombolo lahleliwe leyakhonjiswa etulu kwelusu
date-range-of-fields: Ibanga lelusuku lemasimu lolukhetsiwe lolusuku lolumakiwe kutsi liboniswe etulu kuluhla
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Kucinisekiswa ngetindlela letimbili kuvuliwe ku-akhawunti yakho.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Ngeta lendlela lengetiwe yekuvikeleka ku-akhawunti yakho. Nawusuvuliwe, utawudzinga kufaka likhodi levela ku-app yekucinisekisa onkhe emalanga nawungena.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Skena lelikhodi le-QR nge-app yekucinisekisa (sib. Google Authenticator, Authy), bese ufaka likhodi lelinenombolo letisi-6 lelikuvetako kute ucinisekise.
two-factor-required-text: Lesayithi idzinga kucinisekiswa ngetindlela letimbili ku-akhawunti yakho. Kusete kuze uchubeke.
twoFactorCode-prompt: Faka likhodi lakho lekucinisekisa lelinenombolo letisi-6
twoFactorCode-invalid: Likhodi lekucinisekisa alilungi. Sicela uzame futsi.
subtask-done-no-permission: Awukhoni kushintja kutsi lomsebenti lomncane uphelile yini
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Akukho losele luvulekile kute kubikezelwe - lonkhe likhadi seliphelile.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: Emakhadi la __remaining__ asesevulekile; akukho kuchediwe kwakamuva kute kubikezelwe lusuku.
chart-forecast-projected: Ngesivinini sakamuva se emakhadi la __average__ ngeliviki, emakhadi la __remaining__ lasesevulekile kufanele acedze nga __date__.
list-sync-description: Gcina loluhla lulandzelana neluhlaka lwangaphandle. Umsebenti wangemuva uyaluhlola njalo ngemitsi-15; sebentisa "Vumelanisa manje" kute uhlole nyalo.
drag-to-reorder: Hudvula kuze ushintje kulandzelana. Tinkinobho temicibisholo yetulu naphansi tihambisa indzawo yinye.
