map-view-empty: Lelibhodi alinaso sitfombe selibalave kwanyalo. Umphatsi welibhodi angalayisha sitfombe — liplani lesitezi, libalave lendzawo noma umdvwebo — bese emakhadi abekwa kuso.
map-view-place-hint: Dvosela likhadi ebalaveni, noma ulikhetse bese uchofoza lapho kufanele libe khona.
flow-note-agingWip: Luhla: Calisa → Sikhatsi lesitsatsiwe. P85: n ≥ 5. (akwatiwa): —.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Monte Carlo: 2000 × Umlandvo. emalanga: UTC; 0 ✓. 50%, 70%, 85%, 95%. Emakhadi ≥; Sikhatsi lesitsatsiwe ≤. Imikhawulo: 3650 emalanga.
flow-note-processBehavior: XmR: Sikhatsi somjikelezo; Calisa → Kuphelile. n ≥ 2. X: x̄ ± 3 × MR̄ / 1.128; MR: 0…3.267 × MR̄.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: X: Planning Poker / Inombolo. Y: Sikhatsi somjikelezo (emalanga). (akwatiwa): —.
time-adjustment-note: Umlandvo: Δ ema-awa; Ligama lemsebentisi ≠ Labanikwe umsebenti.
blockly-CANNOT_DELETE_VARIABLE_PROCEDURE: Angeke ukhone kusula lokuguculukako '%1' ngobe kuyincenye yencazelo yesento '%2'
blockly-COLOUR_RGB_TOOLTIP: Yakha umbala ngelinani lelishiwo lelibovu, lililuhlata nelibhuluu. Onkhe emanani kufanele abe emkhatsini wa-0 na-100.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_TOOLTIP: Yeca lokusele kwalesiyingi, bese uchubeka nekuphindza lokulandzelako.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_WARNING: Secwayiso: Lelibhulokhi lingasetjentiswa ngekhatsi kwesiyingi kuphela.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOREACH_TOOLTIP: Entfweni ngayinye eluhlwini, setha lokuguculukako '%1' kube yintfo leyo, bese wenta imiyalo letsite.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TITLE: bala nga-%1 kusuka ku-%2 kuya ku-%3 nga-%4
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TOOLTIP: Yenta lokuguculukako '%1' kutsatse emanani kusuka kunombolo yekucala kuya kunombolo yekugcina, ubala ngesikhala lesishiwo, bese wenta emabhulokhi lashiwo.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSE_TOOLTIP: Engeta simo sekugcina lesibamba konkhe kulibhulokhi lelitsi uma.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_IF_TOOLTIP: Engeta, susa, noma uhlele kabusha tigaba kute uhlele kabusha lelibhulokhi lelitsi uma.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_1: Uma linani liliciniso, yenta imiyalo letsite.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_2: Uma linani liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekucala lemiyalo. Ngalokunye, yenta libhulokhi lesibili lemiyalo.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_3: Uma linani lekucala liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekucala lemiyalo. Ngalokunye, uma linani lesibili liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lesibili lemiyalo.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_4: Uma linani lekucala liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekucala lemiyalo. Ngalokunye, uma linani lesibili liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lesibili lemiyalo. Uma kute ematfuba laliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekugcina lemiyalo.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_UNTI: Ngesikhatsi linani lingesilo liciniso, yenta imiyalo letsite.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_WHIL: Ngesikhatsi linani liliciniso, yenta imiyalo letsite.
blockly-HELP_PROMPT: Cindzetela %1 kute utfole lusito ngetilawuli tekhibhodi.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_CONSTRAINED_MOVE_HI: Sebentisa tinkinobho temicibisholo kuhambisa, bese kuba %1 kwemukela indzawo.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_FLYOUT_LABEL_HINT: Sebentisa tinkinobho temicibisholo kuya kulibhulokhi, noma cindzetela %1 kuya esihlokweni lesilandzelako.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_UNCONSTRAINED_MOVE_: Bamba %1 bese usebentisa tinkinobho temicibisholo kuhambisa ngekukhululeka, bese kuba %2 kwemukela indzawo.
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_EMPTY_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa luhlu, lwebudze lobu-0, lolungenato tincwadzi tedatha
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_CONTAINER_TOOL: Engeta, susa, noma uhlele kabusha tigaba kute uhlele kabusha lelibhulokhi leluhlu.
blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_GET_REMO: Isusa bese ibuyisa intfo yekucala eluhlwini.
Isusa bese ibuyisa intfo lesendzaweni leshiwo eluhlwini.
Isusa bese ibuyisa intfo yekugcina eluhlwini.
Isusa bese ibuyisa nanoma nguyiphi intfo eluhlwini.
blockly-LISTS_GET_SUBLIST_START_FROM_END: tfola luhlu loluncane kusuka ku-# kusuka ekugcineni
blockly-LISTS_INDEX_OF_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa indzawo yekuvela kwekucala/kwekugcina kwentfo eluhlwini. Ibuyisa %1 nangabe intfo ingatfolakali.
blockly-LISTS_REPEAT_TOOLTIP: Yakha luhlu lolunelinani lelinikiwe lelophindvwe inombolo yetikhatsi leshiwo.
blockly-LISTS_SPLIT_TOOLTIP_JOIN: Hlanganisa luhlu lwemabhalo kube ngumbhalo munye, wehlukaniswe luphawu lwekuhlukanisa.
blockly-LISTS_SPLIT_TOOLTIP_SPLIT: Hlukanisa umbhalo ube luhlu lwemabhalo, uwuhlukanisa kuluphawu ngalunye lwekuhlukanisa.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_EQ: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kokubili kuyalingana.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GT: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kwekucala kukhulu kunalokufakwako kwesibili.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GTE: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kwekucala kukhulu kuna noma kulingana nalokufakwako kwesibili.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_LT: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kwekucala kuncane kunalokufakwako kwesibili.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_LTE: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kwekucala kuncane kuna noma kulingana nalokufakwako kwesibili.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_NEQ: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kokubili akulingani.
blockly-LOGIC_NEGATE_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kungemanga. Ibuyisa emanga nangabe lokufakwako kuliciniso.
blockly-LOGIC_OPERATION_TOOLTIP_AND: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokufakwako kokubili kuliciniso.
blockly-LOGIC_OPERATION_TOOLTIP_OR: Buyisa liciniso nangabe lokunye nje kwalokufakwako kuliciniso.
blockly-LOGIC_TERNARY_TOOLTIP: Hlola simo ku-'hlola'. Nangabe simo siliciniso, ibuyisa linani le-'uma kuliciniso'; ngalokunye ibuyisa linani le-'uma kungemanga'.
blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_POWER: Buyisa inombolo yekucala lephakanyiswe emandleni enombolo yesibili.
blockly-MATH_ATAN2_TOOLTIP: Buyisa i-arctangent yelicophelo (X, Y) ngemadigri kusuka ku -180 kuya ku-180.
blockly-MATH_CONSTANT_TOOLTIP: Buyisa linye lemanani lajwayelekile langaguculuki: π (3.141…), e (2.718…), φ (1.618…), sqrt(2) (1.414…), sqrt(½) (0.707…), noma ∞ (lokungapheli).
blockly-MATH_CONSTRAIN_TOOLTIP: Vimbela inombolo kutsi ibe emkhatsini wemikhawulo leshiwo (kufaka nayo).
blockly-MATH_IS_TOOLTIP: Hlola nangabe inombolo ilingene, ayilingani, iyinhloko, iphelele, ingenhla kwa-0, ingentansi kwa-0, noma nangabe iyehlukaniseka ngenombolo letsite. Ibuyisa liciniso noma emanga.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_AVERAGE: Buyisa silinganiso (sibalo semkhatsini) semanani etinombolo eluhlwini.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MODE: Buyisa luhlu lwetintfo letivela kakhulu eluhlwini.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_SUM: Buyisa sibalo sato tonkhe tinombolo eluhlwini.
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Buyisa inhlamvana nje emkhatsini wa-0.0 (kufaka nayo) na-1.0 (ngaphandle kwayo).
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TITLE: inombolo lephelele nje kusuka ku-%1 kuya ku-%2
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Buyisa inombolo lephelele nje emkhatsini wemikhawulo lemibili leshiwo, kufaka nayo.
blockly-MINIMAP_ARIA_LABEL: Libalave lelincane lendzawo yekusebentela. Sebentisa tinkinobho temicibisholo kuhambisa indzawo yekusebentela.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALLRETURN_TOOLTIP: Sebentisa sento lesichazwe ngumsebentisi '%1' bese usebentisa umphumela waso.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Angeke ukhone kusebentisa sento lesichazwe ngumsebentisi '%1' ngobe libhulokhi lencazelo livaliwe.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_TOOLTIP: Uma linani liliciniso, buyisa linani lesibili.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Secwayiso: Lelibhulokhi lingasetjentiswa ngekhatsi kwencazelo yesento kuphela.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Engeta, susa, noma uhlele kabusha lokufakwako kulesento.
blockly-RENAME_VARIABLE_TITLE: Shintja libito lako konkhe lokuguculukako '%1' kube:
blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Sebentisa tinkinobho temicibisholo kuhamba. Cindzetela %1 kuvula noma kuvala indlela yesifundzi sesikrini.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Indlela yesifundzi sesikrini ivaliwe, cindzetela %1 kuyivula
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_ENABLED: Indlela yesifundzi sesikrini ivuliwe, cindzetela %1 kuyivala
blockly-SHORTCUTS_TOGGLE_SCREENREADER_MO: Vula noma uvale indlela yesifundzi sesikrini
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Bala kutsi umbhalo lotsite uvela kangakhi ngekhatsi kwalomunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Engeta, susa, noma uhlele kabusha tigaba kute uhlele kabusha lelibhulokhi lembhalo.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FIRST: tfola incenye yembhalo kusuka eluhlamvini lwekucala
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: tfola incenye yembhalo kusuka eluhlamvini # kusuka ekugcineni
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa indzawo yekuvela kwekucala/kwekugcina kwembhalo wekucala embhalweni wesibili. Ibuyisa %1 nangabe umbhalo ungatfolakali.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa liciniso nangabe umbhalo lonikiwe ungenalutfo.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Yakha incenye yembhalo ngekuhlanganisa nanoma ngutiphi tintfo.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa linani letinhlamvu (kufaka netikhala) embhalweni lonikiwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Phrinta umbhalo loshiwo, inombolo noma lelinye linani.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Shintjanisa konkhe kuvela kwembhalo lotsite ngekhatsi kwalomunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Buyisa likhophi lembhalo lesusiwe tikhala kulolunye noma kuto tombili tinhlangotsi.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Lokuguculukako lokubitwa ngekutsi '%1' sekuvele kukhona ngalolunye luhlobo: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Lokuguculukako lokubitwa ngekutsi '%1' sekuvele kukhona njengepharamitha esentweni '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Sesha indzawo yekusebentela. Cindzetela Enter kute utfole lokufananako lokulandzelako, Shift+Enter kute utfole langaphambili. Cindzetela Escape kuvala kusesha bese ugcila kulokufananako kwamanje.
r-blocks-help: Hlanganisa sicalisi sinye nesento sinye. Hudvula emabhulokhi ebhokisini lemathulusi. Sebentisa sihleli selifomu kutfola letinye tindlela letetfukile.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yemtsetfo ayitfolakali. Sebentisa sihleli selifomu kubuketa lomtsetfo.
r-blocks-invalid: Hlanganisa sicalisi sinye kuphela nesento sinye. Susa emabhulokhi langakahlanganiswa noma lengetiwe ngaphambi kwekugcina.
r-blocks-conflict: Lomtsetfo ushintjile ngesikhatsi usahlela. Layisha kabusha umtsetfo logciniwe ngaphambi kwekugcina.
r-blocks-permission: Imvume yemphatsi welibhodi iyadzingeka kute uhlele imitsetfo.
scrum-releases-select-help: Likhadi lingaba kulokukhishwa lokunyenti. Bamba Ctrl (Cmd ku-Mac) kute ukhetse lokungetulu kwalokunye; kusule konkhe kute ususe likhadi kuko konkhe lokukhishwa.
scrum-select-sprint: Khetsa i-sprint kute ubuke umbiko wayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Hlela umsebenti ngelizinga lalokulindzile. Nika emakhadi ku-sprint lehleliwe noma lesebentako.
scrum-report-help: Imibiko igcina kulinganisa kusuka etitfombeni te-sprint. Kulinganisa lokungatiwa kubalwa ngalokwehlukile; akusiko kulinganisa kwa-0. Catsanisa lijubane kuphela emkhatsini wetinani tekulinganisa nemigomo lefananako.
scrum-total: Emakhadi langu-__count__; langu-__estimate__ alinganisiwe; langu-__unknown__ akatiwa
scrum-confirm-close: Vala lena sprint bese ugcina imiphumela yayo? Emakhadi langakapheli atawuya endzaweni lekhetsiwe.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela lena sprint? Emakhadi ayo agcina bulunga bawo kuze kube kunikwa kabusha.
scrum-partial-report: Umbiko lophelele kancane: kufakwe emakhadi lonikwe wona nyalo kuphela.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Lena sprint inencenye kuphela yesitfombe sekucala.
scrum-history-job-running: Kubuyiselwa emuva nobe kwentiwa kabusha lushintjo lolukhulu: __done__ emigceni yemlandvo lengu-__total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Kubuyisela emuva nobe kwenta kabusha lushintjo lolukhulu kumile. Cindzetela futsi buyisela emuva nobe yenta kabusha kute uchubeke:
scrum-daily-observations-help: Libha ngalinye likhombisa lokubonakele kwekucala lokubhalwe kulilanga le-UTC, ngesikhatsi lesikhonjisiwe. Emalanga langekho ayayekelwa. Loku lokubonakele akubhali konkhe kushintja noma kukhombise emanani ekuphela kwelilanga. Kulinganisa lokungatiwa akusiko 0. Sebentisa sento sekuTfumela salesigaba kutfumela lokubonakele kwamalanga onkhe; sento sekuTfumela selibha lemathulusi sitfumela imiphumela ye-sprint.
scrum-daily-empty: Kute lokubonakele kwamalanga onkhe lokubhaliwe kulena sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Bubanti bemsebenti nemsebenti losele, lushintjo ngalunye
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe kabusha ngemlandvo welibhodi kusukela ekucaleni kwesikhatsi semsebenti: umugca munye ngelushintjo ngalunye kumakhadi esikhatsi semsebenti, etilinganisweni nobe emsebentini lophelile.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Umlandvo awuphindzi wakhe sitfombe sesimo salesikhatsi semsebenti ngekwaso: letinye tingucuko tentiwa ngaphandle kwekubhalwa emlandvweni, ngako lamanani akapheleli.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kufundzeke tingucuko tekucala kuphela; kwakha kabusha akukapheleli.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Kute tingucuko kusukela ekucaleni kwesikhatsi semsebenti.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Likhadi ligcinwe endzaweni yekulondvolota nobe libuyiselwe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Lokubonakele kwekucala lokubhalwe kulilanga ngalinye le-UTC; emalanga langekho ayayekelwa. Lokubonakele akubhali konkhe kushintja noma emanani ekuphela kwelilanga. Kulinganisa lokungatiwa akusiko 0.
scrum-import-pending: Kungenisa kwe-Scrum akukapheli. Kuhlela kwe-Scrum nekutfumela imibiko akutfolakali.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kungenisa lokuphazanyiswe kucala kabusha kungacedzelwa lapha nasekumile. Nangabe luhlelo lwekungenisa lungakagcinwa luphelele, kungakhanselwa kuphela; loku akuguculi lutfo ebhodini.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetsa kutfumela kwelibhodi la-WeKan noma lifayela lekudlulisa le-Scrum. Ema-sprint nekukhishwa lelibhodi lelinako kuyahlanganiswa, akuphindvwa. Emakhadi afaniswa nge-ID, noma ngenombolo yelikhadi nesihloko; emakhadi langafani ayabhalwa ashiywe angashintjwa. Buka kuqala kute ubone kutsi yini letawushintja.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ema-sprint: lamasha langu-__created__, langu-__matched__ sekavele akulelibhodi, langu-__skipped__ angakangeniswa
scrum-import-preview-releases: Kukhishwa: lokusha lokungu-__created__, lokungu-__matched__ sekuvele kukulelibhodi, lokungu-__skipped__ akukangeniswa
scrum-import-preview-cards: Emakhadi: langu-__updated__ atawubuyeketwa, langu-__unchanged__ angashintjwa, langu-__unmatched__ angafaniswanga
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Kute lokufanele kushintjwe: lelibhodi selivele linalokuhlela.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Kuhlela kwe-Scrum kungenisiwe futsi kwabhalwa eMlandvweni.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Likhadi lifanana nemakhadi langetulu kwalinye kulelibhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Likhadi lingelalelinye libhodi futsi lashiywa lingashintjwa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint noma kukhishwa kufanana nalokungetulu kwalokunye kulelibhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, kukhishwa noma umcimbi akukhonanga kungeniswa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Khetsa linani kulokungavumelani ngakunye. Kuvumelanisa kuyaphindza emva kwekukhetsa ngakunye. Kute lokutfunyelwa ehlelweni lemtfombo.
sync-conflict-refresh: Phindza uvumelanise kute ubuketa emanani alamuhla.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Emakhadi lonikwe wona abuketiwe. Kute kungavumelani kwetindzawo lokusele. Kuvumelanisa kweluhlu lonkhe akwentiwanga.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Susa kuhlanganisa kwekuvumelanisa kwalelikhophi kuphela. Lokukulo kuhlala ku-WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Kuyisa Engobolweni kuvinjelwe ngemakhadi lamancane lasebentako
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Intfo yemtfombo ayisekho, kodvwa emakhadi lamancane lasebentako avimbela kuyisa Engobolweni. Gcina lelikhadi lapha ngekususa kuhlanganisa kwalo kwekuvumelanisa. Emakhadi lamancane akashintjwa.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gcina likhadi langaphambili lingashintjwa bese wakha likhadi lelisha lekuvumelanisa kulolu luhlu. Kuphindza kusebentisa futsi lelingena esikhundleni.
sync-preview-saved: Kusekelwe etilungiselelweni letigciniwe. Kuvumelanisa nyalo kulanda futsi kuhlole umtfombo kabusha.
sync-preview-unavailable: Gcina umtfombo wekuvumelanisa ngaphambi kwekucela kubuka kuqala.
sync-preview-blocked: Lungisa kungavumelani lokungentansi ngaphambi kwekubuketa luhlelo lwekushintja.
sync-preview-scope: Emanani asho tindzawo temtfombo letilungisiwe. Leminye idatha ingayekelwa sihlatiyi semtfombo.
sync-source-scope: Tindlela tihlanganisa kuvela kwetindzawo kuto tonkhe tintfo temtfombo. Tintfo letingakahlanganiswa tibikwa tonkhe; emanani ato akakhonjiswa.
sync-source-truncated: Umbiko ukhawulelwe etindleleni leti-100 nakumabito etindzawo lafinyetiwe.
sync-report-retention: Kusebenta kwakamuva lokungu-20. Imibiko igcinwa emalanga langu-30.
sync-report-partial: Kusebenta lokwehlulekile noma lokungakapheli kungahle kushintje emakhadi lambalwa. Lemibiko ayichubeki noma ibuyisele emuva kusebenta.
sync-report-unavailable: Imibiko yekusebenta idzinga imvume yekubhala eluhlwini lonkhe kanye neseva lekhona.
sync-recovery-description: Imibiko yekuvumelanisa legcinwe emalangeni langu-30 langaphambili. Sesha nge-ID yelibhodi noma yeluhlu. Umphumela longakapheli ungahle usachubeka noma uphatamisiwe. Vuselela kute uhlole futsi; lemibiko ayikhoni kuchubeka noma kubuyisela emuva kushintja.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Akukhonakali kufundza kuhlola kwekuvumelanisa. Hlola imvume yemlawuli nekutfolakala kweseva.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Khetsa indzawo yetinombolo lene-ID yendzawo ya-Jira kanye nelunani lwekulinganisa, njengobe yakhiwe kungenisa kwa-Jira lokuhlanganisiwe. Kushintja kwalapha kubuketwa njengekungavumelani. Emanani emtfombo langekho ayanganakwa; i-null lecacile isula linani lelihlanganisiwe.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Sisindvo nobe silinganiso sesikhatsi se-GitLab sibhalwa endzaweni yetinombolo loyikhetsako. Tingucuko talapha tibuyeketwa njengetingcabano; indzaba lengenasisindvo isula linani lelichunyiwe.
email-recovery-description: Umugca munye wememukeli ngamunye. Sesha nge-ID yemsebentisi. Lokucuketfwe ngumlayeto netinkhundla te-imeyili tememukeli akukhonjiswa. Kumisa kwesikhashana kubamba imilayeto lekhona naletako; Kuchubeka kutama futsi kutfumela imilayeto leseluhlwini nyalo. Kukhansela kususa imilayeto lefakwe eluhlwini kuze kube sikhatsi sesicelo. Nangabe kutfumela kumatasa, tama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana. Umlayeto losewucalile kutfunyelwa awukwati kubuyiswa, futsi kutfumela lokunemphumela longacinisekile kungaphindvwa. Kwehluleka lokungapheli nemilayeto lefinyelele emkhawulweni wekutama futsi kusala kute kuhlolwe. Kutama futsi imilayeto leyehlulekile kucala umjikeleto lomusha wemetamo futsi kugcina kumiswa kwesikhashana lokukhona.
email-recovery-empty: Ayikho imilayeto eluhlwini futsi abekho bemukeli labamiselwe kutfumela kwesikhashana.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwati kufundvwa luhlu lwema-imeyili. Hlola emalungelo emphatsi nekutfolakala kweseva.
email-recovery-busy: Kutfumela nobe lomunye umsebenti weluhlu uyachubeka. Vuselela bese utama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenti awukwazanga kucinisekiswa. Vuselela luhlu bese utama futsi sento lesifanako nangabe kudzingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Sento lesisha semsebentisi lophetse sitsatse indzawo yalesicelo. Kukhonjiswa simo sanyalo seluhlu.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonkhe imilayeto leseluhlwini nyalo yalomemukeli? Lokucuketfwe kuyo kutawususwa futsi ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayeto lemisha leyentiwe ngemuva kwalesicelo itawugcinwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kulethwa akukhonanga kucinisekiswa; buketa ngaphambi kwekuphindza
sync-time-estimate-hint: Kulinganisa kwesikhatsi kusebentisa tindzawo tetinombolo tesikhatsi sekucala/lesisele letakhiwe kungenisa kwa-Jira. Kufanele kube nendzawo yinye kuphela lefananako kulelibhodi. Kuhlela kwalapha kubuketwa njengekungavumelani; emanani emtfombo langekho ayanganakwa kantsi i-null lecacile isula linani.
sync-planning-hint: I-sprint nekukhishwa kuvumelaniswa kuphela nangabe i-Scrum ivuliwe kulelibhodi. I-sprint noma kukhishwa lokungekho kwakhiwa kulelibhodi, ngemalanga lanikwa ngumtfombo; lokukhona kufaniswa nge-ID yemtfombo kuqala, bese kuba ngelibito. Kushintja kwekuhlela kwalapha kuhlala kuze umtfombo ushintje kuhlela kwaleyo nkinga, futsi kuvumelanisa kwekucala akukususi kuhlela.
activity-recovery-description: Tatiso letingakapheli tiphindvwa ngekutenta. Buketa imisebenti lengekho noma leshintjile ngaphambi kwekuphindza. Kuphindza akusoze kwakha kabusha umsebenti.
activity-recovery-busy: Lomunye umsebenti uphatse lesatiso. Vuselela bese uzama futsi.
activity-recovery-denied: Kufinyelela kwalowemukelako noma tintfo latitsandzako tetatiso akusakuvumeli kulethwa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenti wekucala awukho noma ushintjile. Kute lokwakhiwe kabusha.
activity-recovery-failed: Akukhonakalanga kucedza kulethwa kwetatiso. Umsebenti lolindzile ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Lesatiso sishintjile selokhu salayishwa. Buketa simo lesivuselelwe ngaphambi kwekuzama futsi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Akukhonakalanga kucinisekisa silungiselelo sekulethwa. Vuselela bese ubuketa simo saso salamuhla.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela unomphela kulethwa lokusele kwalomsebenti? Loku angeke kuchubekiswe. Ema-imeyili lasemugceni netatiso letilethiwe akubuyiswa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Buyeketa imitamo lebhaliwe yekutfumela ema-imeyili emitsetfo. Imitamo lengakacinisekiswa ingahle isatfumela noma iphazamisekile. Lombiko awuphindzi utfumele futsi awukukhanseli kutfumela.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Kute imitamo yekutfumela ema-imeyili emitsetfo lehambisana nalolusesho.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Akukhonakalanga kulayisha kuzama kwe-imeyili yemtsetfo. Vuselela kute uzame futsi.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: I-WeKan ayiphindzi itfumele yona yodvwa i-imeyili lengakacinisekiswa. Kutfumela futsi kuya kuphela kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa. Yimake njengaletfunyelwe nangabe wati kutsi ifikile, noma ukhansele kutfumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kutfumela kwekucala kungenteka kusachubeka. Ungancuma ngemuva kwa-__time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Tfumela le-imeyili futsi kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa? Noma ngubani iseva yakhe yemeyili leyemukele umlayeto ingakatjeli i-WeKan utawutfola kabili.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maka le-imeyili njengaletfunyelwe kubo bonkhe? Yenta loku kuphela nangabe wati kutsi ifikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela kutfumela le-imeyili? Ngeke itfunyelwe kulabamukelako labangakacinisekiswa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kutfumela kwekucala kungenteka kusachubeka. Yetama futsi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kutfumela futsi kwangaphambili kungenteka kusachubeka. Yetama futsi kamuva.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Bonkhe labamukelako sebacinisekisiwe. Esikhundleni sekuyitfumela futsi, yimake njengaletfunyelwe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iseva yemeyili ayiphendvulanga. Umlayeto lotfunyelwe futsi kungenteka ufikile noma awukafiki; ukhonjiswa njengalokuchubekako.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Lomunye umphatsi uxazulula le-imeyili. Yetama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: I-imeyili legciniwe ayisahambisani nalomtamo, ngako ayikwati kuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Lirekhodi leligciniwe lalomtamo alivumelekile, ngako awukwati kuxazululwa lapha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Le-imeyili ayikwazanga kuxazululwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
rule-email-legacy-description: Lama-imeyili emitsetfo alungiswa yinguqulo yangaphambili ye-WeKan lebeyingabhali kutsi lokucuketfwe kuwo kuvelaphi, ngako i-WeKan ngeke iwatfumele yona yodvwa. Ngemuva kwekuhlola kutsi umbhali wemtsetfo usenalo lilungelo lekufinyelela, xhumanisa i-imeyili futsi kute ilungiswe ngekwesimo sanyalo selikhadi, noma uyilahle.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lungisa le-imeyili futsi ngekwesimo sanyalo selikhadi? Lokucuketfwe kuyo kungahluka kuloko lokwalungiswa ngaphambili.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Akukwazanga kulayishwa ema-imeyili emitsetfo lalindzele kubuyeketwa. Vuselela likhasi kute uyetame futsi.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Umbhali wemtsetfo akasenalo lilungelo lekufinyelela kulelikhadi, noma umtsetfo ushintjile, ngako i-imeyili ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Sento lesibangele le-imeyili sishintjile, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Likhadi lekuvela kulo le-imeyili alisatfolakali, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Kusebenta kwemtsetfo lokulungise le-imeyili akusagciniwe, ngako ayikwati kuxhunyaniswa futsi. Ungayilahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Le-imeyili seyivele itfunyelwe, kwetanyiwe kuyitfumela, noma ilahliwe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Lesento asikwazanga kuphetfwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
stuck-sync-operation-description: Ngamunye walokuvumelanisa kweluhlu lokugciniwe kwema emkhatsini futsi akusakhoni kucedvwa, ngobe luhlu lwako lususiwe, lwakhiwe kabusha noma lwahlelwa kabusha, noma umsebentisi lowakucala walahlekelwa yimvume yekubhala. Ngesikhatsi kunye kusalindzile, lolo luhlu alukhoni kuvumelanisa. Kulahle kute luhlu luphindze luvumelanise: kushintja lokusentiwe kuyahlala, kushintja lokusele lokugciniwe akusoze kwabhalwa, futsi kuvumelanisa lokulandzelako kucatsanisa luhlu nemtfombo walo futsi.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Luhlu lususiwe, lwakhiwe kabusha noma tilungiselelo talo tekuvumelanisa tishintjile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Umsebentisi lowakucala akasenayo imvume yekubhala eluhlwini lonkhe
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Kugcinwe yinguculo yakadzeni ya-WeKan ngaphandle kwalokwakucala
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Kungaphindvwa nyalo futsi kutawuphela ngekwako, ngako angeke kulahlwe.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lahla lokuvumelanisa kweluhlu lokugciniwe? Kushintja lokusentiwe kuyahlala; lokusele akusoze kwabhalwa. Luhlu lungabe seluyavumelanisa futsi.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Kukhonjiswa lokudzala kakhulu lokungu-50 kuphela. Lahla lokutsite bese uvuselela kute ubone lokunyenti.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Akukhonakalanga kulayisha kuvumelanisa kweluhlu. Vuselela kute uzame futsi.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Lomsebenti awukatfolakali ubambekile, ngako angeke ulahlwe.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Lomsebenti ungaphindvwa nyalo futsi utawuphela ngekwawo, ngako awukalahlwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Lolu luhlu luyavumelanisa nyalo. Zama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Lesento asikwazanga kuphetfwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
interrupted-import-description: Ngamunye walokungenisa kwemabhodi kwema emkhatsini - iseva yaphindza yacala, noma kungenisa kwehluleka - kwashiya libhodi lelingakapheli. Kungenisa angeke kuchubekiswe, ngobe lifayela lemtfombo walo aligcinwa. Gcina libhodi njengobe linjalo, noma ulilahle bese uphindza ungenisa lifayela. Kulahla kususa libhodi lelakhiwe ngulokungenisa kanye nako konkhe lokukulo, kufaka nalokungetwe kulo kusukela lapho.
interrupted-import-scrum: Sigaba saso se-Scrum sinendzawo yaso yekuhlola (__state__, __next__ ku-__total__ tinyatselo). Nawugcina libhodi, sicedze noma usilahle ekubuyiseleni kwekungenisa kwe-Scrum kwelibhodi.
interrupted-import-counts: Imizila lengu-__swimlanes__, luhlu lu-__lists__, emakhadi langu-__cards__, luhlu lwekuhlola lu-__checklists__, imibono lengu-__comments__, lokunamatselwe lokungu-__attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gcina lelibhodi lelingakapheli njengobe linjalo? Kute lokususwako, futsi kungenisa akusabhalwa lapha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lahla lokungenisa? Libhodi lelakhiwe nako konkhe lokukulo kususwa unomphela.
interrupted-import-empty: Kute kungenisa kwemabhodi lokuphatamisiwe lokulindze kubuketwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Kukhonjiswa lokudzala kakhulu lokungu-50 kuphela. Gcina noma ulahle lokutsite bese uvuselela kute ubone lokunyenti.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Akukhonakalanga kulayisha kungenisa kwemabhodi lokuphatamisiwe. Vuselela kute uzame futsi.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Libhodi lalesi-id alikakhiwa ngulokungenisa, ngako alikatsintfwa.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Sigaba saso se-Scrum sisabhalwa noma sibuyiselwa. Zama futsi ngemuva kwemaminitsi lambalwa.
interrupted-import-failed: Lesento asikwazanga kuphetfwa. Vuselela likhasi bese uyetama futsi.
saml-login-not-started: Lokungena nge-SAML akukacaliswa kule thebhu yesiphequluli. Sicela ungene futsi.
history-request-pending-undo: Iseva ayikakucinisekisi kuhlehlisa kwakho lushintjo lwekugcina.
history-request-pending-redo: Iseva ayikakucinisekisi kuphindza wente lushintjo lwakho lwekugcina.
history-request-hint: Kwetama futsi kuphindza sicelo lesifanako, ngako angeke kuhlehlise lushintjo lwesibili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Kubuyisela emuva, kuphindza noma kubuyisela kwekushintja kwe-Scrum kwema ngenca yekungavumelani. Kuhlela kwe-Scrum kulelibhodi kuvinjelwe kuze kulungiswe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Kushintja lokungu-__applied__ ku-__total__ kubhaliwe, lokungu-__pending__ akukabhalwa, kantsi lokungu-__conflicted__ kushintjwe ngulomunye selokhu.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Kubuyisela emuva kubuyisela onkhe emarekhodi lashintjile njengobe abenjalo ngaphambili; kunikwa kuphela nangabe kute lomunye loshintje lawo marekhodi selokhu. Kugcina libhodi njengobe linjalo kususa umsebenti lowemile futsi akushintji marekhodi. Noma ngukuphi, kubhalwa ku-Iphaneli yemlawuli, Tinkinga, Kubuyisela.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gcina onkhe emarekhodi njengobe anjalo nyalo, kufaka nekushintja lokusabhalwe ngumsebenti lowemile?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umphatsi welibhodi angakubuyisela emuva noma agcine libhodi njengobe linjalo.
login-setting-after-restart: Kucala kusebenta ngemuva kwekutsi i-WeKan icaliswe kabusha
login-setting-env-only: Tisetwa yindzawo yeseva kuphela. Tikhonjiswa lapha ngekufundza kuphela.
email-to-card-description: I-imeyili letfunyelwe ekhelini lelibhodi lakho iba likhadi kulelo libhodi.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ye-webhook lengenako yemhlinzeki we-imeyili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark nobe i-MIME relay lengakalungiswa)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Libhodi lapho kuya khona i-imeyili yalesi-grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Lutfo - ema-imeyili kuphela lanelithokheni lelibhodi esihlokweni
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Faka loku esihlokweni kuze ufike kulelibhodi njengawe:
email-to-card-address-private: Lifihle: noma ngubani lonalo angengeta emakhadi njengawe.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Ucishe emakheli emabhodi akho ku-Tilungiselelo telilunga.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: I-grain ayikabi nelikheli layo le-imeyili. Phindze ulayishe likhasi.
inbound-account-invalid: Libhokisi leposi le-IMAP lidzinga ligama leseva lelivumelekile.
feature-views-email-desc: Libhodi njengelibhokisi leposi: luhla lwe-imeyili yi-Lokungenile, luhla ngemafolda, emalebula ngemalebula, futsi emalunga abhala aphendvule ema-imeyili ekhelini lelibhodi.
email-view-not-receiving: Lelibhodi alikemukeli ema-imeyili. Livule eTilungiselelo tetatiso telibhodi → I-imeyili iye kulikhadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Lelinye lemakheli akusilo likheli le-imeyili lelivumelekile.
email-view-too-many: Ema-imeyili lamanyenti kakhulu atfunyelwe ehoreni leliphelile. Phindze uzame ngemuva.
feature-views-chat-desc: Libhodi njengendzawo yengcoco: tindzawo temsebenti, emabhodi, imitsandvo, luhla nemakhadi njengesihlahla semachanela, likhadi emkhatsini nemibono yalo njengemilayeto yengcoco.
chat-view-pick-card: Khetsa likhadi emachaneleni kute ulibone lapha.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Emakhadi lafanako emacenjini lamanyenti emakholamu lanemagama - ngekuphela, ngekubaluleka, ngesigaba nobe nanobe yini - lahanjiswa emkhatsini wemakholamu ngekudvonsa.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Imenyu yelibhodi → Imitsetfo iphakamisa imitsetfo ngaloko bantfu labakwenta ngesandla kanyenti.
feature-board-summary-desc: Imenyu yelibhodi → Sifinyeto sikhombisa loko lokwentiwe ngumuntfu ngamunye ebhodini ngelilanga noma ngeliviki lekugcina, nalokwendlulelwe sikhatsi.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Imenyu yelibhodi → Kusukela ekuvakasheni kwakho kwekugcina kukhombisa loko labanye labakushintjile ebhodini.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kufuna konkhe kuyayicondza imisho lefana na "emakhadi ami lasendlulelwe sikhatsi".
column-sets-empty: Akukabi nemacembu emakholamu. Umphatsi welibhodi angenta linye: libite ngeligama, bese wengeta emakholamu alo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Libhodi njengesilandzeli setinkinga se-GitHub noma se-Gitea: emakhadi njengetinkinga, emalebula netinyatselo letimcoka, imibono njengengcoco, lokunamatsiselwe njengemafayela, nemlandvo welibhodi ngekubuyisela.
vcs-no-milestones: Akukabi khona tinyatselo letimcoka. Lilebula lelinelilanga lekuphela sinyatselo lesimcoka.
vcs-no-list: Lelibhodi alinalo luhlu noma umgudvu wenkinga.
card-qr-code-desc: Yiskena kute uvule lelikhadi efowunini noma kuthebulethi.
card-qr-code-too-long: Lilinki lalelikhadi lidze kakhulu kukhodi ye-QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Kute i-wiki kwanyalo. Kungeniswa kwenhlangano ye-GitHub kuletsa lapha i-wiki yendzawo yekugcina.
github-org-import-desc: Yonkhe indzawo yekugcina yenhlangano noma yemsebentisi iba libhodi layo, livulwe ku-Board View / Version Control: tinkinga tayo netimibono, emalebula nemafayela, lokukhishiwe kwayo, tinchubo temsebenti te-GitHub Actions njengemitsetfo, ne-wiki yayo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Liyadzingeka etindzaweni tekugcina letiyimfihlo nemkhawulo we-API lophakeme. Lisetjentiswa kuphela nakusangeniswa futsi alikaze ligcinwe.
github-org-import-result: Tinkinga letingu-%s, lokukhishiwe lokungu-%s, imitsetfo lengu-%s, emakhasi e-wiki langu-%s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Bhala libito lenhlangano noma lemsebentisi, noma likheli layo le-GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: Ema-REST API lanesimo sema-API etilandzeli letinye, kute ema-app nema-script ato kusebentise le-WeKan njengesisekelo sato: loko lokugcinwa ngito kugcinwa ku-WeKan, emabhodini e-WeKan. Ngayinye icishiwe kuze kube ikhetfwa lapha. Kute leneligunya layo: likhasimende lingena nge-token ye-API ye-WeKan futsi lingabona liphindze lishintje kuphela loko lowo muntfu langakubona akushintje ku-WeKan. Tonkhe tidzinga kutsi i-REST API ye-WeKan ivulwe (WITH_API=true). Likheli langaphansi kwayinye ngulelo lelisetjentiswa likhasimende njengeseva yalo.
optional-api-trello-desc: Ema-app nema-script lalotselwe i-REST API ye-Trello (sibonelo Trellinator) asebenta ne-WeKan: emabhodi, tinhla, emakhadi, emalebula, emalunga, imibono netinhla tekuhlola. I-token ye-Trello yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan. Kususa likhadi kulisa esigcinweni ku-WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Emakhasimende e-REST API v2 ye-Jira asebenta ne-WeKan: liphrojekthi libhodi (sikhiya salo sikhiya selibhodi), inkinga likhadi (DEV-7), simo luhla, kantsi kudlula kuhambisa likhadi. Kusesha kwemukela i-JQL lelula: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Ngena nge-token ye-API ye-WeKan njengeliphasiwedi. Kususa inkinga kuyisa esigcinweni.
optional-api-github-desc: Emakhasimende e-REST API ye-GitHub yetinkinga asebenta ne-WeKan: indzawo yekugcina libhodi, inkinga likhadi, nemalebula, tinyatselo letimcoka (emalebula lanelilanga lekuphela), imibono, futsi kuvulekile noma kuvaliwe njengaku-Kubukwa Kwelibhodi / Kulawula Tinguculo. I-token yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Emakhasimende e-REST API ye-Gitea ne-Forgejo yetinkinga asebenta ne-WeKan, ngendlela lefanako ne-API levumelana ne-GitHub: indzawo yekugcina libhodi futsi inkinga likhadi. I-token yi-token ye-API ye-WeKan.
bots-none: Akukabi nemabhothi. Libhothi lisebenti eseva yakho - lomenteli we-AI, umsebenti we-CI, iskripthi - lolibhodi leliniketa emakhadi.
bot-option-not-found: Leyo mphendvulo ayisiyo lenye yaleto letaniketwa libhothi.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Ema-Webhook laphumako awekho emvumo yekufinyelela emakheli lasenethiwekhini ya-WeKan lucobo, kuze kungabi khona lotsite webhook yelibhodi kumsebenti wangekhatsi. Bhala lapha ema-host akulenethiwekhi lekuvunyelwe ema-webhook kutsi afinyelele kuwo - i-Node-RED, i-server yekucoca - linye kulayini ngamunye, njengelibito noma likheli, ne-port kuze kuvunyelwe leyo port kuphela. Kulite: kute. Baphatsi besayithi kuphela labangashintja lolu luhla.
account-webhook-desc: Likheli linye i-WeKan leyitjela lona nangabe lotsite angena noma kwentiwa i-akhawunti lensha. Kute lokutfunyelwako kuze kukhetfwe sehlakalo lesingentasi. Kuphetse sehlakalo, ligama lemsebentisi nesikhatsi; khetsa letinye tindzawo kuphela nangabe lowemukelako aticela.
account-webhook-field-ip: Likheli le-IP lapho kungena kuvela khona
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela tonkhe tatiso temsebenti letisalindzile letindzala kwendlula emalanga lamangakhi?
vcs-synced-from: Kuhlanganiswe kusuka ku-%s: kuvule futsi ukuvale lapho.
vcs-synced-issue: Lenkinga ihlanganisiwe: yivule futsi uyivale kulandzeleli wayo.
sync-write-back: Bhala tingucuko ubuyisele ku-GitLab: sihloko, inchazelo, imibono, kuvala nekuvula futsi
email-bounces-description: Loko WeKan lekwenta nema-imeyili labuyako: likheli lelibhalwe kabi, libhokisi leligcwele, imphendvulo yekungabi bikhona, sikhalo se-spam. Luhlobo ngalunye lunetento talo, letentiwa nalubuye kangako.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Likheli alikho: liphutsa lekubhala, i-akhawunti lesusiwe, sizinda lesingatiwa.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Kute kufike kwanyalo: libhokisi ligcwele, i-server imatasatasa. Lokunyenti lokulandzelanako kuphela kusho lokutsite.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Timphendvulo tekungabi sehhovisi, telikhefu nobe tesistimu yemathikithi. I-imeyili ifikile.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ku-Amazon SES, tfumela tatiso te-Bounce ne-Complaint, kanye nemtsetfo wekwemukela welikheli WeKan letfumela kulo, esihlokweni se-SNS, bese ubhalisa lelikheli kuso nge-HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ema-ARN etihloko te-SNS latakwemukelwa, linye kulayini ngamunye
email-bounces-stopped-only: Emakheli kuphela WeKan lengasatfumeli kuwo ema-imeyili
email-bounces-clear-hint: Khohlwa kubuya kwalelikheli bese uphindze utfumele kulo ema-imeyili
email-bounces-providers-description: Nangabe WeKan itfumela ngalomunye walemisebenti, wuvule, unike umsebenti lelikheli le-webhook kuticubuntu tawo tema-imeyili labuyile netikhalo te-spam, bese unamatsisela lapha sikhiya lesisayina ngaso, nobe liphasiwedi lolifake ekhelini njenge https://user:password@… nobe ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Umsebenti lovuliwe udzinga sikhiya sawo sekusayina nobe liphasiwedi.
activity-pub-enabled: Emabhodi emphakatsi ashicilela umsebenti wemakhadi awo ku-fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kuvaliwe ngekwendlela lejwayelekile. Nakuvuliwe, libhodi ngalinye lemphakatsi lingalandzelwa kusuka ku-Mastodon nakulamanye emasevha e-fediverse njenge @board-<id> kulikheli lalesi WeKan, futsi umsebenti lomusha wemakhadi ufika kubalandzeli balo. Kufundvwa kuphela: kute lokutfunyelwa lisevha le-fediverse lokuntjintja libhodi, futsi emabhodi langasese akashicilelwa nanini.
caldav-sync-desc: Ifaka emalanga ekugcina emakhadi alelibhodi elikhalendeni - Nextcloud Calendar nobe nguliphi nje likhalenda le-CalDAV. Lusuku lekugcina loluhanjiswe elikhalendeni lubuyela elikhadini. Sebentisa liphasiwedi leluhlelo lwekusebenta, hhayi lelakho.
caldav-invalid-url: Likheli lelikhalenda kufanele libe likheli le-http:// nobe le-https://, ngaphandle kwelibito lemsebentisi nobe liphasiwedi kulo.
caldav-not-linked: Gcina likheli lelikhalenda kucala bese uvula kuvumelanisa.
webdav-storage-description: Igcina lokunamatsiselwe kulifolda kulisevha le-WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud nobe lenye. Sebentisa liphasiwedi leluhlelo lwekusebenta lelentelwe WeKan. Lisevha lelikulinethiwekhi ya-WeKan ngekwayo lingasetjentiswa lapha, ngoba ngumlawuli wesayithi kuphela lobeka lelikheli.
sqrl-desc: Kuvaliwe ngalokumisiwe. Nakuvuliwe, likhasi lekungena linikela nge-SQRL, emalunga engeta kucala bunikhwe bawo be-SQRL kuTilungiselelo Telilunga. I-SQRL idzinga kutsi i-WeKan ibe kulikheli le-https://.
sqrl-scan: Skena ikhodi nge-app yakho ye-SQRL, nobe uvule likhasimende lakho le-SQRL kulelithulusi.
sqrl-expired: Lekhodi ye-SQRL sekuphelelwe sikhatsi. Cala kabusha.
sqrl-needs-https: I-SQRL idzinga kutsi i-WeKan ibe kulikheli le-https://.
sqrl-description: Ngena ngebunikhwe bakho be-SQRL esikhundleni seliphasiwedi. Bungete lapha kanye ngelikhasimende lakho le-SQRL; ungabesusa lapha nanoma nini.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kungena nge-SQRL kuvaliwe kule-akhawunti kusuka kulikhasimende lakho le-SQRL. Kuvule futsi lapho ngekhodi yakho yekutsakula.
sqrl-only-on: Likhasimende lakho le-SQRL likhiye le-akhawunti ku-SQRL kuphela: tonkhe letinye tindlela tekungena tiyaliwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Likhasimende lakho le-SQRL likhiye le-akhawunti ngalokucinile: kusetha kabusha liphasiwedi nekushintja i-imeyili kuyaliwa.
sqrl-hardlock: Le-akhawunti ikhiyelwe ku-SQRL: ayikwati kubuyiswa nome kushintjwa ngalenye indlela.
windows-sso-failed: Kungena nge-Windows kuhlulekile. I-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows ingahle ingavunyelwa lapha.
enrollment-password-instructions: Cinisekisa liphasiwedi lakho kute ucale. Loku akukungenisi. Sici lesisebenta lesikhona singeke sashintjwa lapha.
enrollment-setup-denied: Akukhoni kucala kulungiselela. Hlola imininingwane yakho nekutsi ngabe emakhodi asetjentiswa kanye asavuliwe yini.
enrollment-code-instructions: Sebentisa emakhodi lasekelwe esikhatsini: SHA1, tinombolo letisitfupha, imizuzwana lengu-30. Gcina imfihlo iyimfihlo. Loku kulungiselela kuphela emizuzwini lesihlanu.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Ikhodi yekucinisekisa sewuyisebentisile. Lindza ikhodi lensha ku-authenticator yakho ngaphambi kwekungena.
registration-first-admin: Le-akhawunti yekucala itawuba yi-Domain Global Admin.
auth-too-many-attempts: Kulinga kungena kunyenti kakhulu. Phindze ulinge ngemuva.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Ema-akhawunti e-Global Admin acaliswa lapha. Kubhalisa kwalabo bonkhe kuvaliwe.
expedite-limit: Likhadi linye kuphela lelivulekile lalibhodi lelingaba Lokusheshisako ngesikhatsi sinye.
list-policy-placeholder: Likhadi lingangena nini kulolu luhla, futsi liphela nini lapha?
commitment-point-hint: Kusukela kulolu luhla umsebenti uyatibophelelwa; luhla loluphambi kwalo kukhetsa.
person-wip-over: __user__ unemakhadi lavulekile langu-__count__; umkhawulo we-WIP kumuntu ngamunye ngu-__limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Inchubomgomo yeluhla ngalunye - nini likhadi lingangena futsi nini liphela lapho - esihlokweni seluhla. Iyavulwa elibhodini ngalinye ku-Tilungiselelo telibhodi / Luhla.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Luhla lapho umsebenti utibophelelwa khona, lolumakwe esihlokweni salo. Luyakhetfwa elibhodini ngalinye ku-Tilungiselelo telibhodi / Luhla.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Mangaki emakhadi lavulekile umuntu munye langawabamba elibhodini; likhadi lelivulekile lixwayisa ngabo bonkhe labeca umkhawulo. Kusetjwa elibhodini ngalinye ku-Tilungiselelo telibhodi / Luhla.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Umhlangano walamalanga onkhe kumenyu yelibhodi: emalunga elibhodi ngekulandzelana lokuhlanganisiwe, ngamunye anesikhatsi lesifanako. Uyacimwa kulelo nalelo libhodi ku-Tilungiselelo te-Scrum talo.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Libhodi lekubuka emuva kumenyu yelibhodi: libhodi lelisha lelimfihlo leneluhla Cala kwenta, Yekela kwenta, Chubeka wenta kanye Lokufanele kwentiwe. Liyacimwa kulelo nalelo libhodi ku-Tilungiselelo te-Scrum talo.
show-split-lists: Vumela luhla kutsi luhlukaniswe kube Kuyachubeka naKuphelile
feature-split-lists-desc: Luhla loluhlukaniswe kube Kuyachubeka naKuphelile: likhadi lelaphawulwa kutsi liphelile lapho liyalindza, lifiphele, kudonselwa eluhleni lolulandzelako, futsi sihloko seluhla sibala kokubili. Kuvunyelwa kulibhodi ngalinye ku-Tilungiselelo telibhodi / Luhla, bese kuvulwa kumenyu yaluhla ngalunye.
workload-intro: Ema-awa lalinganisiwe nemaphuzu etindzaba emakhadi labekelwe umuntfu ngamunye, liviki ngeliviki, kucatsaniswa nema-awa lanawo: sikhatsi sakhe semsebenti, kungabikhona kwakhe kanye nemaholide. Chofoza liviki kute ubone emakhadi alo.
workload-truncated: Kunyenti kakhulu kukhombisa kanye kanye: umbiko ukhombisa bantfu nemakhadi bekucala kuphela. Khetsa emaviki lambalwa nome emabhodi lambalwa.
workload-allocations-intro: Kutsi sikhatsi semuntfu lesingakanani siya ebhodini, nome ngutiphi tindzima libhodi letitidzinga ngaphambi kwekutsi kubekwe umuntfu.
workload-invalid-estimate: Kulinganisa kufanele kube emkhatsini wa 0 na 10000 wema-awa.
feature-workload-desc: Umtfwalo wemsebenti nemandla kumenyu yemsebentisi: ema-awa lalinganisiwe nemaphuzu etindzaba emakhadi emuntfu ngamunye, liviki ngeliviki, kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi sakhe semsebenti, kungabikhona kanye nemaholide, kanye nekwabiwa emabhodini netindzima tesikhashana.
billing-intro: Emabhodi longumphatsi wawo: sabelomali yawo, kutsi umsebenti wawo ubite malini nekutsi utawubita malini ngemanani ema-awa lowabekako, nema-invoyisi ema-awa lasetjentisiwe. Baphatsi belibhodi kuphela labakubonako loku.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h akunalo inani le-awa futsi akukabalwa. Beka inani lelibhodi noma labo bantfu.
feature-billing-desc: Sabelomali nekukhokhisa kumenyu yemsebentisi: sabelomali yelibhodi ngemali noma ngema-awa, emanani ema-awa, tindleko nesibikezelo semsebenti walo, nema-invoyisi ema-awa lakhokhiswako lasetjentisiwe. Baphatsi belibhodi kuphela labakubonako.
billing-include-undated: Faka sikhatsi lesabhalwa ngaphambi kwekugcinwa kwemalanga
billing-pay-by-scanning: Khokha ngekuskena nge-app yelibhange nobe yekukhokha
billing-reverse-charge: Kukhokhiswa lokubuyiselwe emuva: i-VAT ikhokhwa ngumtsengi
billing-undated-included: Kufaka ema-awa la-__hours__ labhalwa ngaphambi kwekugcinwa kwemalanga.
billing-field-promptpay-target: Inombolo yeselula, i-ID yesive nobe i-ID yesikhwama se-elektroniki
billing-field-proxy: Inombolo yeselula, i-UEN, i-FPS ID nobe i-imeyili
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h akunalo inani lekusebenta le-awa futsi akukho ekunaneni lekusebenta.
billing-bill-time: Khokhisa sikhatsi nge-awa (kucinyiwe: inani lelingagucuki, kukhokhiswa timali letibekiwe netindleko kuphela)
billing-fees-intro: Sigaba noma inani lelingagucuki likhokhiswa kanye, kusukela elangeni lalo; imali yenyanga nenyanga kusukela elangeni layo kuze kube sekugcineni kwayo.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h ilindze kuvunywa futsi ayikho kule-invoyisi.
billing-quotes-intro: Inani lelinikelwako libeka inani emsebentini losele - silinganiso salikhadi ngalinye lelivulekile kususwe sikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe - netimali letingakakhokhiswa.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Inani lelinikelwako lelemukelwe liba sabelomali selibhodi
workload-utilization-title: Ema-awa lakhokhiswako labhaliwe kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi semsebenti salamaviki
cloud-panel-settings-intro: Ku-domain ye Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin ugcina ema-domain emakhasimende, tidzingelo tawo temininingwane, i-DNS ye-CloudFlare kanye netindlela te-Caddy, futsi likhasimende ngalinye libona ema-invoyisi alo likhulume na-SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin ngumphatsi we-WeKan lokhona vele.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Likheli ema-domain lakhomba kulo (likheli le-IP nome libito le-host)
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: I-Caddy itfumela i-domain ye Cloud Panel kanye nayo yonkhe i-domain lehlanganyelwe ku-WeKan lena, nayo yonkhe i-domain lenesitsengelo sayo kusitsha sayo se-WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-upstream: Le WeKan, njengoba i-Caddy ifika kuyo (host:port)
cloud-panel-customers: Emakhasimende langena lapha (emabito ebasebentisi nome emakheli e-imeyili)
cloud-panel-test-ok: Kuchunyiwe: basebentisi labangu-__users__, emabhodi langu-__boards__, emakhadi langu-__cards__.
cloud-panel-import-files: Lokunamatsiselwe lokungu-__count__: kopisha nemafayela esitolo semafayela se-WeKan lendzala.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: I-Cloud Admin ikhona kuphela kulelikheli lelibizwa yi-CLOUD environment variable yeseva, kubalawuli bayo be-Cloud nakubathengi be-domain leyilandzelanisako.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Emakheli e-IPv4 ne-IPv6, nemikhawulo yemakheli lefana ne-203.0.113.0/24, lapho umlawuli we-Cloud angena khona. Linye ngemgca ngamunye. Ngekhasi: nanoma ngabe ngukuphi likheli.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Likheli lakho __address__ alikho kuleli luhlu. Kulilondvolota kungakuvala ngaphandle, ngako alilondvoloteki.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Emakheli e-IPv4 ne-IPv6 nemkhawulo wemakheli, linye emugceni ngamunye, lapho Iphaneli yemlawuli ne-admin REST API kungasetjentiswa khona. Kute lutfo: noma nguliphi likheli.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Lokugucukako kwesimo seseva ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ngiko lokunca sincumo, hhayi loluhlu.
admin-panel-address-refused: Iphaneli yemlawuli ayikwati kusetjentiswa kusuka ekhelini lakho __address__.
feature-views-website-desc: Libhodi njengewebhusayithi: emakhadi eluhlu lwalo Published, umtsandvo Pages njengemenyu nalamanye emakhadi njengetincwadzi, letinsha kucala, nalokunamatsiselwe kwato. Libhodi lakwemphakatsi lingavuleka kuloku, kuze tivakashi tibone iwebhusayithi ekhelini lelibhodi.
feature-views-shop-desc: Tintfo letitsengiswako letisemakhadini elibhodi njengesitolo se-inthanethi: likhadi lelinentsengo yintfo letsengiswako, emalebula alo ngemihlobo, kantsi i-oda likhadi lelisohlwini lwema-Oda. Libhodi lebantfu bonkhe lingavuleka kuko, kuze tivakashi titsenge ekhelini lelibhodi.
shop-sale-lists: Tinhla letitsengiswako (kute lokhetsiwe: tinhla tonkhe ngaphandle kwalohla lwema-Oda)
shop-category-labels: Emalebula lavetwa njengemihlobo (kute lokhetsiwe: onkhe emalebula)
shop-orders-private: Ema-oda abhalwa elibhodini lelimfihlo, ngobe libhodi lebantfu bonkhe likhombisa wonkhe umuntfu onkhe emakhadi.
shop-show-on-public: Khombisa Sitolo esikhundleni selibhodi lebantfu bonkhe
shop-show-on-public-note: Libhodi lebantfu bonkhe livuleka ngendlela yinye kuphela. Kukhetsa Sitolo lapha kungena esikhundleni sa __view__ kutivakashi, kantsi kukhetsa Iwebhusayithi nome lenye indlela ku-Tilungiselelo telibhodi / Kubukwa Kwelibhodi kungena esikhundleni seSitolo.
shop-empty: Kute tintfo letitsengiswako okwamanje. Likhadi lelinentsengo eluhlwini lolutsengiswako yintfo letsengiswako.
shop-privacy-note: Libito lakho nemininingwane yekukutsintsa kubhalwa ku-oda kuze sitolo siyiletse, akubhalwa kulenye indzawo.
shop-price-changed: Intsengo ishintjile. Hlola inombolo lensha lephelele bese wenta i-oda futsi.
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Ku-WordPress, khetsa 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' na 'Download Export File', ukhetse lelifayela le-.xml lapha, noma unamatsisele umbhalo walo. I-Squarespace, i-Wix nalamanye emasayithi latfumela ngaphandle lifayela le-WordPress asebenta ngendlela lefanako. Likhasi ngalinye nencwadzi ngayinye kuba likhadi eluhlwini lwesimo salo, emakhasi emtsandvweni Pages netincwadzi ku-Posts, nalokucuketfwe kwalo, tigaba nema-tag njengemalebula, nemibono yalo levunyelwe.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Gcina tincwadzi nemakhasi e-WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts na /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) njengelifayela linye le-.json, ulikhetse lapha noma ulinamatsisele. Likhasi ngalinye nencwadzi ngayinye kuba likhadi eluhlwini lwesimo salo.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Ku-Ghost, khetsa 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', ukhetse lifayela le-.json lapha noma ulinamatsisele. Likhasi ngalinye nencwadzi ngayinye kuba likhadi eluhlwini lwesimo salo, nema-tag alo njengemalebula.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Ku-Blogger, khetsa 'Settings', 'Back up content', ukhetse lifayela le-.xml lapha noma unamatsisele umbhalo walo. Incwadzi ngayinye nelikhasi ngalinye kuba likhadi, lokungakapheli eluhlwini Draft, nemalebula alo nemibono.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Faka ku-.zip imitfombo yesayithi ye-Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro noma lenye isayithi lengashintji - emafayela e-Markdown nema-front matter awo, netitfombe tawo - ukhetse i-.zip lapha. Lifayela ngalinye le-Markdown liba likhadi: tincwadzi letivela kumafolda e-posts noma letinelilanga egameni lelifayela, lokunye kungemakhasi, lokungakapheli eluhlwini Draft, netitfombe lelitisebentisako njengalokunamatsiselwe kwalo.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Faka ku-.zip emafayela ewebhusayithi - emakhasi ayo e-.html netitfombe, njengoba agcinwe nge-wget noma nge-HTTrack, noma lokutfunyelwe ngaphandle yi-Medium - ukhetse i-.zip lapha. Likhasi ngalinye liba likhadi nembhalo walo lomkhulu, netitfombe lelitisebentisako njengalokunamatsiselwe; ema-script, emamenyu nemafomu kuyashiywa.
import-board-instruction-substack: Ku-Substack, khetsa 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', ukhetse i-.zip loyilandile lapha. Incwadzi ngayinye iba likhadi nembhalo wayo, leshicilelwe noma lengakapheli.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Imitsandvo yehlukanisa libhodi ibe ngemibhede levundlile, ngako ngulelo khadi lingelaluhla nalelomtsandvo. Umtsandvo ungamela licembu, umuntfu, likhasimende noma luhlobo lwemsebenti, kantsi tinhla tisolo tikhombisa tigaba temsebenti.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Chofoza + enhloko yemtsandvo, noma ukhetse Ngeta Umtsandvo kuyimenyu yawo, bhala libito bese ukhetsa kutsi uya etulu noma ngaphansi kwemtsandvo lokhetsiwe. Kunamatsisela imigca leminyenti kungadala umtsandvo munye ngemugca ngamunye. Chofoza libito kute ulishintje, sebentisa luphawu kute ugoce noma unwebe umtsandvo, dvonsa sibambo sawo kute uhlele kabusha imitsandvo, futsi udvonse umphetfo wawo wangaphansi kute ushintje budze bawo ngaphandle kwekutsi umlawuli welibhodi uvalile kushintja bukhulu.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Tinhla tingemakholamu labamba emakhadi. Elibhodini le-kanban luhla ngalunye lusigaba semsebenti, futsi likhadi lihamba lusuka eluhlwini liye kulolunye njengoba umsebenti uchubeka. Embonweni weMitsandvo luhla lungaba ngelemtsandvo munye.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza luphawu lwekungeta luhla ekugcineni kwesekudla kwenhloko yeluhla, noma Ngeta kuyimenyu yeluhla, bhala libito bese ukhetsa kutsi luta emva kwaluphi luhla; kunamatsisela imigca leminyenti kungadala luhla lunye ngemugca ngamunye. Chofoza sihloko seluhla kute usishintje, kantsi luphawu lwenhloko yalo lugoca noma lunwebe luhla kuwe wedvwa. Imenyu yeluhla futsi inekukopisha, kuhambisa nekuyisa esigcinweni, futsi ungadvonsa sibambo emkhatsini wetinhla kute ushintje bubanti bato uma kuvunyelwe.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Umbono weLithebula ukhombisa emakhadi elibhodi njengelithebula lelifana nelispredishithi, umugca munye ngelikhadi ngalinye, nekuluhla lwalo, umtsandvo, bantfu, emalebula netinsuku. Uyasita ekubukeni emakhadi lamanyenti kanyekanye nasekungeteni noma ekuhambiseni emakhadi ngaphandle kwekuwadvonsa etinhleni.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza inhloko yelikholamu kute uhlele, uphindze uyichofoze kute uphendvule luhlelo. Bhala ebhokisini lekusesha kute ufanise tihloko temakhadi, tinhla, imitsandvo nemalebula, bese usebentisa Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako kute uhambe emigceni lengu-25 ngesikhatsi. Inkinobho Hlela ivula likhadi ngetulu kwelithebula. Kusonga tihloko nekuhlela ngemtsandvo kushintja kuhleleka futsi kukhunjulwa kulesiphequluli. Emakhadi lasesigcinweni ashiywa ngaphandle, kantsi Hlunga lwelibha yasecaleni lunciphisa imigca.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Umbono weLikhalenda ubeka emakhadi elibhodi elikhalendeni ngetinsuku tawo: likhadi lelinelusuku lekucala nelekuphela liba libha emkhatsini wato, kantsi tinsuku talo tekwemukelwa, tekugcina netekuphela tiba ngetinto letitimele. Tintfo teluhla lwekuhlola letinetinsuku nato tiyavela.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Sebentisa Namuhla, Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako kute uhambe, bese ushintja emkhatsini welilanga, liviki nenyanga, ngamunye njengeligridi noma luhla. Dvonsa likhadi kute ulinike lusuku lekugcina lolusha, noma ulelule kute ushintje lusuku lwalo lwekuphela. Chofoza lilanga, noma udvonse emahoreni eligridini leliviki noma lelilanga, kute udale likhadi lelisha lelifanele kugcina ngaleso sikhatsi; liya emtsandvweni wekucala nasesluhlwini lwekucala lwelibhodi.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Indlela yeKhalenda ikhombisa ngulelo khadi ngelilanga lelusuku lwalo lwekugcina, nemalebula alo nesihloko sonkhe, eligridini lenyanga noma leliviki. Kubuka jikelele lokufundvwa kuphela kwalokufanele kugcina nini, lokufana nelikhalenda le-Trello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Sebentisa Namuhla, Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako kute uhambe ngenyanga noma ngeliviki, naLiviki noma Inyanga kute ushintje ligridi; lokukhetsile kukhunjulwa kulesiphequluli. Chofoza likhadi kute ulivule. Emakhadi lasesigcinweni ashiywa ngaphandle futsi Hlunga lwelibha yasecaleni luyasebenta. Kute ushintje tinsuku ngekudvonsa, sebentisa umbono weLikhalenda esikhundleni saloku.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Likhalenda Lemabhodi Lamanyenti likhombisa emakhadi lanetinsuku awo onkhe emabhodi lolilunga lawo elikhalendeni linye, ngako ungabona konkhe lokufanele kugcina kulelivi liviki nomakungaliphi libhodi. Intfo ngayinye icala ngesihloko selibhodi layo emabakaksini.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Livule kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi kunoma nguliphi libhodi bese ulindza kuze kulayishwe emakhadi awo onkhe emabhodi akho. Sebentisa Namuhla, Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako kanye nembono yelilanga, liviki nenyanga, ngamunye nawo njengeluhla. Tinsuku tekwemukelwa, tekugcina netekuphela titfola tintfo tato. Chofoza intfo kute uvule lelo khadi elibhodini lalo. Tinsuku atikwati kudvonswa lapha.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Umbono weSikhatsi uhlanganisa kulandzelela sikhatsi kwelibhodi endzaweni yinye: kutsi sikhatsi lesingakanani sisetjentisiwe, ngubani futsi kumaphi emakhadi, nekutsi kusele sikhatsi lesingakanani kuze kufike lusuku lwekugcina lwemakhadi. Sikhatsi sifakwa emakhadini ngekwawo; lombono uyabika nje kuphela.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Fundza sifinyeto sesikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe etulu, bese ufundza kwehlukaniswa ngalonikwe umsebenti nangelikhadi, nemakhadi ledlule sikhatsi aphawulwe. Ngaphansi kwaloko lushintjo ngalunye emahoreni labhaliwe elikhadi lubhalwa ngemuntfu lolwentile. Chofoza Tfumela kute ugcine umbiko njenge-PDF noma i-Excel. Emalunga lavunyelwe kubona emakhadi labanikwe wona kuphela atfola sifinyeto semakhadi awo, kantsi letinye tigaba tihlala tingenalutfo.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Umbono weMudlanko wesikhatsi ukhombisa libhodi njengoba belinjalo ngesikhatsi lesengcile, usebentisa umlandvo welibhodi. Ukusita kutsi ubone kutsi yini leshintjile futsi ubuyisele likhadi kutsi libe njengoba belinjalo.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Chofoza liphuzu emugceni kute ubone likhadi ngalinye njengoba belinjalo ngaleso sikhatsi, lihlelwe ngeluhla lwalo ngaleso sikhatsi, nesihloko salo, inchazelo, emalebula, emalunga nelusuku lwekugcina. Chofoza Nyalo kute ubuyele esikhatsini sanyalo. Elikhadini, Buyisela kulesi simo kubuyisela letinani emva kwekutsi uvumile. Kute lokususwako: kubuyisela kubhalwa njengemlandvo lomusha, futsi inkinobho ikhonjiswa kuphela kubantfu labangashintja lelo khadi.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Tibalo tikhombisa simo selibhodi ngekushesha: kutsi emakhadi alo alayishwa njani nekutsi linemitsandvo lemingakhi, tinhla, emakhadi, emakhadi lasesigcinweni, emalebula, emalunga netikhala takho.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Vula Tibalo eceleni leMbono jikelele kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi bese ufundza lithebula lesimo selibhodi. Kulayishwa kwemakhadi kusho kutsi lelibhodi lilayisha emakhadi labonakalako kuphela noma onkhe emakhadi, nekutsi loko kukhetfwe ngekutentekela yini kulibhodi lelikhulu. Tinombolo tibalwa kusevha, ngako tilungile ngisho nakulibhodi lelikhulu. Noma nguliphi linani lingakhetfwa likopishwe, futsi kuvula lombono akushintji lutfo.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Hlela ngalotfunywe kubeka ngulelo khadi ngaphansi kwemuntfu lonikwe lona, esikhundleni sekutsi kube ngaphansi kweluhla lwalo, ngako ungabona kutsi ngubani lonani ngaphandle kwekuvula luhla ngalunye. Kufanele umhlangano welicembu.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Kuvule kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi. Lonikwe umsebenti ngamunye utfola sigaba lesinemakhadi akhe, lusuku lwekugcina lapho lukhona kanye neliwashi uma likhadi lidlule sikhatsi; emakhadi langenalonikwe umsebenti angaphansi kwe-Akukho lonikwe umsebenti. Chofoza sihloko selikhadi kute uvule likhadi. Kuhlela kusebentisa sikhala selikhadi saLonikwe umsebenti, hhayi Emalunga alo. Bantfu labavunyelwe yindzima yabo kubona emakhadi labanikwe wona kuphela abatfoli idatha lapha.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Imibono ye-Gantt idweba emakhadi elibhodi elikhalendeni ngako ungabona kutsi yini lecalako, yini lefanele kugcina nekutsi yini lengenelana. I-Gantt lithebula lelinemugca munye ngelikhadi nelupawu ngelusuku ngalunye lwalo, kantsi i-Frappe Gantt ne-DHTMLX Gantt tidweba likhadi ngalinye njengelibha kusukela ekucaleni kuya ekupheleni.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Khetsa i-Gantt, i-Frappe Gantt noma i-DHTMLX Gantt eceleni leLikhalenda nesikhatsi kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi; emakhadi adzinga lokungenani lusuku lunye lwekwemukelwa, lwekucala, lwekugcina noma lwekuphela. Ku-Gantt, liviki ngalinye lelinetinsuku litfola lithebula lalo; chofoza libito lelikhadi kute uvule likhadi noma luphawu lwelusuku kute uhlele lolo lusuku. Ku-Frappe Gantt nase-DHTMLX Gantt, emalunga lanemvume yekubhala angadvonsa libha kute ahlele kabusha sikhatsi selikhadi.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Luhlu lwemsebenti lolulindzile lwemkhicito luhla lolulandzelanako lwemsebenti licembu le-Scrum lelingakawufaki ku-sprint. Lukhombisa emakhadi elibhodi langenayo i-sprint yanyalo, ahlelwe ngelizinga lekulindza, ngaphandle kwekuwasusa etinhleni tawo.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Tfola likhadi elithebuleni bese, eselini lalo leTento, ubeka i-Sprint yalo, lizinga lekulindza, kukhululwa, luhlobo lwemsebenti kanye nemibandzela yekwemukela, bese uchofoza Gcina. Emazinga lamancane eta kucala. Bamba Ctrl, noma Cmd ku-Mac, kute ufake likhadi ekukhululweni lokunyenti. Chofoza sihloko selikhadi kute uvule likhadi, naKhombisa lokunyenti kute ulayishe emakhadi langu-100 lalandzelako. Kuhlela kulandzela timvume temakhadi letijwayelekile.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: I-sprint sikhatsi lesifishane lesimisiwe lapho licembu le-Scrum liceda umsebenti lokhetsiwe libheke enhlosweni. Umbono wema-sprint ndzawo lapho ema-sprint elibhodi ahlelwa khona, acalwe, avalwe noma akhanselwe, kanye nekukhululwa kwalo nemicimbi ye-Scrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Umlawuli welibhodi ucala ngekuvula tilungiselelo te-Scrum, avule kuhlela kwe-Scrum bese akhetsa umtfombo wesilinganiso, iyunithi, umtsetfo wekuphotfula nemalanga ekusebenta. Bese udala i-sprint lehleliwe ngelibito, inhloso, kucala nekuphela, unikete emakhadi kuyo kusuka kuLuhlu lwemsebenti lolulindzile, bese uchofoza Cala i-sprint. Kute ucede, khetsa kutsi umsebenti longakapheli uyaphi bese uchofoza Vala i-sprint, noma unikete sizatfu bese uchofoza Khansela i-sprint. Balawuli belibhodi kuphela labaphatsa ema-sprint.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Umbiko we-sprint ulandzisa lokwentekile ku-sprint yinye levaliwe: lokwetsenjiswa, lokuphotfuliwe, lokungetiwe, lokususiwe nalokushiywe kungakapheli. Lijubane libala leyo miphumela ku-sprint ngayinye levaliwe, ngako i-sprint lelandzelako ingahlelwa ngalokwentiwa licembu ngempela.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: KuMbiko we-sprint, khetsa i-sprint bese ukhetsa Emakhadi noma Silinganiso ngetulu kwemabha, bese ufundza bubanti bemsebenti bemalanga nemsebenti losele kanye nemlandvo welushintjo ngalunye ngaphansi. KuLijubane, fundza umugca munye nge-sprint ngayinye levaliwe. Imiphumela ivela etitfombeni letitsatfwe ngesikhatsi i-sprint ngayinye icala nangesikhatsi ivalwa, ngako lushintjo lwesilinganiso lwakamuva alutibhali kabusha. Tfumela kugcina imiphumela njenge-PDF noma i-Excel, kantsi Vuselela kulayisha kabusha umbiko.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Lamashadi e-Scrum akhombisa inchubekelembili ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi. I-Burndown ikhombisa kutsi kusele umsebenti lomungakanani ngelilanga ngalinye kantsi i-Burnup kutsi lomungakanani wentiwe, Lijubane likhombisa kutsi i-sprint ngayinye levaliwe icede lokungakanani, i-Burndown yekukhishwa ilandzela umsebenti losele ekukhululweni, kantsi Inchubekelembili yemisebenti lemikhulu ikhombisa kutsi emakhadi labatali afike kuphi.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Khetsa lishadi ngaphansi kwe-Scrum kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi. Ngalinye lidwetjwa ngemakhadi nema-sprint elibhodi futsi likhombisa tinombolo elithebuleni ngaphansi kwelishadi. Lijubane lidzinga lokungenani i-sprint yinye levaliwe, futsi likuvumela kutsi ukhetse Emakhadi noma Silinganiso. Chofoza Tfumela etulu kute ugcine tinombolo letifanako njenge-PDF noma i-Excel. Lishadi lelingakabi nalutfo lwekudweba lisho kutsi Kute imiphumela.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Indlela Yekuya Embili ihlela emakhadi ngemigca ngelinani lesikhala sakho, njengekukhululwa noma umsebenti lomkhulu, bese idweba emakhadi emugca ngamunye emudlankweni wesikhatsi. Iyasita endleleni yekukhululwa noma yesihloko uma lokuhlela sekugcinwe esikhaleni sakho.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Libhodi lidzinga lokungenani sikhala sakho sinye sembhalo noma semenyu lehlayo. Khetsa sikhala kuHlela nga etulu; linani ngalinye litfola lishadi lalo lelincane le-Gantt lemakhadi alo, kantsi emakhadi langenalinani ahlelwa ngaphansi kwe-Kute linani. Emakhadi abekwa ngetinsuku tawo, ngako wanike tinsuku tekucala netekugcina kute uwabone emudlankweni wesikhatsi.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Lamashadi eMbono jikelele aphendvula kutsi libhodi limatasatasa kangakanani nekutsi umsebenti walo usabalele njani: Ibhodi lekulawula nekushaya kwenhlitiyo kufinyeta libhodi, Umtfwalo wemsebenti ukhombisa kutsi ngubani lonani, Kwabiwa kutsi emakhadi ahlukaniswe njani, Libalave lekuncika kutsi emakhadi avimbana noma ancikana njani, kantsi Libalave lekushisa kwemisebenti kutsi bantfu basebenta nini elibhodini.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Khetsa lishadi eceleni leMbono jikelele kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi. Likhasi ngalinye lidweba lishadi ngemakhadi nangemlandvo welibhodi futsi likhombise lithebula letinombolo lelingemuva kwalo. Chofoza Tfumela etulu kute ugcine idatha lefanako njenge-PDF noma i-Excel. Uma kute lutfo lwekudweba, lishadi lisho kutsi Kute imiphumela.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: I-Bigboard ibeka onkhe emabhodi lolilunga lawo elikhasini linye lelehlako, ngalinye netinhla nemakhadi alo, ngako ungasebenta kuwo onkhe emabhodi akho kanyekanye.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Vula i-Bigboard kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi bese ulindza kuze kulayishwe emakhadi alo lonkhe libhodi. Sigaba ngasinye selibhodi sisebenta njengelibhodi lelijwayelekile: dvonsa emakhadi emkhatsini wetinhla, vula emakhadi uphindze uhlele tinhla. Ungadvonsa futsi likhadi uliyise eluhlwini lwalelinye libhodi elikhasini, loku kulihambisela kulelo libhodi. Tinhla tingadvonswa kuphela ngekhatsi kwelibhodi lato. Chofoza sihloko selibhodi kute ulivule lodvwa.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Emashadi ekugeleta kweKanban akhombisa kutsi umsebenti uhamba njani elibhodini: kugeleta lokuhlangene, kulawula nesikhatsi somjikelezo, sikhatsi sekuletsa, kusebenta kahle kwekugeleta, umkhicito, i-WIP, umsebenti loguga, tivimbelo, kubikezela kutsi umsebenti utawuphela nini, kutiphatsa kwenchubo nekutsi tilinganiso letinkhulu titsatsa sikhatsi lesidze yini. Akusita kutsi utfole lapho umsebenti unwabeka khona nekutsi utsatsa sikhatsi lesingakanani ngempela.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Khetsa lishadi eceleni leKugeleta kweKanban kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi. Fundza linothi ngaphansi kwesihloko, lelisho kutsi likala njani, bese ufundza lishadi nelithebula ngaphansi kwalo. Lamanye emakhasi atsatsa tilungiselelo, njengemakhadi lahlosiwe nelusuku kuKubikezela kwe-Monte Carlo noma sikhala sebukhulu kuBukhulu bemsebenti uma kucatsaniswa neSikhatsi somjikelezo, letisetjentiswa nge-Sebentisa. Tfumela etulu igcina emathebula njenge-PDF noma i-Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Lemibiko ikhombisa kutsi umsebenti ugeleta njani elibhodini liviki ngeliviki: emakhadi ladalwe naladzeliwe, kugeleta lokuhlanzekile, kutsi emakhadi ahlala sikhatsi lesingakanani eluhlwini ngalunye, budzala lobuphakatsi bemakhadi lavulekile, umkhicito waliviki nekutsi tinsuku tekugcina tifinyelelwa kangakanani.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Khetsa umbiko eceleni leKugeleta kweKanban kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi: Lokwentiwe nalokuxazululiwe, Kugeleta lokuhlanzekile, Sikhatsi eluhlwini, Budzala lobuphakatsi, Lishadi lemkhicito ngesikhatsi noma Kugcinwa kwelusuku lekugcina. Ngamunye ukhombisa lishadi, kantsi ngaphansi kwalo lithebula letinombolo lelidwetjwe ngalo. Chofoza Tfumela etulu kute ugcine lelo thebula njenge-PDF noma i-Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Umbono weLibalave ukhombisa emakhadi elibhodi njengetimphawu esitfombeni umlawuli welibhodi lasilayisha, njengelipulani lesitezi noma libalave lendzawo. Kufanele umsebenti lowenteka etindzaweni, njengemakamelo, imishini noma tingcephe temhlaba.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Umlawuli welibhodi uchofoza Layisha sitfombe selibalave bese akhetsa lifayela le-PNG, JPEG, GIF noma WebP, futsi angalisusa ngemuva ngaphandle kwekulahlekelwa tindzawo temakhadi. Bantfu labangashintja libhodi babona emakhadi langakabi selibalaveni; dvonsa linye uliyise esitfombeni, noma ulikhetse bese uchofoza lapho lifanele khona, bese udvonsa luphawu kute ulihambise. Luphawu lutsatsa umbala welilebula lekucala lelikhadi, futsi kuluchofoza kuvula likhadi.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Umbono we-imeyili ukhombisa libhodi njengelibhokisi leposi: emakhadi angimilayeto, tinhla tingemafolda kantsi emalebula angemalebula. Ungabhala uphindze uphendvule ema-imeyili ngelikheli lelibhodi lelilalo, ngako timphendvulo tibuyela elibhodini njengemakhadi nemibono.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza Libhokisi lekwemukela, Lokutfunyelwe, Onkhe emaposi, luhla noma lilebula kute ukhetse lokukhonjiswako, bhala ebhokisini lekusesha kute unciphise imigca, bese uchofoza umugca kute uvule likhadi, lelinemibono lengiyo inkhulumo. Bhala ibhala i-imeyili lensha kantsi umcibisholo wekuphendvula uphendvula yinye, itfunyelwa ngelikheli lelibhodi. Libhodi kufanele licale lemukele i-imeyili, loku kuvulwa kuTilungiselelo Tetatiso telibhodi ngaphansi kwe-Imeyili kuya elikhadini.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Umbono weNgcoco ukhombisa libhodi njengendzawo yekusebentela yengcoco: likhadi ngalinye lelinenkhulumo lishaneli futsi imibono yalo ingimilayeto. Sihlahla semashaneli sifaka wonkhe libhodi longalibona, nenombolo yemilayeto longakayifundzi.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Vula indzawo yekusebentela nelibhodi kuMashaneli bese uchofoza likhadi; livuleka esigabeni lesisemkhatsini kantsi imilayeto yalo esigabeni sengcoco. Bhala umlayeto bese ucindzetela u-Enter noma uchofoze Tfumela; Shift+Enter icala umugca lomusha. Kute ucale inkhulumo elikhadini lelingenayo imilayeto, chofoza Khombisa onkhe emakhadi alelo libhodi bese ukhetsa likhadi. Tigaba tiyaphendvulwa tilimi letibhalwa kusukela kwesekudla kuya kwesancele.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Umbono weKulawula Tinguculo ukhombisa libhodi njengesilandzeleli tinkinga sendzawo yekugcina ikhodi: emakhadi atinkinga, emalebula angemalebula, emalebula lanelusuku lwekugcina tingcopho, imibono yinkhulumo kantsi lokunamatsiselwe kungemafayela. Uphindze ungenise uvumelanise tinkinga kusuka ku-GitHub, GitLab, Gitea naku-Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Buka tinkinga letivulekile naletivaliwe, hlunga ngelilebula noma ngesicongo, bese uvula inkinga kute ufundze uphindze ungete enkhulumweni yayo. Likhadi libalwa njengelivaliwe uma lisesigcinweni noma liseluhlwini lolunjenga Kuvaliwe noma Kuphelile. Tinkinga letinsha tiba ngemakhadi eluhlwini lolivulekile lwelibhodi, kantsi Vala noma Vula kabusha kuhambisa likhadi emkhatsini wetinhla letivulekile naletivaliwe. Konkhe kuyidatha yelikhadi lejwayelekile, ngako lushintjo lugcinwa emlandvweni welibhodi.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Emacembu emakholamu akuvumela kutsi uhlele emakhadi lafanako ngetindlela letengetiwe, njengekubaluleka, sicongo noma bukhulu, ngaphandle kwekususa nome nguliphi likhadi eluhlwini lwalo. Licembu ngalinye linemakholamu alo lanemibala.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Umlawuli welibhodi ubhala libito kuLicembu lemakholamu lelisha bese uchofoza Ngeta, bese ungeta emakholamu ngelibito nangembala. Khetsa licembu etulu; likhadi ngalinye lisekholamu yinye yalo noma ku-Akubekiwe. Dvonsa likhadi uliyise kulelinye likholamu kute ushintje indzawo yalo kulelicembu kuphela; luhla lwalo, umtsandvo, emalebula nemalunga kuhlala kunjalo. Likhadi ngalinye liphindze likhombise emalebula lamancane elikholamu yalo kulamanye emacembu.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Umbono weWebhusayithi ukhombisa libhodi njengewebhusayithi leyakhiwe ngemakhadi nangalokunamatsiselwe lokulalo, sibonelo iwebhusayithi lengeniswe kusuka ku-WordPress, Ghost, Blogger noma iwebhusayithi lemile. Libhodi lemphakatsi lingavuleka kulombono, ngako tivakashi tibona iwebhusayithi elikhelini lelibhodi.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Emakhadi laseluhlwini lolubitwa ngekutsi Kushicilelwe asewebhusayithini, noma emakhadi alo lonkhe luhla uma lungekho loluhla lolunjalo; emakhadi lasesigcinweni awakaze avele. Emakhadi lasemtsandvweni lobitwa ngekutsi Emakhasi akha imenyu, nemisebenti lemincane njengemakhasi lamancane, kantsi lamanye emakhadi atindzaba elikhasini lekucala, lamasha kucala. Inchazelo yelikhadi ingumbhalo welikhasi futsi lokunamatsiselwe kulo titfombe nemafayela alo. Kute uyisebentise njengembono welibhodi lemphakatsi, yikhetse kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Kubukwa Kwelibhodi.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Umbono weSitolo ukhombisa imikhicito lesemakhadini elibhodi njengesitolo se-inthanethi, netitfombe, emanani, tigaba, likhasi lemkhicito, libhasikidi kanye nekukhokha. Likhadi leliseluhlwini lolutsengiswako liba ngumkhicito uma sikhala salo senani sinenombolo, futsi emalebula alo aba tigaba.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Umlawuli welibhodi uhlela sitolo kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Sitolo: tikhala tenani, tekhodi yemkhicito netesitoko, luhla lwema-oda lwangasese, imali, i-VAT, tindlela tekukhokha, tinhla letitsengiswako nemalebula lakhonjiswa njengetigaba, bese uphawula Sitolo sivulekile. Batsengi bahlunga ngesigaba, bangeta imikhicito elibhasikidini bese bayakhokha. I-oda ngalinye liba likhadi lelisha eluhlwini lwema-oda, futsi umtsengi utfola i-imeyili yekucinisekisa.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Hlunga kukhombisa kuphela emakhadi lafanana naloko lokukhetsako, njengemalebula, emalunga, labanikwe umsebenti, tinsuku, emanani etikhala takho, umbhalo welikhadi noma kutsi emakhadi asehlale sikhatsi lesingakanani eluhlwini. Akushintji likhadi noma kufinyelela kwanome ngubani, futsi kuhlanganiswa kwetihlungi kungagcinwa ngelibito kuphindze kusetjentiswe.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Khetsa emalebula, bantfu, tinsuku noma leminye imibandzela elibha yasecaleni, futsi libhodi likhombisa emakhadi lafananako kuphela. Ngaphansi kweMalebula, OR ifanisa nome nguliphi lilebula lelikhetsiwe kantsi AND idzinga onkhe; kuchofoza lilebula lelikhetsiwe futsi kulikhipha. Umbhalo welikhadi usebenta njengoba ubhala. Kuvala liphaneli kugcina kuhlunga kuvuliwe kuze ukusule. Kusesha Jikelele, lokulapha futsi, kutfola emakhadi kuwo onkhe emabhodi akho.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Sesha kutfola emakhadi netinhla talelibhodi lanembhalo lonaloko lokubhalako, futsi kukhombisa likhadi ngalinye lelitfolakele elibhodini ngekwalo. Ku-Onkhe emabhodi inkinobho lefanako inciphisa luhla lwakho lwemabhodi ngesihloko.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Bhala esikhaleni bese ucindzetela Enter. Libha yasecaleni ibhala tinhla nemakhadi lafananako, futsi likhadi lekucala livuleka elibhodini nesibali ngaphansi kwesikhala. Cindzetela Enter futsi kuze ufike elikhadini lelilandzelako noma Shift+Enter elikhadini lelengcile; imicibisholo yenta lokufanako futsi iyabuyela ekucaleni. Chofoza likhadi noma luhla emiphumeleni kute ulikhombise elibhodini, bese uchofoza Sesha futsi kute uvale libha yasecaleni.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Kukhetsa Lokunyenti kukuvumela kutsi uphawule emakhadi lamanyenti bese wenta intfo yinye kuwo onkhe kanyekanye: kubeka lilebula noma lilunga, kushintja umbala, kuwahambisa, kuwakopisha noma kuwayisa esigcinweni. Ku-Onkhe emabhodi kukhetsa emabhodi esikhundleni saloko.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Vula Kukhetsa Lokunyenti enhloko yelibhodi, bese uphawula emabhokisi emakhadi, noma usebentise Hlunga kuya ekukhetseni kulibha yasecaleni yeKuhlunga kute ukhetse onkhe emakhadi lakhonjiswa sihlungi. Khetsa sento elibha yasecaleni, njengeBeka lilebula kulokukhetsiwe, Hambisa lokukhetsiwe noma Yisa lokukhetsiwe esigcinweni. Chofoza Cima Kukhetsa Lokunyenti, i-X eceleni kwenkinobho yenhloko, uma usucedzile. Udzinga imvume yekushintja libhodi.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Tikhala takho tikhala letengetiwe telibhodi temakhadi, njengenguculo, sabelomali, likhasimende, libhokisi lekuphawula noma kukhetsa eluhlwini. Sikhala sichazwa kanye kulibhodi, futsi likhadi ngalinye lingaba nelinani lalo.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Chofoza + kute udale sikhala, usinike libito neluhlobo (umbhalo, inombolo, lusuku, imenyu lehlayo, imenyu lehlayo lekhetsa lokunyenti, libhokisi lekuphawula, imali noma ithempuleti yembhalo) bese ukhetsa kutsi sikhonjiswa kuphi: elikhadini, ekhadini lelincane, emakhadini lamasha noma kulo lonkhe likhadi. Luhlobo alukwati kushintjwa ngemuva. Tikhala tetinombolo netemali tingakhombisa inombolo yato lephelele etulu kweluhla ngalunye. Emanani emakhadi abe sewagcwaliswa elikhadini lelivuliwe.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Ingobolwane ibamba emakhadi, tinhla nemitsandvo leyiswe esigcinweni. Kuyisa esigcinweni kufihla lokutsite ngaphandle kwekukulahla, ngako kungabuyiselwa ngemuva, kantsi kususa kukususa phakadze.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Khetsa lithebhu leMakhadi, Tinhla noma Imitsandvo bese uchofoza Buyisela eceleni kwentfo, noma Buyisela konkhe. Likhadi lingase lingabuyiselwa ngesikhatsi luhla lwalo lusesigcinweni noma lugcwele ngekwemkhawulo walo we-WIP, futsi Ingobolwane iyakusho. Balawuli belibhodi baphindze babone Susa naSusa konkhe, lokungeke kuhlehliswe. Emabhodi lasesigcinweni abuyiselwa kusuka elikhasini leNgobolwane ku-Onkhe emabhodi esikhundleni saloko.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Tindzawo tekucala tikhombisa lapho umtsandvo ngamunye, luhla nelikhadi kwabekwa khona nakwentiwa, nekutsi ngukuphi lokuhambile kusukela lapho. Kuyasita emva kwekuhlelwa kabusha lokukhulu, noma kute ubone sihloko likhadi ladalwa ngaso.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Fundza emacembu lamatsatfu, Imitsandvo, Tinhla naMakhadi. Intfo ngayinye ikhombisa libito layo lanyalo, Kuhanjisiwe uma ingasekho lapho beyibekwe khona, indzawo leyadalwa kuyo, sihloko sayo sekucala uma sesishintjile, nekutsi yentiwa nini. Chofoza Vuselela kute uphindze ufundze umlandvo welibhodi. Tintfo letentiwa ngaphambi kwekutsi tindzawo tibhalwe atinamugca.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Sifinyeto ngumbiko wemhlangano wemalanga onkhe walokwentekile elibhodini, umuntfu ngemuntfu, lotsatfwe kumarekhodi elibhodi ngekwalo. Siphendvula kutsi ngamunye wetfu wentani elangeni lelengcile noma eliviki, nekutsi yini lesele emuva.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Khetsa Lilanga lelengcile noma Liviki lelengcile.
