Lilunga ngalinye lelente lokutsite noma lelinemakhadi lasele emuva litfola emacembu emakhadi Laphelile, Lahanjisiwe, Langetiwe naLanemibono, kanye nemakhadi alo Lasele emuva, futsi likhadi ngalinye livuleka elinkini lalo. Chofoza Kopisha njengembhalo kute ukopishe sifinyeto sonkhe, silungele kunamatsiselwa engcocweni noma ku-imeyili.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Kusukela ekuvakasheleni kwakho kwekugcina kubhala loko labanye bantfu lakushintje kulelibhodi kusukela ugcine kulivula: emakhadi lamasha, kuhanjiswa, imibono, lushintjo lwelusuku lwekugcina nemalunga langetiwe. Intfo yemenyu ikhombisa linani lelushintjo.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Kuvula libhodi kubhala kuvakashela kwakho. Vula lombono kute ubone lushintjo luhlelwe ngelikhadi, lolusha kucala, bese uchofoza umugca kute uvule lelo khadi. Lushintjo lwakho alubhalwa. Umlawuli angafihla lolusito kuPhaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo / Tinsita.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Kubonakala kunquma kutsi ngubani longalibona libhodi: bantfu labangetwe kulo kuphela (Kwangasese), wonkhe umsebentisi longenile wale-WeKan (Basebentisi labangenile), noma nome ngubani lonelinki (Kwemphakatsi). Kuhlela kuhlala kwemalunga elibhodi ngaphandle kwekutsi umlawuli welibhodi avumele lokunye.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Umlawuli welibhodi uchofoza inkinobho yekubonakala enhloko yelibhodi bese akhetsa Kwangasese, Basebentisi labangenile noma Kwemphakatsi; lokukhetsiwe kwanyalo kunelupawu lwekuvuma futsi inkinobho ibe seyikhombisa silungiselelo lesisha. Elibhodini laBasebentisi labangenile noma leKwemphakatsi, uma umlawuli avumela, umlawuli angaphindze aphawule Wonkhe longenile angahlela. Kulabanye bantfu inkinobho ikhombisa silungiselelo kuphela.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Kubuka kubeka kutsi utiva lokungakanani ngalelibhodi: Kulandzela kukwatisa ngalo lonkhe lushintjo, Kulandzelela kuphela ngelushintjo emakhadini lowadalile noma loyilunga lawo, futsi Kuthulisiwe ngalutfo. Silungiselelo ngesakho; lamanye emalunga akhetsa letawo.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Chofoza inkinobho yekubuka enhloko yelibhodi bese ukhetsa Kulandzela, Kulandzelela noma Kuthulisiwe; lizinga lakho lanyalo linelupawu lwekuvuma futsi inkinobho ikhombisa lizinga lelisha. Uma lushintjo lwaliwa, umlayeto usho kutsi kungani futsi kute lokushintjako. Inkinobho ifihlwa uma umlawuli acime kubuka.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Hlela Emakhadi kushintja luhlelo emakhadi lakhonjiswa ngalo ngekhatsi kweluhla ngalunye: ngelusuku lwekugcina, ngesihloko, ngesikhatsi sekudalwa, ngemavoti noma ngeluhlelo lwemalebula elibhodi. Kushintja kuphela loko lokubonako, futsi kute likhadi lelihanjiswako.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza Hlela Emakhadi enhloko yelibhodi bese ukhetsa luhlelo; emakhadi eluhlwini ngalunye ayalulandzela futsi inkinobho isho kutsi Kuhlela kuvuliwe. Chofoza i-X eceleni kwayo kute ususe kuhlela bese ubuyela eluhlelweni emakhadi abedvonswe ngalo. Lokukhetsile kugcinwa esipheqululini sakho nangabe ulayisha kabusha. KuLuhlelo lwemalebula, umlawuli welibhodi angashintja luhlelo lwemalebula ngeYisa etulu naYisa phansi nakahlela lilebula.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Tilungiselelo Telibhodi tihlanganisa konkhe lokubekelwe lelibhodi linye: imitsetfo yalo, kuhlela, umbala nesitfombe sangemuva, tinsuku, imibono, imitsandvo, tinhla nemakhadi, kutfumela nekungenisa, tatiso, ema-webhook nengobolwane. Tintfo letinyenti ngetebalawuli belibhodi; indzima yakho netilungiselelo teiwebhusayithi kunquma kutsi ubona tiphi.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Vula libha yasecaleni yesekudla yelibhodi ngemenyu bese uchofoza Tilungiselelo Telibhodi. Khetsa intfo bese liwindi layo noma likhasi liyavuleka. Tintfo tihlelwe ngemacembu: imitsetfo kucala, bese kubukeka kwelibhodi, bese kutsi lidvwetjwa njani, bese kutsi yini lengenako nalephumako kulo, bese ekugcineni ingobolwane.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Shintja Umbala ubeka indlela yemibala yalelibhodi, lebonwa ngulo lonkhe lilunga kulelibhodi. Kuyindlela yekwehlukanisa emabhodi ngekushesha. Balawuli belibhodi kuphela labangawushintja.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Chofoza sibonelo sendlela yemibala; isetjentiswa ngekushesha, ngaphandle kwenkinobho Gcina. Etindleleni letilula naletisobala ungaphindze ukhetse imibala yakho ngemasondvo emibala futsi uyihlole kusibonakaliso. Umbala lotibekele wona kuTilungiselelo Telilunga usolo unqoba umbala welibhodi kuwe.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Satiso selibhodi ngumlayeto umlawuli welibhodi lawubhalela wonkhe umuntfu lokulelibhodi, lokhonjiswa elibha ngetulu kwetinhla telibhodi. Sisebentise etintfweni wonkhe lilunga lekufanele alubone, njengelusuku lekugcina noma lushintjo endleleni libhodi lelisetjentiswa ngayo.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Bhala umbhalo, kufika etinhlavwini letingu-2000 tembhalo locacile, uphawule Kukhombise kubo bonkhe kulelibhodi, bese uchofoza Gcina. Emalunga abona libha kuze aliyale ngeluphawu lwalo lwe-X, loku kulifihla kubo kuphela. Uma satiso sihlelwa, siphindze sikhonjiswe kubo bonkhe.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Sitfombe sangemuva sitfombe lesikhonjiswa ngemuva kwetinhla telibhodi, futsi njengelithayela lelibhodi elikhasini Onkhe emabhodi. Singaba likheli lesitfombe ewebhu noma sitfombe lesilayishiwe sagcinwa ku-WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Bhala likheli lesitfombe ku-URL yeSitfombe sangemuva bese uchofoza Gcina, noma usebentise Susa Sitfombe sangemuva kute usisule. Kute ugcine sitfombe, chofoza Layisha sitfombe sangemuva bese ukhetsa lifayela; titfombe letilayishiwe tibhalwe ngaphansi, lapho kuchofoza sinye kwenta sibe ngemuva welibhodi, kantsi timphawu tiyasilayisha noma tisisuse.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Lusuku luvumela umlawuli welibhodi kutsi akhetse indlela yinye yekubhala lusuku kubo bonkhe kulelibhodi, esikhundleni sendlela lebekelwe iwebhusayithi yonkhe. Lelo windi lelivelako linesishintji senombolo yeliviki sakho, futsi kubalawuli belibhodi, kuvumelanisa kwelikhalenda lokufaka tinsuku tekugcina temakhadi elikhalendeni le-CalDAV njenge-Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Phawula Indlela Yelusuku yelibhodi, khetsa indlela bese uchofoza Gcina; susa luphawu kute uphindze ulandzele silungiselelo seiwebhusayithi. Indlela levuliwe yelilunga ngekwalo kuTilungiselelo Telilunga isolo iyanqoba. Khombisa liviki lemnyaka livula noma licime tinombolo temaviki kuwe ngekushesha. Kute uvumelanise likhalenda, faka likheli lelikhalenda, libito lemsebentisi nephasiwedi yelulungelo, uphawule libhokisi lekuvumelanisa bese uGcina.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Tilungiselelo Tawo onkhe emabhodi tinquma kutsi lithayela lalelibhodi likhombisa yini elikhasini Onkhe emabhodi, njengelinani lemakhadi eluhlwini ngalunye netitfombe temalunga. Tiphindze tibeke kuguga kwemakhadi, kuyisa esigcinweni ngekutentekela kwemakhadi langakatsintfwa, nekutsi bubanti betinhla ngebemuntfu ngamunye yini noma butsintsetfwana.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Phawula noma ususe luphawu emugceni bese kugcinwa ngekushesha. Nekuguga kwemakhadi kuvuliwe, bhala tinombolo letintsatfu temalanga emva kwawo emakhadi afiphala ngetinyatselo. Kuyisa esigcinweni ngekutentekela, bhala kutsi likhadi lingahlala emalanga lamangakhi ngaphandle kwemsebenti lingakayiswa esigcinweni, noma ukushiye kungenalutfo kute ukucime. Emathempuleti awakaze ayiswe esigcinweni.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Kubukwa Kwelibhodi kukhetsa kutsi ngumuphi umbono, njengeMitsandvo, Tinhla, Lithebula, Likhalenda, i-Gantt noma emashadi, lonikwa kuyimenyu yeKubukwa Kwelibhodi kwalelibhodi, nekutsi libhodi livuleka ngaliphi. Kubekwa ngalokuhlukile uma libhodi lingelemphakatsi nangesikhatsi lingelangasese.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Lelo windi linemugca munye ngembono ngamunye nemabhokisi lamane ekuphawula: umbono lojwayelekile nemibono lekhonjiswako yelibhodi lemphakatsi, kanye nalawo lamabili elibhodi langasese. Phawula libhokisi lekuKhombisa lembono kute uwunike kuyimenyu, nelibhokisi lawo lekuJwayelekile kute libhodi livuleke ngawo.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Umtsandvo ubamba tilungiselelo temitsandvo telibhodi lonkhe: kutsi imitsandvo ingadvonswa yini, kutsi budze bayo bungashintjwa yini, kutsi yonkhe imitsandvo yabelana ngemugca munye wetinhloko tetinhla yini, nekutsi ngutiphi tikhala te-Scrum lekhonjiswa ngumtsandvo. Emacembu Emkhawulo we-WIP, imikhawulo yemsebenti lochubekako labelwana ngayo etinhleni letinyenti, nawo alapha.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Phawula emabhokisi lowafunako; libhokisi leKudvonseka lisethebuleni etulu. Umugca munye wenhloko yeluhla lotsintsetfwanako ukhombisa yonkhe imitsandvo netinhla tonkhe telibhodi ngaphansi kwemugca munye wetinhloko lohlala etulu, ngaphandle kwekushintja tinhla. Chofoza Emacembu Emkhawulo we-WIP phansi kute ungete noma uhlele imikhawulo letsintsetfwanako.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Luhla lubamba tilungiselelo tetinhla telibhodi lonkhe: kutsi tinhla tingadvonswa yini, kutsi bubanti bato bungashintjwa yini, kutsi tonkhe tinhla tinebubanti lobufanako yini, kanye nesikhala se-Scrum lesikhonjiswa luhla. Luphindze luvule imigomo yekugeleta kweKanban: imigomo yetinhla, tinhla letehlukaniswe tibe Kuyentiwa naKuphelile, liphuzu lekutibophelela nemkhawulo we-WIP ngemuntfu.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Phawula tishintji lotidzingako; libhokisi leKudvonseka lisethebuleni etulu. Nekushintja bukhulu kuvunyelwe, dvonsa sibambo emkhatsini wetinhla kute ushintje bubanti. Umugca wemgomo wekugeleta uvela kuphela uma lelo lusito luvuliwe kuwebhusayithi, futsi nakuvuliwe, imininingwane yawo ibekwa kuyimenyu yeluhla ngalunye.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Sitolo sishintja emakhadi elibhodi abe sitolo se-inthanethi lesikhonjiswa embonweni welibhodi weSitolo. Umlawuli welibhodi ukhetsa kutsi ngutiphi tikhala takho letilinani, ikhodi yemkhicito nesitoko, ngutiphi tinhla letitsengiswako, ngamaphi emalebula latigaba, kutsi ema-oda abhalwa kuphi nekutsi ngutiphi tindlela tekukhokha letinikwako.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Beka imigca bese uchofoza Gcina; konkhe kugcinwa ndzawonye futsi kuphindze kuhlolwe yisevha. Likhadi lelinenani eluhlwini lolutsengiswako liba ngumkhicito. Ema-oda abhalwa njengemakhadi eluhlwini lwema-oda, lokufanele lube selibhodini langasese, futsi umtsengi angatfola i-imeyili yekucinisekisa. Ungaphindze wente Sitolo sibe ngiko lokubonwa tivakashi telibhodi lemphakatsi.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Likhadi linquma kutsi emakhadi lamancane nemakhadi lavuliwe alelibhodi akhombisa yini, nangaluphi luhlelo, ngamunye ngalokutimele. Lisebentise uma libhodi lincike etikhaleni letimbalwa, sibonelo kubeka inchazelo noma tikhala takho kucala, noma kukhombisa lusuku lwekugcina kucala emakhadini lamancane.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Lelo windi linetigaba letimbili, Khombisa eKhadini Lelincane naKhombisa eKhadini. Phawula noma ususe luphawu esigabeni noma esikhaleni kute usikhombise noma usifihle, bese udvonsa imigca kute ushintje luhlelo lwayo. Letinye tigaba tinemenyu yato yekuba netilungiselelo letinyenti, njengeMisebenti Lemincane netindlela tekudvonsa likhadi.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Kutfumela kubhala lelibhodi, noma incenye yalo, efayeleni: tindlela ta-WeKan ngekwayo, emaspredishithi, i-PDF, i-HTML, emafayela elikhalenda netindlela temathulusi lamanyenti. Kungenisa kungeta lokuvela ekutfumeleni kwa-WeKan kulelibhodi. Kutfumela kwelibhodi akusiko kulondvoloza kweiwebhusayithi yonkhe.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: KuTfumela, khetsa kucala kutsi yini lofuna kuyifaka, bese uchofoza indlela futsi lifayela liyalayishwa. KuNgenisa, khetsa lifayela lekutfumela kwa-WeKan nge-json noma i-zip futsi lokukulo kungetwa kulelibhodi. Kungenisa kudzinga imvume yekubhala elibhodini, futsi kokubili kungacinywa ngumlawuli weiwebhusayithi.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Tatiso tibeka lokujwayelekile kwalelibhodi kutatiso te-imeyili nangekhatsi kweluhlelo, tikhumbuto telusuku lwekugcina, i-imeyili kuya elikhadini, nekutsi tatiso tilethwa njani. Kukhetsa lokucacile kwelilunga ngekwalo kusengakunqoba lokujwayelekile kwelibhodi.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Kulithileyi langekhatsi kweluhlelo nakwi-imeyili, khetsa Lokujwayelekile kute ulandzele silungiselelo seiwebhusayithi, noma Yebo noma Cha kute usinqobe kulelibhodi. Ngaphansi kweTikhumbuto telusuku lwekugcina, bhala emalanga ekukhumbuta, ahlukaniswe ngekhoma, lapho 0 kulilanga lekugcina futsi tinombolo letingaphansi kwa-0 temalanga emva kwalo, bese uchofoza Gcina. Tigaba tekuletsa ngaphansi tibeka kutsi satiso siphetseni, kuhlanganisa nesikhatsi.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Ema-Webhook laphumako atfumela imisebenti yalelibhodi kulolunye lusito, njengelithulusi lengcoco noma kuhlanganisa kwakho, njengoba yenteka. I-webhook ngayinye itfumela umbhalo wemsebenti kanye nemabito nemalinki elibhodi, luhla, umtsandvo, likhadi nebantfu labatsintsekako.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Bhala libito, likheli lolinikwe lusito lolwemukelako futsi, uma lufuna, lithokheni, khetsa luhlobo bese uchofoza Dala. I-webhook legciniwe ikhombisa tindlela letinyenti: kutsi itfumela miphi imisebenti, imilayeto leya ngco kumalunga elikhadi ku-Mattermost, nekutsi imilayeto yayo ihlanganiswa njani nesikhatsi sayo. Yihlele bese uyigcina futsi, noma usebentise Cima Lena Webhook kute uyimise.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Basiti lababili bemihlangano ye-Scrum, labatfolakala kulo lonkhe lilunga lelibhodi. Umhlangano wemalanga onkhe ngumbali wesikhatsi lonika lilunga ngalinye sikhatsi lesifanako, kantsi Libhodi lekubuka emuva lenta libhodi lelisha lekubuka emuva lekutsi Cala, Yekela, Chubeka.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Umhlangano wemalanga onkhe ubhala emalunga elibhodi ngeluhlelo lolugcwatjelwe; Cala ubala phansi sikhatsi semuntfu wekucala, lesiba bovu uma sedlula, kantsi Lokulandzelako kudlulisela kuze kufike kulowekugcina. Umbali wesikhatsi usebenta kuphela esipheqululini sakho. Libhodi lekubuka emuva lidala futsi livule libhodi lelisha langasese linetinhla Cala kwenta, Yekela kwenta, Chubeka kwenta naTintfo tekwenta.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Licembu lemkhawulo we-WIP ngumkhawulo munye wemsebenti lochubekako labelwana ngawo tinhla letimbili noma ngetulu ndzawonye, ngetulu kwemkhawulo weluhla ngalunye. Uyasita uma umsebenti lochubekako wendlulela etinhleni letinyenti, njengekutsi Kuyentiwa, Kubuyeketa naKuhlola, noma uma ufuna kubeka umkhawulo emtsandvweni wonkhe.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Ngaphansi kweNgeta licembu lemkhawulo we-WIP, phawula tinhla letibalwa ndzawonye, noma ukhetse umtsandvo bese uchofoza Sebentisa emtsandvweni kute uphawule tinhla tawo. Beka umkhawulo bese uchofoza Ngeta licembu lemkhawulo we-WIP. Licembu lelikhona lingashintjwa nge-Sebentisa, livulwe noma licinywe ngeKuvula Umkhawulo we-WIP, noma lisuswe ngeSusa.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Imisebenti Lemincane ihlukanisa likhadi lelikhulu ibe ngemakhadi lamancane langanikwa umuntfu, ahlelelwe sikhatsi futsi ahanjiswe ngalinye, kantsi likhadi lelitali liyawabhala libale kutsi mangakhi laphelile. Leti tilungiselelo tinquma kutsi imisebenti lemincane lemisha idalwa kuphi nekutsi umsebenti lomncane ukhombisa njani lotali wawo.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Khetsa kutsi likhadi lelincane lemsebenti lomncane libiza njani lotali walo, nekutsi emakhadi elibhodi anesigaba seMisebenti Lemincane yini, kanye nelibhodi, luhla nemtsandvo lapho imisebenti lemincane lemisha idalwa khona. Ngalokujwayelekile iya elibhodini layo. Imisebenti lemincane ngekwayo ingetwa esigabeni seMisebenti Lemincane selikhadi lelivuliwe.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Imitsetfo yenta libhodi lisebente ngekutentekela: uma lokutsite kwenteka, sicalisi, i-WeKan yenta lokutsite, sento. Sibonelo, uma likhadi lihanjiswa liya ku-Kuphelile, liphawule njengeliphelile. Imitsetfo yentiwa balawuli belibhodi, futsi libhodi lingavumela emalunga alo kutsi ayifundze.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Bhala sihloko, khetsa sicalisi bese ugcwalisa tikhala taso, bese ukhetsa sento; umtsetfo uyagcinwa futsi usebenta kusukela lapho ngaphandle kwekutsi ucinywe. Embonweni weKuhamba kwemsebenti ungakha imitsetfo ngekudvonsa sicalisi nesento. Imitsetfo ingashintjwa libito, isuswe, itfunyelwe futsi ingeniswe, kantsi umtsetfo ungaba netinye ticalisi netento emininingwaneni yawo.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Tilungiselelo Telilunga yimenyu yakho, levulwa elibitweni lakho lemsebentisi noma esitfombeni sakho etulu kwesekudla. Inemakhasi akho njengeMakhadi Ami, Emakhadi Lafanele Kugcina naLanenkhanyeti, kubuka jikelele kwemabhodi, nato tonkhe tilungiselelo takho, kusukela kuphrofayili nephasiwedi kuya kululwimi nemafonti.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Chofoza libito lakho lemsebentisi noma sitfombe sakho bese ukhetsa intfo; likhasi layo noma liwindi lelivelako liyavuleka. Lokubonako kuncike eluhlotjeni lwe-akhawunti yakho, endzimeni yakho nasetilungiselelweni teiwebhusayithi. Uma iphrofayili yetinsita yemlawuli weiwebhusayithi ikufihlela letinye tinsita, imenyu isho kutsi mangakhi lafihliwe.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Hlela Iphrofayili ishintja kutsi labanye bantfu bakubona njani ku-WeKan: libito lakho lonkhe netinhlamvu tekucala, futsi, uma iwebhusayithi ivuma, libito lakho lemsebentisi nelikheli le-imeyili. Uma iwebhusayithi ivuma, ungaphindze ususe noma wente kungatiwa i-akhawunti yakho lapha.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Shintja tikhala bese uchofoza Gcina; liwindi liyavaleka uma kusebentile, ngaphandle kwaloko likhombisa liphutsa. Libito lemsebentisi noma likheli le-imeyili lelisetjentiswa ngulenye i-akhawunti liyaliwa, futsi likheli le-imeyili lelishintjiwe liphawulwa njengelingakacinisekiswa. Susa kususa i-akhawunti yakho ngaphandle kwekuhlehlisa, kantsi Yenta i-akhawunti ingatiwa igcina umlandvo wakho kodvwa ishintje libito lakho.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Shintja Tilungiselelo tibamba tincumo takho tekuhlela nekukhombisa, njengetibambo tekudvonsa, kuphawula emakhadi lashintjile kusukela ugcine kuwavula, umugca wekugcila, kugcina tihleli nge-Enter, kuvula emakhadi lamanyenti kanyekanye kanye nemsindvo weluhla lwekuhlola. Tisebenta kuwe kuphela, kuwo onkhe emabhodi.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Chofoza sishintji kute usivule noma usicime; luphawu lwekuvuma lukhombisa kutsi sivuliwe futsi sigcinwa ngekushesha. KuKhombisa linani lemakhadi uma luhla luneladlula, bhala inombolo bese uchofoza Gcina. Indlela yelusuku, kucala kweliviki netatiso kunetintfo tako kuTilungiselelo Telilunga.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Shintja Umbala ubeka indlela yakho yemibala ku-WeKan. Inqoba indlela yemibala yeiwebhusayithi yonkhe indzawo futsi nembala welibhodi emakhasini elibhodi, kodvwa kuwe kuphela.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Chofoza sibonelo sendlela yemibala; isetjentiswa ngekushesha. Etindleleni letilula naletisobala ungakhetsa imibala yakho ngemasondvo emibala futsi uyibone kusibonakaliso. Khetsa Indlela yemibala lejwayelekile kute ususe lokukhetsile bese uphindze ubone imibala yelibhodi noma yeiwebhusayithi.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Lifonti likuvumela kutsi ukhetsele wena luhlobo lwetinhlavu, bukhulu bembhalo nembala wembhalo wesikhombisi sonkhe se-WeKan. Liyasita ekufundzeni, sibonelo ngebukhulu lobukhudlwana noma ngembala lofanele emehlo akho.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Chofoza Lokujwayelekile noma lenye yetinkinobho temafonti; kunikwa kuphela emafonti lafakwe esipheqululini sakho. Khetsa bukhulu bese ukhetsa umbala wembhalo elisondvweni lemibala, noma uchofoze Susa kute ubuyele embaleni wendlela yemibala. Lushintjo lusebenta ngekushesha futsi lugcinwa kuphrofayili yakho, kantsi umugca wesibonakaliso ukhombisa umphumela.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: I-avatar yakho sitfombe lesincane lesikhonjiswa ngawe emakhadini, etinhleni temalunga, emibonweni nasenhloko. Shintja I-avatar ikuvumela kutsi ulayishe titfombe, ukhetse kutsi ngusiphi lesisetjentiswako, utisuse, noma ubuyele etinhlavweni takho tekucala.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Chofoza Layisha i-avatar bese ukhetsa sitfombe; singetwa eluhlwini, futsi kuchofoza umugca waso kusenta sibe yi-avatar yakho, siphawulwe ngeluphawu lwekuvuma. Chofoza Tinhlavu tekucala kute ukhombise tinhlavu takho tekucala esikhundleni saloko. Luphawu lwembhoshongo wetibi lususa sitfombe emva kwekutsi uvumile. Liwindi likhombisa imikhawulo yebukhulu neyeluhlobo lwelifayela uma iwebhusayithi iyibekile.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Shintja Iphasiwedi ishintja iphasiwedi longena ngayo ku-WeKan. Yema-akhawunti lanephasiwedi ye-WeKan; ema-akhawunti langena ngalolunye lusito ashintja iphasiwedi yawo lapho.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Faka iphasiwedi yakho yanyalo, bese ufaka iphasiwedi lensha kabili, bese uyatfumela. Iwebhusayithi ingadzinga budze lobuncane futsi yale emaphasiwedi lasondzelene kakhulu nelibito lakho lemsebentisi noma i-imeyili, noma latfolakala ekwebiweni kwedatha lokwatiwako. Emva kwelushintjo, sikhatsi ngasinye se-akhawunti yakho siyaphuma, futsi uphindze ungene ngephasiwedi lensha.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: I-passkey ikuvumela kutsi ungene ngesigcivito salelidivayisi, buso, kuvala sikrini noma sikhiya sekuvikela esikhundleni sephasiwedi yakho. I-passkey ihlala kudivayisi yakho futsi i-WeKan igcina incenye yayo yemphakatsi kuphela.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Bhala libito njengeLucingo lwami bese uchofoza Ngeta i-passkey kulelidivayisi, bese uyacinisekisa ngekuvala sikrini sakho uma siphequluli sicela. Ema-passkey akho abhalwa ngemabito awo netinsuku, kantsi luphawu lwembhoshongo wetibi lususa linye. Uma siphequluli singakhoni kwenta ema-passkey, liwindi liyakusho.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: I-SQRL ikuvumela kutsi ungene ngekuskena ikhodi ye-QR nge-aphu ye-SQRL, ngaphandle kwephasiwedi. Lapha ungeta bunjalo bakho be-SQRL ku-akhawunti yakho kanye, noma ubususe futsi.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Chofoza Ngeta bunjalo bami be-SQRL bese kuvela ikhodi ye-QR. Yiskene nge-aphu ye-SQRL, noma uchofoze Vula likhasimende le-SQRL kulelikhompyutha; liwindi likutjela uma bunjalo bungetiwe, noma uma ikhodi iphelelwe sikhatsi noma yehlulekile. Susa bunjalo bami be-SQRL kubususa ku-akhawunti yakho.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Kucinisekisa ngetinyatselo letimbili kwenta kungena kucele ikhodi lenetinombolo letingu-6 kusuka ku-aphu yekucinisekisa elucingweni lwakho emva kwephasiwedi yakho, ngako iphasiwedi lentjontjiwe yodvwa ayenele kungena ku-akhawunti yakho.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Chofoza Vula Kucinisekisa Ngetinyatselo Letimbili, bese uskena ikhodi ye-QR nge-aphu yekucinisekisa noma ubhale ikhodi lekhonjiswa ngaphansi kwayo ku-aphu. Faka ikhodi lenetinombolo letingu-6 lekhonjiswa yi-aphu bese uchofoza Cinisekisa Futsi Uvule. Kusukela lapho kungena kucela ikhodi, futsi lelo windi lingaphindze kukucime ngaphandle kwekutsi umlawuli wakho uyakudzinga.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Emabhodi lafihliwe abhala emabhodi lowashiyile lobekusengawafinyelela ngelicembu, inhlangano noma sizinda se-imeyili yakho, ngako i-WeKan ikufihlele wona esikhundleni saloko. Kushiya libhodi lelinjalo akushintji bulunga bakho belicembu noma benhlangano.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Liwindi likhombisa umugca munye ngelibhodi ngalinye lelifihliwe, noma lisho kutsi kute. Chofoza Buyisela eceleni kwelibhodi kute ulibuyisele ku-Onkhe emabhodi. Loku kulisusa eluhlwini lwakho lolufihliwe kuphela; kutsi ungalivula yini libhodi kusolo kunqunywa ngulibhodi ngekwalo.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: Shintja Lulwimi kukhetsa lulwimi lwesikhombisi se-WeKan kuwe. Lokukhetsile kugcinwa kuphrofayili yakho, ngako kukulandzela kuso sonkhe siphequluli. Kuze ukhetse, i-WeKan ilandzela tilimi tesiphequluli sakho futsi ibuyele esiNgisini.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Tilimi tibhalwe ngemabito ato, nelifulegi, umugca wesifundza wetinhlobo tesifundza nelinothi letilimi letibhalwa kusukela kwesekudla kuya kwesancele; lolwanyalo lunelupawu lwekuvuma. Chofoza lulwimi bese sikhombisi siyashintja ngekushesha.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Mema Bantfu kutfumela i-imeyili lenekhodi yesimemo kubantfu labangakabi nayo i-akhawunti, ngako bangabhalisa nangabe kutibhalisa kucinyiwe. Kuvumela emalunga esizinda se-imeyili senhlangano kutsi alete labasebenta nabo ngaphandle kwemlawuli.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Bhala emakheli e-imeyili, linye ngemugca ngamunye noma ahlukaniswe ngekhoma, phawula emabhodi lafanele kungena kuwo nabobhalisa, bese uchofoza Mema. Liwindi lisho kutsi timemo titfunyelwe yini. Udzinga indzima yelibhodi levumela kumema kulo lonkhe libhodi lelphawuliwe, futsi likheli leselinayo i-akhawunti limisa kutfumela.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Lusuku lukhetsa kutsi tinsuku tibhalwa njani kuwe, njengemnyaka-inyanga-lilanga noma lilanga-inyanga-umnyaka, nesikhatsi noma ngaphandle kwaso. Indlela yakho levuliwe iyayinqoba yelibhodi neyeiwebhusayithi. Lelo windi libeka lilanga lekucala leliviki nendlela yelikhalenda.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Etulu kwelwindi kukhombisa tindlela teiwebhusayithi netelibhodi lanyalo, ngako ungabona kutsi bewungatfolani. Phawula Tilungiselelo Telilunga: Indlela Yelusuku bese ukhetsa indlela, beka kucala kweliviki nendlela yelikhalenda uma ufuna, bese uchofoza Gcina. Susa luphawu endleleni yakho bese ugcina kute uphindze ulandzele libhodi noma iwebhusayithi.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Licembu lenkhanyeti enhloko yimenyu yakho yemabhukhimakhi: ligcina emabhodi, lamanye emakhasi e-WeKan, futsi kusuka kumamenyu awo, imitsandvo, tinhla nemakhadi, kube kuchofoza kunye kuphela. Tinkhanyeti takho ngetakho wedvwa.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Chofoza inkhanyeti kute uphawule noma ususe inkhanyeti elibhodini noma elikhasini lolikulo; linani likhombisa kutsi unemangakhi. Chofoza luphawu noma linani kute uvule luhla bese uchofoza umugca kute uye lapho, noma Buka konkhe lokunenkhanyeti kute utfole likhasi lonkhe Lanenkhanyeti. Ku-Onkhe emabhodi / Lanenkhanyeti ungasusa tinkhanyeti ematayeleni futsi uwadvonse kute uwahlele kabusha.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Emakhadi lafanako abhala emakhadi alelibhodi lanesihloko nenchazelo lefana kakhulu nalelo, ngako likhophi lesibili lemsebenti lofanako liyabonakala ngaphambi kwekutsi umsebenti wentiwe kabili. Lokufana kakhulu kuphawulwa ngekutsi Kungaba kuphindvwa.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Kufika emakhadi lafanako lasihlanu akhonjiswa lapha, ngalinye neluhla lolukulo, futsi sihloko siyawabala. Chofoza linye kute ulivule. Kucatsanisa kufanisa umbhalo locacile lokwentiwa yisevha, ngaphandle kwalo nome nguluphi lusito lwe-AI. Sigaba singafihlwa kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi, emugceni Emakhadi lafanako, Khombisa eKhadini.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Imisebenti ngumlandvo welikhadi ngekwalo: ngubani lolidalile, washintja sihloko salo, wengeta lilebula, walihambisa, wabhala umbono noma wanamatsisela lifayela, futsi nini. Iphendvula kutsi yini leyentekile kulelikhadi ngaphandle kwekubuta muntfu.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Tehlakalo letinsha tibhalwa ngekulandzelana, netihloko, emalebula, tincenye temibono nemabito emafayela kukhonjiswa kuhleleke ngendlela lefanako nasekhadini ngekwalo. Chofoza sihloko lesinelinki kute uye kulelo khadi, luhla noma libhodi. Umlawuli weiwebhusayithi angakhetsa kuPhaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo / Kuvikeleka kutsi akhombise umbhalo lohlelekile njengembhalo locacile noma ngaphandle kwemalinki lachofozekako.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Emalebula timphawu telibhodi letinemibala, letisetjentiselwa kuhlanganisa nekuhlunga emakhadi ngesihloko, kubaluleka noma nome yini licembu lelivumelana ngayo. Lilebula lingaba nelusuku lwekugcina lwalo, loku kulenta libe sicongo lesilula njenge-Sprint 1 noma v2.0 kulo lonkhe likhadi leliliphetse.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Chofoza lilebula noma inkinobho yekungeta kute uvule liwindi lemalebula, bese uchofoza emalebula kute uwafake elikhadini noma uwasuse; luphawu lwekuvuma lukhombisa lakhetsiwe. Lipensela eceleni kwelilebula lihlela libito lalo, umbala nelusuku lwekugcina, futsi lilebula lelinelusuku lwekugcina likhombisa lolo lusuku eceleni kwalo. Tinamatseli netindzawo tikulesigaba lesifanako.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Likhadi linetinsuku letine longatikhetsa: Kwemukelwe nangesikhatsi umsebenti ufika, Kucala nangesikhatsi umsebenti ucala, Kugcina kwesikhatsi lesibekiwe kanye Nekuphela nangesikhatsi uphela. Luphawu lwelusuku lwekugcina lunemibala ngekuphutfuma futsi lubala emalanga lasele, ngako umsebenti losele emuva uyabonakala elibhodini.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Chofoza inkinobho yekungeta eceleni kwelusuku, noma luphawu lwelusuku, khetsa lilanga nesikhatsi bese uyagcina; lusuku lwekugcina lolungenaso sikhatsi lesikhetsiwe lutfola 17:00. Vula lelo windi futsi kute ulushintje noma ulususe. Netinkinobho tekusheshisa tikhibhodi tivuliwe, kucindzetela d elikhadini kuvula lusuku lwalo lwekugcina. Likhadi liphindze libale kutsi lusuku lwalo lwekugcina selushintjwe kangakhi.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Sigaba seMalunga sisho kutsi ngubani lotsintsekako ekhadini: emalunga alo, labanikwe umsebenti, ngubani lolidalile, ngubani lowacela umsebenti nekutsi ngubani lowawunika. Kucelwe Ngu naKunikwe Ngu kungabamba emalunga elibhodi futsi nelinothi lembhalo lokhululekile, sibonelo libito lelivela kulesinye silandzeleli.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Chofoza inkinobho yekungeta leyindilinga emugceni kute uvule luhla lwemalunga elibhodi bese ukhetsa bantfu; bakhonjiswa njengema-avatar noma tinhlavu tekucala, futsi kuchofoza i-avatar futsi kubasusa. Ngaphansi kweKucelwe Ngu naKunikwe Ngu, linki leNgeta ngaphansi kwenkinobho libhala umbhalo lokhululekile esikhundleni saloko. Kutsi ngumiphi imigca levelako kukhetfwa kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Sigaba seLikhadi sibamba tikhala tekusebenta telikhadi, njengekuncika kwalo, simo sekuvinjelwa, sigaba selusito, emaphuzu ekubaluleka, inombolo yalo yekuhlela netinkinobho talo telikhadi. Likhadi lelivuliwe likhombisa tonkhe tikhala libhodi letikhetsile kutsi tikhonjiswe emakhadini, tingenalutfo noma cha, tilungele kugcwaliswa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Gcwalisa noma ushintje sikhala ngco kulesigaba. Lokuvela lapha, kuyiphi sigaba nangaluphi luhlelo kunqunywa libhodi lonkhe kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi, esigabeni Khombisa eKhadini: phawula noma ususe luphawu emugceni, noma uwudvonse kute uwuhlele kabusha. Likhadi lelincane lilandzela sigaba Khombisa eKhadini Lelincane ngendlela lefanako.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Kulandzelela sikhatsi kubhala kutsi mangakhi emahora lasetjentiswe elikhadini, nesilinganiso longasikhetsa, timphawu teKukhokhelwa naKwedlula sikhatsi kanye nelirekhodi lemalanga lekutsi ngubani lowasebenta sikhatsi lesingakanani. Inombolo lephelele yondla imibono yelibhodi yesikhatsi, umtfwalo wemsebenti nekukhokhisa, futsi umbali wesikhatsi weFlowtime naPomodoro lapha uyangeta kuyo.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Chofoza luphawu lwesikhatsi noma imenyu eceleni kweSikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe kute uvule Shintja sikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe, faka emahora (emadesimali avunyelwe), uma ufuna silinganiso netimphawu, bese uGcina. Ngaphansi kweSikhatsi ngelilanga, khetsa lusuku, faka emahora nelinothi bese uchofoza Bhala sikhatsi; ungasusa lokufakile kuze kuvunywe noma kukhokhiswe. Luphawu luba bovu uma Kwedlula sikhatsi kuphawuliwe.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Tikhala takho tikhala letengetiwe telibhodi temakhadi alo, eceleni kwaleto letakhelwe ngekhatsi: inguculo, sabelomali, likhasimende, libhokisi lekuphawula noma kukhetsa eluhlwini. Tichazwa kanye kulibhodi, bese likhadi ngalinye lingaba nelinani lalo.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: Lapha ukhetsa kutsi ngutiphi tikhala takho telibhodi lelikhadi letisebentisako bese ugcwalisa emanani ato. Tikhala letinsha tidalwa kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi, esigabeni seTikhala takho, ngekukhetsa libito neluhlobo lolunjengeMbhalo, Inombolo, Lusuku, Imenyu lehlayo, Libhokisi lekuphawula noma Imali. Sikhala singakhonjiswa nasekhadini lelincane, futsi tikhala tetinombolo tingahlanganiswa etulu kweluhla ngalunye.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: I-Planning Poker ivumela licembu kutsi lilinganise likhadi ndzawonye. Wonkhe umuntfu ukhetsa linani emakhadini ekudlala ngaphandle kwekubona lokukhetfwe ngulabanye, futsi uma kuvota kuphela i-WeKan ikhombisa kutsi ngubani lowakhetsa yini nekutsi ngumuphi linani lelinqobile, ngako silinganiso siyavunyelwana esikhundleni sekucagelwa ngumuntfu munye.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Vula imenyu yesigaba, Hlela i-Planning Poker, uma ufuna vumela bonkhe basebentisi labangenile bese ubeka sikhatsi sekuphela, bese uGcina. Umvoti ngamunye uchofoza linani linye; kuchofoza lelinye kushintja livoti. Umlawuli welibhodi uchofoza Cedza kute abone imiphumela, abhale inombolo bese achofoza Beka Silinganiso. Phindza kusula emavoti kute kube nemzuliswano lomusha.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Tilungiselelo te-Scrum tibamba indzawo yelikhadi ekuhleleni kwe-Scrum kwelibhodi: i-sprint yalo nema-sprint lengcile, kukhululwa, luhlobo lwenkinga, imibandzela yekwemukela nelizinga lekulindza. Likhadi lingaphindze liphawulwe njenge-Story noma i-Task, loku lokusetjentiswa yimibono ye-sprint neyekulindza.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Vula Hlela ngaphansi kwetikhala kute utishintje bese uGcina; balabo labangashintja likhadi kuphela labangahlela. Imenyu esihlokweni sesigaba ikhetsa luhlobo lwelikhadi: kute, i-Story noma i-Task. Ema-sprint ngekwawo ahlelwa, acalwe futsi avalwe emibonweni ye-Scrum yelibhodi, futsi kutsi ngutiphi tikhala letikhonjiswako kubekwa kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Inchazelo ngumbhalo lomkhulu welikhadi: imininingwane yemsebenti, emanothi, emalinki noma emanothi emhlangano lanamatsiselwe. Ibhalwa nge-Markdown, ngako ingaba netihloko, tinhla, emalinki, ema-emoji netitfombe kodvwa isolo ingumbhalo locacile lekuhlelwa.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza inchazelo kute uyihlele ebhokisini lembhalo locacile. Bhala luphawu lwe-at nesicalo selibito kute utfole tiphakamiso temalunga. Gcina, bese umbhalo ukhonjiswa uhlelekile. Emafayela lalayishiwe ahlala esigabeni sa-Lokunamatsiselwe futsi angakhulunywa ngawo embhalweni.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Luhla lwekuhlola luhla lwetintfo elikhadini, ngayinye iphawulwa uma seyentiwe, yetinyatselo, imibandzela yekwemukela noma umkhuba. Likhadi lingaba netinyenti, futsi likhadi lelincane lingakhombisa kutsi mangakhi tintfo letentiwe.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Ngeta luhla lwekuhlola ngenkinobho yalo yekungeta, bese ungeta tintfo uphindze utiphawule njengoba tentiwa. Imenyu yeluhla lwekuhlola ngalunye inetento talo: hlela tonkhe tintfo kanyekanye njengembhalo, tfumela noma ungenise, luhambise noma ulukopishe, phawula noma ususe luphawu kuto tonkhe tintfo, fihla tintfo letiphawuliwe, beka kusetha kabusha ngekutentekela lokususa tonkhe timphawu ngelilanga, ngeliviki noma ngenyanga, noma ulususe. Luhla lwekuhlola lungaba nelusuku lwalo lwekugcina.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Imisebenti Lemincane ihlukanisa likhadi lelikhulu ibe ngemakhadi lamancane langanikwa umuntfu, ahlelelwe sikhatsi futsi ahanjiswe ngalinye, kantsi lelikhadi lelitali liyawabhala libale kutsi mangakhi laphelile. Umsebenti lomncane likhadi lelijwayelekile, ligcinwa elibhodini lelikhetfwe imisebenti lemincane.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Chofoza inkinobho yekungeta, bhala sihloko bese uGcina kute udale umsebenti lomncane; phawula Tfola emalebula alotali kute ukopishe emalebula alelikhadi kuwo. Luphawu lwelinki lungeta likhadi lelikhona njengemsebenti lomncane esikhundleni saloko. Imenyu yemsebenti lomncane ngamunye ine-Kubuke, Hamba eLibhodini futsi, kubalawuli belibhodi, Susa. Chofoza sihloko semsebenti lomncane kute ushintje libito lawo.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Lokunamatsiselwe ngemafayela lagcinwa nelikhadi: emadokhumende, titfombe, emavidiyo, emalogi noma emafayela lacindzetelwe. Sitfombe singaphindze sibe sitfombe sesembeso lesikhonjiswa ekhadini lelincane.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Chofoza inkinobho yekungeta kute ungete emafayela kusuka kukhompyutha yakho, unamatsisele noma ulahle sitfombe, unamatsisele lelinye likhadi, noma udvwebe sitfombe lesisha. Nome nguyiphi imikhawulo yebukhulu netinhlobo temafayela letivunyelwe ikhonjiswa ngaphansi kwaletinketfo. Chofoza lokunamatsiselwe kute ukuvule kusilayidi, bese usebentisa tinkinobho letiseceleni kwako kute ukulayishe, ushintje libito noma ukususe; imenyu yako inetinketfo tesitfombe sesembeso.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Imibono yinkhulumo yelikhadi: imibuto, timphendvulo, tibuyeketo netincumo, letigcinwa nemsebenti letikhuluma ngawo. Umbono ungaphendvula lowengcile, futsi imphendvulo ikhonjiswa ngaphansi kwawo njengentsambo.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Bhala esikhaleni semibono, usebentisa i-Markdown futsi ubite bantfu ngeluphawu lwe-at, bese uyawutfumela. Chofoza Phendvula eceleni kwembono kute uwuphendvule; libha lekutsi Kuphendvula ku likhombisa kutsi uphendvula yini, futsi kulivala kwenta umbono lojwayelekile. Ungahlela noma ususe imibono yakho, futsi kulamanye emabhodi ngumbhali wembono kuphela longawushintja.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Tinamatseli timphawu letincane letibekwa elikhadini, njengesitsupa lesiphakeme, sinambuzane, liwashi noma indondo, kute liphawulwe ngekushesha ngaphandle kwekusebentisa lilebula noma umbala. Tikhonjiswa ekhadini lelincane nasekhadini lelivuliwe.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Chofoza sinamatseli kusikhetsi kute usingete elikhadini; luphawu lwekuvuma lukhombisa kutsi sisekhadini, futsi kusichofoza futsi kusisusa. Elikhadini, siphambano lesincane eceleni kwesinamatseli siyasisusa. Kungeta nekususa kudzinga lilungelo lekushintja likhadi.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Likhadi lingaba netindzawo letinyenti, tindzawo lapho umsebenti wenteka khona, njengelihhovisi lelikhasimende, indzawo yekwakha noma indzawo yemcimbi. Ngayinye inelibito, likheli futsi, uma kwatiwa, tikhondinethi nelinki leVula kulibalave.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Gcwalisa libito lendzawo, likheli, i-latitude ne-longitude bese uchofoza Gcina. Kunamatsisela linki yelibalave kuvumela liwindi kutsi likutfolele indzawo, ngako kute lodzinga kubhala tikhondinethi. Kuchofoza indzawo elikhadini kuyivula futsi kute uyishintje noma uyisuse, kantsi siphambano eceleni kwayo siyisusa ngekushesha.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Kuncika kuhlanganisa lelikhadi nalamanye emakhadi: liyawavimba, livinjwa ngiwo, liyawalungisa, liyawaphindza noma liyahlobana nawo. Nekuncika kuvuliwe kuTilungiselelo Telilunga, kudvwetjwa njengemigca yemicibisholo lenemibala elibhodini lonkhe, ngako luhlelo lwemsebenti luyabonakala ngekushesha.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Khetsa luhlobo lwebudlelwane nembala, bese usesha uchofoze likhadi lofuna kulihlanganisa nalo. Linki ikhonjiswa kuKuncika kwelikhadi nanjengemugca elibhodini. Chofoza umugca, noma usebentise Kuncika kwelikhadi, kute ushintje luhlobo lwawo, umbala noma luphawu, noma kute uwususe. Ungaphindze udvonse sibambo sekuhlanganisa selikhadi lelincane uliyise kulelinye likhadi.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Tintfo tekwenta tishintja imigca yekwenta yemanothi emhlangano lanamatsiselwe ibe ngemakhadi. Imigca lefana ne-TODO: Bhukha indzawo, umugca wemsebenti longakaphawulwa, noma umugca lowucala ngekubita umuntfu itfolwa ngekwakheka kwayo, ngaphandle kwe-AI.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Liwindi libhala emakhadi lebekatawentiwa, ngalinye neluphawu nelilunga lelikhonjwa kubitwa. Susa luphawu kulokungakufuni bese uchofoza Dala. Emakhadi lamasha aya eluhlwini lolufanako nalelikhadi futsi abuyela kulo ngelinki. Kubitwa kuba lilunga kuphela uma lowo muntfu alilunga lelisebentako lelibhodi.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Umlandvo luhla lwalo lonkhe lushintjo lolwentiwe kulelikhadi: ngubani lowashintja yini, nini, futsi kusuka kuliphi linani kuya kuliphi. Nome nguluphi lushintjo lungakhetfwa lubuyiselwe, ngako liphutsa lingahlehliswa ngisho ngemuva.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Bhala kuSesha kute unciphise imigca, noma uchofoze i-avatar yemuntfu kute ubone lushintjo lwakhe kuphela. Hamba emakhasini ngemicibisholo. Phawula umugca munye noma ngetulu bese uchofoza Buyisela; imigca leminyenti ibuyiselwa lemidzala kucala njengelushintjo lunye, lolungahlehliswa ngekwalo. Ctrl+Z ne-Ctrl+Y nato tihlehlisa futsi tiphindze lushintjo lwakho lwakamuva.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Ikhodi ye-QR ikhombisa linki yalelikhadi njengekhodi longayiskena, kute uvule likhadi elucingweni noma kuthebhulethi ngaphandle kwekubhala likheli lalo. Ayishintji lutfo elikhadini.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Khombisa ikhamera yelucingo ekhodini bese uvula linki; likheli liphindze likhonjiswe njengembhalo ngaphansi kwayo. Ikhodi idvwetjwa esipheqululini sakho futsi kute lokutfunyelwa kunome kuphi. Nobe ngubani loyiskenako kusafanele angene futsi abe nekufinyelela elibhodini. Linki lendze kakhulu yekhodi ye-QR iyabikwa esikhundleni saloko.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Hambisa Likhadi lihambisa likhadi liye kulenye indzawo kulelibhodi noma kulelinye libhodi. Lenta loko lokwentiwa kudvonsa, ngisho nalapho kudvonsa kungafiki khona, njengakulelinye libhodi noma endzaweni lecondzile eluhlwini lolude.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Khetsa libhodi, umtsandvo neluhla, bese ukhetsa likhadi nekutsi uya etulu noma ngaphansi kwalo. Ungashintja sihloko, ubhale sizatfu sekuhambisa longasikhetsa, bese uphawula Shiya linki endzaweni yekucala kute ugcine likhadi lelihlanganisiwe lapho belikhona. Chofoza Kuphelile uma lapho uya khona sekulayishiwe. Shift+M nayo ivula lelo windi, futsi lapho uya khona kukhunjulwa ngelibhodi ngalinye.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Kopisha Likhadi kwenta likhophi lelisha, lelitimele lelikhadi kulelibhodi noma kulelinye, lenenombolo yalo nemakhophi alo emibono, tinhla tekuhlola, lokunamatsiselwe nemisebenti lemincane.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Hlela sihloko uma ufuna; sihloko lesingenalutfo asikopishi lutfo. Khetsa libhodi, umtsandvo neluhla, bese ukhetsa likhadi nekutsi likhophi liya etulu noma ngaphansi kwalo, bese uchofoza Kuphelile. Uma kukopisha kwaliwa, sizatfu sikhonjiswa lapha. Shift+C nayo ivula lelo windi, futsi lapho uya khona kukhunjulwa ngelibhodi ngalinye.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Kuphindzaphindza kwelikhadi kwenta i-WeKan idale likhophi lelisha lalelikhadi eluhlwini lolufanako ngeluhlelo, lemsebenti lophindzaphindzwako njengembiko wesimo waliviki noma i-invoyisi yenyanga lebeyitawudalwa kabusha ngesandla.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Khetsa Ngelilanga, Ngeliviki noma Ngenyanga, noma Cimile kute ukumise; Cimile ngulokujwayelekile. Isevha ibe seyenta emakhophi ngekwayo, ngaphandle kwekudzinga kuhlela lokunye. Kuyisa likhadi esigcinweni nako kulimisa kutsi lente emakhophi lamanyenti, ngisho nobe sikhatsi lesiphakatsi sisolo sibekiwe.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Kopisha Ithempuleti Kumakhadi Lamanyenti kwenta emakhophi lamanyenti alelikhadi kanyekanye. Likhadi lisebenta njengethempuleti: tinhla talo tekuhlola, lokunamatsiselwe, emalebula nalamanye tikhala kuya kulo lonkhe likhophi, kantsi sihloko nenchazelo kuphela lokwehlukile.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Ebhokisini lembhalo, bhala intfo yinye ngelikhadi ngalinye nesihloko salo nenchazelo, ulandzela sibonelo lesesigcwalisiwe. Khetsa libhodi, umtsandvo, luhla nendzawo eceleni kwelikhadi, bese uchofoza Kuphelile. Uma umbhalo ungakahleleki kahle, kute lokudalwako futsi liphutsa likhonjiswa lapha.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Beka umbala kunika likhadi umbala wangemuva walo kute libonakale elibhodini, sibonelo libovu emsebentini lophutfumako noma umbala welikhasimende. Umbhalo welikhadi wentiwa ufundzeke embaleni ngekutentekela.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Chofoza lomunye wemibala lenemabito, umbala wakho lesewusetjentisiwe kulelibhodi, noma ukhetse nome ngumuphi umbala ngaphansi kweMbala wakho, bese uchofoza Gcina. Susa kususa umbala. Umbala ukhonjiswa ekhadini lelincane nasekhadini lelivuliwe, ngaphandle kwekutsi ucinywe kuTilungiselelo Telibhodi / Likhadi.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Kudvweba kukuvumela kutsi udvwebe noma ubhale ngesandla elikhadini ngemakhondlo, ngemunwe noma ngelipeni: umdvwebo, umfanekiso, kusayina noma linothi lelibhalwe ngesandla. Umdvwebo uhlala uhleleka futsi sitfombe sawo sigcinwa njengalokunamatsiselwe elikhadini.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Khetsa umbala nebubanti bemugca bese uyadvweba. Hlehlisa kubuyela emuva sinyatselo, Sesuli sisusa imigca lesiyitsintsako kantsi Sula kususa konkhe. Gcina kugcina imigca elikhadini futsi kugcina sitfombe njengalokunamatsiselwe; umdvwebo lomusha uba sitfombe sesembeso selikhadi. Imidvwebo legciniwe ibhalwe lapha kute uphindze uyivule uyihlele, kantsi Layisha njenge-SVG kugcina munye njengelifayela.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Lokunyenti kukhombisa linki yelikhadi, emakhadi alo labatali nekutsi ladalwa nini. Kulapho likhadi lentiwa khona umsebenti lomncane walelinye likhadi, futsi lapho umlawuli welibhodi asusa khona likhadi phakadze.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Kopisha linki yelikhadi ku-clipboard kukopisha likheli lelikhadi. Ngaphansi kweShintja lotali welikhadi, khetsa libhodi lemtfombo nelikhadi lelitali, noma kute kute uphindze ulente libe likhadi lelisetulu. Ngeta lelinye likhadi lelitali kungeta labatali labanyenti, kantsi siphambano eceleni kwalinye siyalisusa. Susa, kubalawuli belibhodi kuphela, kususa likhadi phakadze emva kwekucinisekisa.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Dala libhodi kusuka kulelikhadi kushintja likhadi libe linki yelibhodi lelisha. Kwelikhadi lelikhule laba ngumklamo walo: umsebenti uya elibhodini lawo, kantsi likhadi lihlala lapho belikhona njengendlela yekungena kulo.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Libito lelibhodi lelisha ligcwaliswa ngesihloko selikhadi; lishintje uma ufuna bese ucindzetela Dala libhodi kusuka kulelikhadi. Libhodi lidalwa nawe ungumlawuli walo, bese likhadi livula lelo libhodi. Kute lokunye lokushintjako elikhadini. Uma kwaliwa, sizatfu siyakhonjiswa futsi kute lokushintjako.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Hlanganisa nelibhodi kubeka likhadi lelihlanganisiwe lalelikhadi kulelinye libhodi lelikhona. Likhadi libe selikhonjiswa kuwo womabili emabhodi: lekucala lihlala lapho likhona, kantsi linki ikhombisa lokukulo lapho uyibeke khona.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Khetsa libhodi, umtsandvo neluhla, bese ukhetsa likhadi nekutsi linki iya etulu noma ngaphansi kwalo, bese uchofoza Kuphelile. Eluhlwini lolungenalutfo linki iya phansi. Likhadi lekucala alishintjwa, futsi emalebula awakopishwa. Lapho uya khona kukhunjulwa ngelibhodi ngalinye.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Imenyu yelikhadi, Tento Telikhadi, ihlanganisa konkhe longakwenta ngelikhadi lonkhe, esikhundleni sekwenta ngesinye setikhala talo. Kutsi ngutiphi tintfo letivelako kuncike endzimeni yakho elibhodini.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Hambisa ukopishe kune-Hambisa Likhadi, Kopisha Likhadi, Gcina njengeThempuleti, Kopisha Ithempuleti Kumakhadi Lamanyenti, Kuphindzaphindza kwelikhadi nekuhambisa etulu noma phansi kweluhla. Bese kuta Buka neNkhanyeti, nekubonakala nekuBeka umbala, Kudvweba naKudala emakhadi kusuka etintfweni tekwenta. Kwabelana kunelinki yelikhadi, Hlanganisa nelibhodi, ikhodi ye-QR nemLandvo, bese kuTfumela naKungenisa. Sigcinwa sine-Yisa likhadi esigcinweni, Lokunyenti naDala libhodi kusuka kulelikhadi.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Sigaba seNguculo sikhombisa kutsi le-WeKan isebentisa yini: inguculo ye-WeKan nekutsi yafakwa njani, luhlelo lwekusebenta, i-Meteor, i-database ne-Node.js. Sigaba sekucala seIphaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo futsi ngulwati lwekukopisha embikweni wephutsa uma ucela lusito.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Fundza lithebula, lelihlelwe libe yi-Platform, OS, Meteor, Database ne-Node. Cindzetela Hlola Inguculo kute ucatsanise netinguculo letinsha leti-khululiwe te-WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node ne-NPM; ngesikhatsi isebenta isho kutsi iyalayisha, futsi uma kuhlola kwehluleka ubona umlayeto munye wekwehluleka esikhundleni saloko.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Kubonakala kunquma kutsi le-WeKan ibukeka njani nekutsi Onkhe emabhodi akhombisa yini: tincenye letifihliwe njengemabhodi emphakatsi noma imisebenti yelibhodi, ngubani longadala emabhodi, indlela yelusuku, kutsi imininingwane yelikhadi ivuleka ibe banti kangakanani, emakheli emalinki, kuhlanganisa ngekutentekela kwesilandzeleli tinkinga sangaphandle, libito lemkhicito, imibala nema-logo.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Shintja tikhala telicembu linye bese ucindzetela Gcina lelicembu lelo, lekugcina lelo licembu kuphela. Timphawu ngaphansi kwe-Onkhe emabhodi: Fihla tisho kutsi intfo ifihliwe, ngaphandle kwemabhodi wonkhe umsebentisi longenile langawahlela, laphawulwa uma kuvunyelwe. Shintja Umbala uyagcina ngaphandle kwenkinobho Gcina futsi ngulo kuphela licembu umlawuli wenhlangano ngekwakhe lalibonako.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Tinsita yindzawo lapho umlawuli weiwebhusayithi avula noma acime tincenye leti-khetfwako te-WeKan yonkhe: imibono yelibhodi, basiti, emathulusi e-Kanban ne-Scrum, tikhala temakhadi, Umtfwalo wemsebenti nemandla, Sabelomali nekukhokhisa, i-SQRL, i-ActivityPub, Imitsetfo lefundvwako kuphela nema-API lavumelanako leti-khetfwako. Imitsandvo netinhla tihlala tikhona.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Susa luphawu kulokungafanele kunikwe yile-WeKan, kufaka ekhatsi tikhala temakhadi lokute libhodi lelifanele kutikhombisa, bese ucindzetela Gcina. Lusito lolususwe luphawu luyanyamalala esikhombisini sabo bonkhe futsi isevha nayo iyalwala, kodvwa idatha yalo iyagcinwa. Ungadzinga kuvunywa kwetinsita letingetwa kubuyeketwa kwe-WeKan, futsi ubitise basebentisi bekuhlola labasolo babona tinsita leticinyiwe.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Iphrofayili yetinsita inika basebentisi lakhetsiwe, emacembu noma tinhlangano i-WeKan lencane ngekubafihlela letinye tinsita leti-khetfwako, kantsi bonkhe labanye basolo babona konkhe. Ingafihla tinsita letifanako lesigaba seTinsita lesingaticima.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Cindzetela Ngeta iphrofayili, uyinike libito, uphawule tinsita leyitifihlako bese ubhala basebentisi bayo, emacembu netinhlangano, bese ucindzetela Gcina sesigaba. Emabito langafananga nalutfo ayabikwa emva kwekugcina futsi awagcinwa. Ema-phrofayili ayalingwa ngeluhlelo lwelikhasi, futsi imenyu yelilunga yemsebentisi imtjela kutsi nguyiphi iphrofayili lefihla tinsita letingakhi.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Kuvikeleka kubamba tishintji teisevha yonkhe tekutsi umbhalo lohlelekile ungentani nekutsi yini lengangeniswa noma itfunyelwe. Tisebentise kute umise emalinki lachofozekako, ukhombise wonkhe umbhalo lohlelekile njengemtfombo locacile, uvimbe kungenisa noma kutfumela, ubeke umkhawulo webukhulu bekungenisa, ushiye ngaphandle ema-avatar, noma ushintje bunjalo bebasebentisi beliciniso ngemabito langatiwa.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Phawula sishintji futsi sigcinwa ngekushesha; bukhulu lobukhulu bekungenisa bugcinwa uma ushiya sikhala, futsi linani lelingenalutfo lisho kutsi kute umkhawulo. Sishintji ngasinye sicinyiwe ngalokujwayelekile futsi siphoceleliswa yisevha, ngako kungenisa noma kutfumela lokucinyiwe kuyaliwa ngisho nangabe umuntfu akubita ngco.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Tishintji letintsatfu teisevha yonkhe teiwebhusayithi lekufanele tibeke umkhawulo ekulandzeleleni imisebenti: misa kubhala kutsi ngubani lowenta yini, misa kutfumela tatiso ngemisebenti, noma umise basebentisi kutsi babuke emabhodi, tinhla nemakhadi.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Phawula sishintji futsi sigcinwa ngekushesha. Nemisebenti icinyiwe, kute lokusha lokubhalwako futsi lokukhona akusakhonjiswa. Netatiso ticinyiwe, kute tatiso tangekhatsi kweluhlelo, te-imeyili noma letinye letitfunyelwako. Nekubuka kucinyiwe, kute longashintja lizinga lekubuka. Susa luphawu kute uphindze ukuvule; imisebenti lengakabhalwa ngalesosikhatsi ayibuyi.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Kususa ku-WeKan ngalokujwayelekile kuphawula kuphela tinhla, emakhadi nalokunamatsiselwe njengakususiwe kute kubuyiselwe. Lesi sigaba sibamba sishintji sinye lesivumela umlawuli weiwebhusayithi kutsi acitse lokukhona lokunjalo phakadze.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Phawula Vula kususa phakadze kuMlawuli Jikelele; kuyagcina ngekushesha futsi akususi lutfo ngekwako. Timphawu tekususa tibe setivela lapho kususa phakadze kunikwa khona, njengeluhla emgcomeni wetibi noma libhodi lelisesigcinweni kusigcinwa sa-Onkhe emabhodi. Lushintjo ngalunye lwesilungiselelo nekulinga ngakunye kwekususa phakadze kubhalwa kuKubuyisela. Susa luphawu uma usucedzile.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Libha leiwebhusayithi yonkhe lekutjela bonkhe basebentisi labangenile lokutsite kanyekanye, njengekuphumula kwekulungisa, likheli lelisha noma lushintjo lwemgomo. Ihlukile esatisweni selibhodi ngekwalo.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Phawula Satiso Lesisebentako Seluhlelo Lonkhe, bhala umlayeto bese ucindzetela Gcina. Libha livela etulu eKhaya, ku-Onkhe emabhodi nasemabhodini basebentisi labangemalunga awo. Umsebentisi angalivala, futsi lihlala livalekile kuye kuze ushintje umbhalo. Susa luphawu elibhokisini kute ulisuse kubo bonkhe.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Likhasi lekufinyeleleka kulapho le-WeKan itjela khona basebentisi bayo kutsi ifinyeleleka kangakanani nekutsi bachumane nabani mayelana nesivimbelo. Lesi sigaba sivula lelo khasi futsi sibeke sihloko salo nalokukulo.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Phawula Likhasi lekufinyeleleka livuliwe, lekugcina ngekushesha, bese ubhala sihloko nalokukulo bese ucindzetela Gcina. Lokukulo kuhlelwa njengenchazelo yelikhadi. Emalunga elibhodi abe satfola linki yeKufinyeleleka kulibha yasecaleni yesekudla yelibhodi. Susa luphawu kute uphindze ufihle linki.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Imibhalo yekuhumusha lekhetsekile inqoba imibhalo leyakhelwe ngekhatsi ye-WeKan kulesisetjentiswa, ngalulwimi ngalunye, sibonelo kute usebentise ligama lenhlangano yakho lelibhodi noma ulungise umbhalo ngaphambi kwekutsi kufike kuhumusha lokulungisiwe.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Cindzetela Lokusha, khetsa lulwimi, faka sikhiya semugca lofuna kuwushintja (hhayi umusho wesiNgisi) nembhalo lofanele kukhonjiswa esikhundleni sawo, bese uGcina. Umbhalo wekuhumusha wemugca lokhona kuphela longahlelwa, futsi umugca ungasuswa kuyimenyu yawo. Lokunqobako kusebenta embhalweni lowentiwa yisevha, njengema-imeyili; esipheqululini kwanyalo kukhonjiswa kubalawuli beiwebhusayithi kuphela.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Sigaba se-PWA silawula kutsi tiphequluli nemacingo kufundza yini nge-WeKan ngekwayo: ema-meta nema-link tag lengetiwe kuwo onkhe emakhasi, i-manifest yewebhu lesetjentiswa uma i-WeKan ifakwa njenge-aphu, kanye nelifayela lemalinki ema-aphu e-Android lelivumela i-aphu ye-Android kutsi ivule emalinki e-WeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Phawula incenye lofuna kuyihlela ngendlela yakho, lekugcina ngekushesha, namatsisela ema-tag akho noma i-JSON bese ucindzetela Gcina. I-JSON lengakalungi iyaliwa futsi kute lokugcinwako. Ema-meta tag engetwa njengema-meta element kuphela, ngako imibhalo, tindlela nema-tag lavuselela likhasi ayasuswa. Nesishintji sicinyiwe, i-WeKan isebentisa lokujwayelekile kwayo lokwakhelwe ngekhatsi.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Ema-webhook emhlaba wonkhe atfumela umlayeto kulelinye likheli, njengengcoco noma isevha yekutentekela, nobe nini uma kwenteka lokutsite kunome nguliphi libhodi lale-WeKan. Asebentisa lifomu lelifanako nema-webhook elibhodi ngekwalo. Sigaba siphindze sibhale ema-host angekhatsi ema-webhook langawafinyelela kanye ne-webhook yekungena neyekubhalisa.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Gcwalisa lifomu lelingenalutfo ngelibito, likheli, lithokheni longalikhetsa neluhlobo, ngendlela yinye noma ngetindlela letimbili, bese ucindzetela Dala. Ku-webhook legciniwe ungayicima, ukhetse kutsi itfumela miphi imisebenti nekutsi iletsa njani, bese uGcina. Bhala ema-host enethiwekhi ye-WeKan ngekwayo ngaphansi kweTindzawo tangekhatsi, linye ngemugca, ngako ema-webhook avunyelwe kuwafinyelela.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Emalebula labelwana ngawo anika lilebula libito linye nembala munye emabhodini lamanyenti kanyekanye: kuwo onkhe emabhodi, emabhodini enhlangano, noma emabhodini elicembu. Wasebentise emalebula lanjenga Kuphutfumako noma Likhasimende lafanele kubukeka ngendlela lefanako yonkhe indzawo.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Ngeta lilebula emugceni wekugcina ngelibito, umbala nekhathalogi, bese ucindzetela Ngeta lilebula lelabelwana ngalo; umugca ngamunye uyagcina noma uyasusa ngekwawo. Emalebuleni elikhadi, emalunga elibhodi abona emalebula labelwana ngawo libhodi labo lelingawasebentisa futsi achofoze linye kute aligete. Kushintja libito noma umbala lapha kulishintja kuwo onkhe emabhodi, futsi kulisusa kulishiya kulawo emabhodi njengelilebula lawo.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Sigaba se-imeyili sibeka kutsi i-WeKan itfumela njani liposi, kungaba ngetilungiselelo teposi teisevha ngekwayo noma ngemhlinzeki lohlelwe lapha, futsi sibamba tilungiselelo letihlobene: kutsi ngusiphi sizinda se-imeyili lesingamema bantfu uma kutibhalisa kucinyiwe, kutsi basebentisi bangalishintja yini likheli labo, kutsi kwentiwani ngeliposi lelibuyile, kanye nemathempuleti e-imeyili yesimemo neyemisebenti.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Phawula Vula ngaphansi kwetilungiselelo te-imeyili, khetsa i-SMTP noma umhlinzeki lowakhelwe ngekhatsi, gcwalisa libito lemsebentisi, iphasiwedi nelikheli lemtfumeli bese ucindzetela Gcina; iphasiwedi legciniwe iyagcinwa uma sikhala sishiywa singenalutfo. Titfumelele i-imeyili yekuhlola kute uhlole kutsi iyasebenta. Ngaphandle kweluphawu, tilungiselelo teposi teisevha ngekwayo tisolo tisetjentiswa. Tikhala temathempuleti letingenalutfo tigcina ema-imeyili lakhelwe ngekhatsi.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Lokujwayelekile kwatatiso teiwebhusayithi yonkhe: kutsi lithileyi letatiso langekhatsi kweluhlelo ne-imeyili kuvuliwe noma kucinyiwe kubo bonkhe, nekutsi i-imeyili, lithileyi nema-webhook laphumako kuletsa njani ngalokujwayelekile. Tilungiselelo telibhodi netilungiselelo telilunga ngalinye tingakunqoba ebubanti bato.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Khetsa Yebo noma Cha kuLithileyi letatiso nakuyi-imeyili; lokukhetsile kugcinwa ngekushesha. Vula indlela yekutfumela kute ubeke kuhleleka kwayo, kutsi ikhombisani, kutsi tatiso tihlanganiswa njani nekutsi titfunyelwa nini, ngamunye ugcinwa ngekushesha. Balawuli belibhodi nemalunga bangakhetsa Lokujwayelekile kute babuyele kuloko lokubekile lapha. Tilungiselelo te-imeyili kuya elikhadini tikulesigaba lesifanako.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Tizinda tibhala sonkhe sizinda se-imeyili lesisetjentiswa ngema-akhawunti kule-WeKan, nekutsi ngasinye sinebasebentisi labangakhi. Kuyindlela lesheshako yekubona kutsi ngutiphi tinhlangano letikulesisetjentiswa nekubona sizinda lesingalindzelekile ngaphandle kwekufundza luhla lonkhe lwebasebentisi.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Fundza lithebula, umugca munye ngesizinda ngasinye nelinani lebasebentisi baso. Bhala incenye yesizinda ebhokisini lekusesha bese ucindzetela Enter kute usitfole, bese uhamba emkhatsini wemakhasi ngetinkinobho Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako. Kute lokugcinwako; lithebula libalwa kabusha ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi likhonjiswa.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Tinhlangano tihlanganisa basebentisi ngenkampani, umnyango noma likhasimende kute emabhodi nemabhodi ematempuleti abelwane nabo bonkhe, emalunga abo angahlala avumelana nemkhombandlela lofana ne-LDAP, futsi, nekuba nebaniniyo labanyenti, inhlangano ingaba netizinda tayo, luphawu lwayo nebalawuli bayo.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Chofoza Lokusha enhloko yelikholamu lekucala kute udale yinye, Hlela kute ushintje umugca, nemenyu yemugca kute uwususe noma ukhetse balawuli benhlangano. Tishintji temugca temathempuleti labelwana ngawo, tekungeta emalunga emabhodini netekuvumelanisa emalunga kusuka kumhlinzeki wekungena tigcina ngekushesha. Phawula Ngeta emalunga elibhodi kusuka eNhlanganweni yinye kuphela kute ubeke umkhawulo wekutsi ngubani longangetwa emabhodini.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Emacembu ahlanganisa basebentisi labasebenta ndzawonye kute libhodi noma emabhodi ematempuleti abelwane nelicembu lonkhe, emalunga angahlala avumelana nemkhombandlela lofana ne-LDAP, futsi luhla lweBantfu lungancishiswa lube licembu linye. Asebenta njengetinhlangano ngaphandle kwencenye yeniniyo.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Chofoza Lokusha enhloko yelikholamu lekucala kute udale licembu, Hlela kute ulishintje, noma imenyu yemugca kute ulisuse. Tishintji temugca tigcina ngekushesha. Kute ufake bantfu emacenjini, baphawule kuPhaneli yemlawuli / Bantfu / Bantfu bese uchofoza Emacembu. Phawula Ngeta emalunga elibhodi kusuka eLicenjini linye kuphela kute ubeke umkhawulo wekutsi ngubani longangetwa emabhodini.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Bantfu kubhala yonkhe i-akhawunti kule-WeKan ne-imeyili yayo, simo sekuba ngumlawuli, iphrofayili yetinsita, simo sekusebenta, emave lengena kuwo, simo sekukhiywa, umsebenti wakamuva nelusuku lekudalwa. Kulapho udala khona, uhlele, ucime, uvule, utentisa njengemunye, wente kungatiwa futsi ususe ema-akhawunti.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Sesha ngelibito lemsebentisi, libito noma i-imeyili bese ucindzetela Enter, futsi unciphise ngeKhombisa neLicembu. Chofoza Lokusha kute udale umsebentisi naHlela kute ushintje lomunye. Chofoza luphawu lwekusebenta kute ucime noma uvule, nesikhiya lesibovu noma Vula Bonkhe kute uvule. Imenyu yemugca ine-kutentisa njengemunye, kwenta kungatiwa nekususa; phawula bantfu labanyenti bese uchofoza Emacembu kute ushintje emacembu abo.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Kuvikela ekuhlaselweni ngemandla kukhiya i-akhawunti emva kwekulinga kwekungena lokunyenti lokwehlulekile. Lesi sigaba sibeka kutsi kwehluleka lokungakhi kubangela kukhiywa, kutsi kuhlala sikhatsi lesingakanani nesikhatsi lapho kwehluleka kubalwa khona, ngalokuhlukile kumabito ebasebentisi lakhona nakulawo langekho.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Gcwalisa kwehluleka, sikhatsi sekukhiywa nesikhatsi sekubala, ngemasekhendi, kubasebentisi labatiwako nalabangatiwa bese ucindzetela Gcina; emanani lamasha asebenta ngekushesha ngaphandle kwekucala kabusha. Kute ubone futsi ukhulule ema-akhawunti lakhiyiwe, vula Iphaneli yemlawuli / Bantfu / Bantfu, khetsa Basebentisi Labakhiyiwe Kuphela bese uchofoza sikhiya lesibovu, noma Vula Bonkhe.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Lirekhodi lekuhlola ngumkhondvo walokwentiwa balawuli beiwebhusayithi, lokusha kucala: nini, ngubani, ngusiphi sento, nekutsi saphumelela yini, imininingwane yaso nelikheli lesivela kulo. Liphendvula kutsi ngubani lowashintja lokutsite futsi nini kutilungiselelo tebantfu, tekungena, tekugcina netekulondvoloza.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Fundza lithebula leNini, Umlawuli, Sento, Imininingwane ne-IP; sento lesaliwe siphawulwa ngeliphutsa laso. Bhala ebhokisini lekusesha kute unciphise imigca ngemlawuli, ngesento noma ngemininingwane, bese usebentisa imicibisholo ngaphansi kwelithebula kute uhambe emkhatsini wemakhasi.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Tindzima tinquma kutsi ngutiphi tindzima telibhodi letingamema bantfu elibhodini, tikuvumela kutsi wakhe tindzima letikhetsekile ngaloko lilunga lelibhodi lelingakwenta, futsi tikhombisa kutsi indzima ngayinye ingentani. Balawuli beiwebhusayithi bahlala banawo onkhe emalungelo.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Ngaphansi kweVumela Kumema eLibhodini, phawula tindzima letingamema bese ucindzetela Gcina. Ngaphansi kweTindzima letikhetsekile, bhala libito, phawula loko indzima lengakwenta bese ucindzetela Ngeta indzima; umugca ngamunye uyagcina noma uyasusa ngekwawo, futsi balawuli belibhodi bangabe sebanika emalunga lendzima. Lithebula leSimo seTindzima likhombisa umphumela wetimphawu takho, ngisho ngaphambi kwekutsi ugcine.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Emathempuleti labelwana ngawo akuvumela kutsi ubuke emabhodi ematempuleti ebasebentisi langabelwana ngawo ngenhlangano, ngelicembu noma ngesizinda se-imeyili. Timphawu tiphindze tinqume kutsi ngutiphi tinhlobo temacembu libhodi lethempuleti lingabelwana nawo kusuka ku-Onkhe emabhodi / Emathempuleti.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Phawula Tinhlangano, Emacembu noma Tizinda; luphawu ngalunye lugcina ngekushesha kulesisetjentiswa sonkhe. Ngaphansi kwebubanti ngabunye lobuphawuliwe ubona onkhe emacembu, basebentisi bawo nemabhodi abo ematempuleti, futsi kuchofoza libhodi lethempuleti kulivula. Kutsi emathempuleti elicembu linye ayafika yini emalungeni alo kubekwa ngenhlangano nangelicembu etigabeni tato.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Kungena kunquma kutsi yini levunyelwe ekungeneni, njengekukhohlwa iphasiwedi, kutibhalisa, kushintja libito lemsebentisi, kususa i-akhawunti yakho nesikhetsi sendlela. Kuphindze kukuvumele kutsi unqobe tilungiselelo tekungena teisevha ngaphandle kwekucala kabusha, sibonelo kungena ngephasiwedi, indlela lejwayelekile, budze besikhatsi, kuphuma ngekutentekela, imitsetfo yephasiwedi nekucinisekisa ngetinyatselo letimbili lokuphocelelwe.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Phawula noma ususe luphawu emabhokisini eKungena: Vumela; ngalinye ligcina uma lichofozwa. Nekutibhalisa kucinyiwe, sebentisa Mema Bantfu kute umeme emakheli emabhodini lakhetsiwe. Efomini yetilungiselelo sikhala ngasinye sisho kutsi ngumuphi linani lelisebentako; bhala noma ukhetse linani bese ugcina, noma ukushiye kungenalutfo noma ukhetse Lokujwayelekile kute ubuyele etilungiselelweni teisevha. Indlela ngayinye yekungena inesigaba sayo kuyimenyu yeBantfu.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Kungena nge-SAML kuvumela bantfu kutsi bangene ngemhlinzeki webunjalo wenhlangano yakho esikhundleni sephasiwedi ye-WeKan. Umhlinzeki ucinisekisa kutsi bangobani ngemlayeto losayiniwe futsi i-WeKan iyabangenisa, idale i-akhawunti ekungeneni kwekucala.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Faka likheli lekungena lemhlinzeki webunjalo nesitifiketi sekusayina, libito lemkhiphi wale-WeKan naletinye tinketfo kulesi sigaba, noma etilungiselelweni teisevha; linani lelagcinwa lapha linqoba leleisevha. Nakuvuliwe, likhasi lekungena likhombisa inkinobho Ngena nge-SAML leyisa umsebentisi kumhlinzeki webunjalo bese imbuyisa.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Kungena nge-LDAP kuvumela bantfu kutsi bangene ngelibito lemsebentisi nephasiwedi lasebanayo kumkhombandlela wakho, njenge-Active Directory noma i-OpenLDAP. I-WeKan ihlola iphasiwedi ngekumkhombandlela, idale i-akhawunti ekungeneni kwekucala futsi ingagcina emabito, ema-imeyili, simo sekuba ngumlawuli, tinhlangano nemacembu kuvumelana nemkhombandlela.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Gcwalisa likheli lemkhombandlela, iphothi, kubetela, sisekelo nekutsi basebentisi baseshwa njani, bese ugcina; linani lelagcinwa linqoba tilungiselelo teisevha kantsi Lokujwayelekile kubuyisela linani leisevha. Cindzetela Hlola Kuchumana kwe-LDAP kute ulinge tilungiselelo letisebentako, naVumelanisa basebentisi be-LDAP nyalo kute usebentise kuvumelanisa kwangemuva ngekushesha. Khetsa i-LDAP njengendlela lejwayelekile esigabeni seKungena.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Kungena nge-OAuth2 ne-OpenID Connect kuvumela bantfu kutsi bangene nge-akhawunti kulolunye lusito, njenge-Keycloak, Authelia noma i-GitLab, esikhundleni sephasiwedi ye-WeKan. Ngalokwehlukile kubahlinzeki bekungena bemphakatsi labamisiwe, ungakukhombisa kunome ngumuphi umhlinzeki ngekunika emakheli akhe.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Bhalisa i-WeKan njenge-aphu kumhlinzeki, bese ufaka i-id yeklayenti yayo, imfihlo, likheli leisevha, emaphuzu ekugcina nekutsi tikhala temsebentisi wayo tihlobana njani ne-WeKan lapha; linani lelagcinwa lapha linqoba tilungiselelo teisevha futsi lisebenta ekungeneni lokulandzelako ngaphandle kwekucala kabusha. Likhasi lekungena libe selikhombisa inkinobho yekungena lenembhalo lobekwa esigabeni seKungena.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: I-CAS luhlelo lwekungena kanye: bantfu bangena kanye kuyisevha ye-CAS yenhlangano yakho, futsi i-WeKan iyalitsemba lithikithi leyilibuyisako, ngako i-WeKan ayikayiboni iphasiwedi.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Faka emakheli esisekelo, ekungena nekucinisekisa eisevha ye-CAS lapha bese uyayivula; linani lelagcinwa lapha linqoba tilungiselelo teisevha. Khetsa i-CAS njengendlela lejwayelekile esigabeni seKungena, noma uvumele basebentisi bayikhetse esikhetsini sendlela. Kungena kuyisa siphequluli elikhasini lekungena le-CAS bese kubuyela ku-WeKan, sewungenile.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Kungena ngenhloko kuvumela i-proxy lephambene letsembekile leseyentile kungena kanye kutsi itjele i-WeKan kutsi umsebentisi ngubani, ngako umsebentisi uyangena ngaphandle kwephasiwedi futsi i-akhawunti idalwa ekuvakasheleni kwekucala.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Leti tilungiselelo tikhonjiswa lapha tifundvwa kuphela futsi atikwati kugcinwa kusuka kuPhaneli yemlawuli, ngoba i-proxy letsembekile ingangena njengome ngubani; tibekwa etilungiselelweni teisevha nekucala kabusha. I-proxy kufanele icinisekise umsebentisi, itfumele tinhloko tebunjalo futsi isuse tinhloko letinjalo letitfunyelwa ngemaklayenti, futsi kutsenjwa emakheli e-proxy labhaliwe kuphela.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Leti tinkinobho tekungena temphakatsi letilungiselelwe: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo neMeetup. Ngayinye idzinga kuphela i-id ye-aphu nemfihlo lonikwa yona ngumhlinzeki, futsi tingasetjentiswa ndzawonye nekungena nge-OAuth2 lokujwayelekile.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Dala i-aphu kuwebhusayithi yebatfutfukisi bemhlinzeki nelikheli lekubuyisela le-WeKan, bese ufaka i-id yayo nemfihlo lapha bese uvula umhlinzeki; linani lelagcinwa lapha linqoba tilungiselelo teisevha. Inkinobho Ngena nga yalowo mhlinzeki ibe seyivela elikhasini lekungena.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Kungena ngaphandle kwephasiwedi kuvumela umsebentisi kutsi angene ngekhodi yekusetjentiswa kanye i-WeKan leyimtfumelela yona nge-imeyili, esikhundleni sephasiwedi. Kulula kubantfu labakhohlwa emaphasiwedi, akusiso sinyatselo sesibili, futsi kuphephile njengelibhokisi leposi lemsebentisi kuphela.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Cinisekisa kutsi i-imeyili lephumako iyasebenta, bese ukuvula lapha; linani lelagcinwa lapha linqoba tilungiselelo teisevha. Likhasi lekungena libe selinikela ngekutfumela ikhodi yekungena nge-imeyili: umsebentisi ubhala likheli lakhe, atfole ikhodi lesebenta sikhatsi lesifishane, ayifake bese uyangena.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Kulondvoloza kutsatsa ingobolwane yale-WeKan nyalo noma ngeluhlelo, nedatha yembhalo, lokunamatsiselwe nema-avatar njengetinketfo letehlukene, futsi kuyayibuyisela. Umlawuli weiwebhusayithi ulondvoloza lesisetjentiswa sonkhe noma inhlangano yinye; umlawuli wenhlangano ngekwakhe ulondvoloza emabhodi ayo kuphela. Kulondvoloza lokuchubekako esikhundleni saloko kugeleta lushintjo ngalunye ngako ungabuyisela kunome nguyiphi sikhatsi.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Khetsa bubanti, phawula lokufanele kufakwe bese ucindzetela Londvoloza nyalo; kulondvoloza lokuphelele kudzinga tontsatfu nesisetjentiswa sonkhe. Beka luhlelo lwelilanga, leliviki noma lwenyanga bese uGcina. Cindzetela Bhala kulondvoloza bese ubuyisela kunye, kungaba ngekungeta idatha lengekho kuphela noma ngekushintja konkhe. KuKulondvoloza lokuchubekako, beka lifolda lekuya kulo, lokufakwako nesikhatsi sekugcina, bese ukhetsa liphuzu lekubuyisela.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Tigaba teLokunamatsiselwe tinquma kutsi lokunamatsiselwe emakhadini nema-avatar kugcinwa kuphi, kungaba kukhulu kangakanani, kugcinwa sikhatsi lesingakanani nekutsi kuhamba njani emkhatsini wetindzawo tekugcina. Emafayela angagcinwa kudiski yeisevha, ku-database noma endzaweni yekugcina yelifu njenge-S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage noma i-WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Khetsa sigaba kuyimenyu yesancele. Beka indzawo yekugcina emafayela lamasha laya kuyo, hlela indzawo yekugcina ngayinye ngetishintji tayo tekufundza nekubhala, bese uhambisa lokunamatsiselwe noma ema-avatar kusuka kulenye indzawo yekugcina kuya kulenye. Imikhawulo ibeka bukhulu bekulayisha, Kugcina kususa lokunamatsiselwe lokudzala emva kwemalanga latsite, kantsi Kuhambisa i-database kuhambisa idatha yembhalo emkhatsini we-MongoDB ne-FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Likhasi lekucala leIphaneli yemlawuli / Tinkinga nekuhlola kwakho kwemalanga onkhe kweisevha yonkhe. Likutjela kutsi yini lesebentako nyalo, yini lengalungi nyalo nekutsi umbiko ngamunye uhlanganise tinkinga letinsha letingakhi, netinkinobho tekutilungisa noma tekutivuma.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Simo sibhala kuhambisa nekulungisa lokuchubekako, lokungehlisa kungena, kulandzelwe yinkinga ngayinye nelinani nalokufanele kwentiwe, kanye nenkinobho Lungisa emakhadi laphukile, Buyisela noma Lungisa lapho kufanele khona. Kulungisa lokususa idatha kukucela kutsi uchofoze Cinisekisa kucala. Ngaphansi kweMpilo yedatha, Cala kusebentisa kuskena kwangemuva. Ngaphansi kweTinkinga, phawula imibiko loyibuyeketile bese ucindzetela Vuma kute usethe kabusha linani lato letinsha, noma Sula kute ususe imigca yato.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Kulinga ngakunye umlindzi wekuvikeleka lakwalako noma lakubonile: bekuyini, kubi kangakanani, ngubani lowakulinga, kusuka kuphi nekutsi kangakhi. Kukhombisa kutsi kukhona lowalinga, hhayi kuphela kutsi imbobo ivaliwe. Tishintji tekuvikeleka ngekwato tikuPhaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo / Kuvikeleka.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Imigca ibhalwa lemisha kucala, futsi kulinga lokuphindzaphindzwako kungumugca munye lonelinani lekulinga lelikhulako, kantsi Imininingwane isho kutsi umlindzi ubonani. Bhala libito, sigaba, umtfombo, libito lemsebentisi noma likheli ebhokisini lekusesha kute uhlunge njengoba ubhala, bese uchofoza libito lemsebentisi kute uvule leyo akhawunti. Vuma noma usule umbiko ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Umkhondvo wekuhlola webalawuli labenta njengalabanye basebentisi. Kutentisa njengemunye kuvumela umlawuli kutsi abone i-WeKan njengoba umsebentisi munye ayibona, sibonelo kute atfumele libhodi langasese, futsi lombiko ugcina lawo mandla abonakala ngemuva.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Umugca ubhalwa uma umlawuli akhetsa Tentisa njengemsebentisi kuPhaneli yemlawuli / Bantfu, adala lithokheni lekungena lalomunye umsebentisi nge-REST API, noma atfumela libhodi, likhadi noma lokunamatsiselwe ngesikhatsi atentisa njengemunye. Umugca ngamunye ukhombisa lusuku, umlawuli, umsebentisi lotentiswa njengaye, libhodi nesizatfu, lokusha kucala. Chofoza libito kute uvule lowo msebentisi, bese usesha nge-Enter. Kute lapha lokushintja noma lokususa umugca.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Kukhombisa kutsi ngubani longena ngephasiwedi lemfisha kunebudze lobuncane, kusuka kuphi, nekutsi uyishintjile yini kusukela lapho. Ungabona kutsi ngubani lobekatawutsintseka ngaphambi kwekutsi uphocelele budze lobuncane bemaphasiwedi lamasha.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Beka Budze lobuncane bephasiwedi, phawula Phocelela budze lobuncane kute wale emaphasiwedi lamasha lamafisha, bese ucindzetela Gcina. Kungena akukaze kwaliwe, kodvwa nekuphocelela kuvuliwe, i-akhawunti lenephasiwedi lendzala lemfisha icelwa kutsi iyishintje kucala. Lithebula linemugca munye nge-akhawunti ngayinye nekungena kwekucala nekwekugcina, emakheli, linani lekungena nekutsi yalungiswa nini. Hlunga ngeIphasiwedi lemfisha kakhulu, Kulungiswe kwaba yiphasiwedi lende ngalokwenele noma Konkhe. Ema-akhawunti langena nge-LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS noma Sandstorm awabhalwa.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Kuchaza kutsi i-WeKan ilayisha njani emakhadi elibhodi, loku lokunquma kutsi kuvula libhodi lelikhulu kubita malini. Kuyinchazelo nje kuphela, kute lokuchofozwako noma lokugcinwako.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Kulayishwa kwemakhadi kwenteka ngekutentekela kulibhodi ngalinye: libhodi lelinemakhadi langetulu kwa-500 lilayisha kuphela emakhadi labonakalako eluhlwini ngalunye njengoba wehla, nemanani lavela kusevha, kantsi libhodi lelincane lilayisha onkhe emakhadi. Umsebentisi weisevha angaphocelela kulayisha konkhe noma kulayisha kancane, noma ashintje linani lemakhadi, etilungiselelweni teisevha bese acala kabusha. Umbono weTibalo welibhodi ukhombisa kutsi lisebentisa yiphi indlela.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Kubhala ticelo temakhasi ewebhu nete-REST API letitsetse sikhatsi lesidze kakhulu kuphendvula, ngako ungabona kutsi ngumaphi emakhasi noma tingcingo letehlako nekutsi kangakhi.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Sicelo ngasinye ngaphandle kwemafayela lamile siyabalelwa sikhatsi, futsi lesitsatsa imizuzwana lemibili noma ngetulu ngalokujwayelekile siyabhalwa. Sicelo lesifanako lesehlako sigcinwa njengemugca munye lonelinani nelusuku lolukhulako, kantsi Imininingwane ikhombisa indlela, indlela yekuya nekutsi kutsetse sikhatsi lesingakanani. Kusesha kuhlunga njengoba ubhala, futsi Tinkinga / Sifinyeto kuyakuvuma noma kukusule. Umkhawulo, noma kuwucima, kubekwa etilungiselelweni teisevha. Tikhatsi tetingcingo letiphilako temetindlela netekushicilela tingaphansi kwe-Instrumentation esikhundleni saloko.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Kutihlola kweisevha lesebentako lokwehlulekile. Masinyane emva kwekucala, i-WeKan ihlola kutsi i-database iyaphendvula, kutsi umkhombandlela wemafayela ungabhalwa, kutsi inkhumbulo isenendzawo lesele nekutsi idiski inendzawo lekhululekile.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Kuhlola kusebenta kanye, cishe imizuzwana lengu-15 emva kwekutsi isevha icale, futsi kwehluleka kuphela lokwenta umugca: Umtfombo ubiza kuhlola futsi Imininingwane inika umlayeto wayo weliphutsa. Kute tinkinga letinsha kusho kutsi kute lokwehlulekile kusukela umbiko ugcine kusulwa. Sigaba asinayo inkinobho yekuphindza kukusebentisa, ngako cala kabusha i-WeKan. Kuvume noma ukusule ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Ibuka umtfwalo weprosesa yemshini wonkhe, ngoba i-WeKan ne-database yayo ekhompyutheni yinye kungasebentisa i-CPU leyenele kwehlisa letinye tinhlelo. Tikhatsi te-CPU lephakeme lehlala isikhatsi lesidze tibhalwa lapha, futsi imisebenti lemidze iyehla ngesikhatsi umshini umatasatasa.
