help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Umugca wetulu ukhombisa kusetjentiswa kwe-CPU kwanyalo, linani lema-core, umtfwalo lophakatsi, lokuncane kwakamuva, lokuphakatsi nalokukhulu, nekutsi i-WeKan yentani, kuvuselelwa njalo emva kwemizuzwana lemihlanu. Lithebula ngaphansi libhala tikhatsi letengcile tekumatasatasa: umugca wekucala, kakhulu umugca munye mayelana nekwehlisa, nemugca wekuphela nesikhatsi, inhloko nekutsi kwehlisa kusitile yini. Kusesha kuhlunga njengoba ubhala. Imikhawulo, noma kucima umbuki, ikutilungiselelo teisevha.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Ibuka kutsi umshini wonkhe usebentisa inkhumbulo nekushintjanisa lokungakanani, futsi ibhala kutsi sikhatsi sekusebentisa inkhumbulo lenyenti sicala nini nekutsi siphela nini. Kuphelelwa yinkhumbulo, noma kushintjanisa, kwehlisa noma kuwisa i-WeKan naletinye tinhlelo kumshini lofanako.
help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Umugca wetulu ukhombisa kusetjentiswa kwenkhumbulo kwanyalo njengemaphesenti nanjengema-gigabyte lasetjentisiwe naphelele, kanye nekushintjanisa uma umshini unako, kuvuselelwa njalo emva kwemizuzwana lemihlanu. Ngaphansi kwawo, lithebula libamba umugca munye wekucala nemugca munye wekuphela kusikhatsi ngasinye senkhumbulo lenyenti, lokusha kucala, imigca lengu-10 elikhasini, nelibhokisi lekusesha. Kuvume noma ukusule ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto. Imikhawulo ikutilungiselelo teisevha futsi ifundvwa uma isevha icala.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Ibuka indzawo lekhululekile kumadiski labamba i-database, lokunamatsiselwe nalokulayishiwe. Idiski legcwele yenta kulayisha kwehluleke futsi imise i-database kutsi ibhale, ngako loku kunika secwayiso ngekushesha ngaphambi kwekutsi kwenteke.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Umugca munye lophilako ngediski ngayinye ukhombisa emaphesenti lasetjentisiwe, ema-gigabyte lakhululekile naphelele, indzawo yayo nalokugcinwa yi-WeKan lapho, kuvuselelwa njalo emva kwemizuzwana lengu-30, futsi idiski lesesikhatsini lesiphakeme iyagcamiseka. Lithebula ngaphansi linemugca wekucala nemugca wekuphela kusikhatsi ngasinye sekusetjentiswa lokuphakeme, futsi kusesha kuhlunga njengoba ubhala. Kuvume noma ukusule ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto. Lamanye emadiski lekufanele abukwe angengetwa etilungiselelweni teisevha.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Tibali letiphilako talokwentiwa yilesevha ye-WeKan: kutsi kuchumana lokungakhi lokuvulekile, nekutsi indlela ngayinye nekushicilela ngakunye kubitwa kangakhi, kwehluleka kangakhi nekutsi kutsatsa sikhatsi lesingakanani. Kukhombisa kutsi ngiyiphi incenye ye-WeKan lematasatasa noma lehlulekako nyalo ngaphandle kwelithulusi lekubuka lelihlukile.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Umugca wetulu ukhombisa kuchumana lokusebentako, lokuvuliwe nalokuvaliwe nekutsi kubala kwacala nini. Emabha ngendzawo ngayinye, njengeMakhadi, Emabhodi, Kungena noma Lokunamatsiselwe, akhombisa tingcingo, sikhatsi lesiphakatsi nemaphutsa; chofoza indzawo kute ukhombise imigca yayo kuphela, uphindze uchofoze kute ukhombise konkhe. Lithebula libhala tingcingo, letiphelile, emaphutsa, nesikhatsi lesiphakatsi nalesikhulu. Livuselelwa njalo emva kwemizuzwana lemihlanu, libala le-prosesa yeisevha kuphela, futsi liphindze licale ku-0 nakucalwa kabusha.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Kubhala emakhadi lokute libhodi lelingawakhombisa, ngoba libhodi, umtsandvo noma luhla lawo langelalo alikho. Kufaka onkhe emabhodi kusevha, nobe ulilunga noma cha.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Umugca ngamunye ukhombisa sihloko selikhadi, i-id yalo, tihloko telibhodi, temtsandvo neteluhla letisekhona, luhlobo lwalo nekutsi ladalwa nini; isela lelingenalutfo yincenye lengekho. Bhala incenye yesihloko bese ucindzetela Enter kute usesha, bese uhamba emakhasini ngetinkinobho Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako. Sigaba sibhala emakhadi kuphela: walungise ngeLungisa emakhadi laphukile ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto. Kuvula libhodi nako kulungisa emakhadi alo.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Kubhala lokunamatsiselwe lokugcinwe kulesevha, netinkinobho letihlola loko i-database lekushoko ngako konkhe lokunamatsiselwe nema-avatar kucatsaniswa naloko lokusendzaweni yekugcina ngempela. Kuhlola kutfola emafayela langekho, langakhulunywa ngawo noma lanelibito lelingakalungi kanye nemlandvo longakuchaza.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Lithebula likhombisa sibonakaliso, libito lelifayela, bukhulu, luhlobo nema-id alokunamatsiselwe, elibhodi nelikhadi, nelibhokisi lekusesha. Hlola emafayela nemlandvo, Hlola tinhlobo temafayela netandiso, noma Hlola emafayela langekho nalangakalandzelelwa kucala kuhlola; Khansela kuhlola kuyakumisa. Ngemuva, fundza emanani, kufinyelela nesibonelo setintfo letitfolakele, noma usebentise Layisha sifinyeto sesimo. Kuhlola akukaze kushintje, kuhambise noma kususe lifayela nome lirekhodi.
help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Kubhala yonkhe imitsetfo yekutentekela kusevha nelibhodi layo, ngako ungabona endzaweni yinye kutsi i-WeKan yentani ngekutentekela kuwo onkhe emabhodi, sibonelo uma ufuna umtsetfo lohambisa emakhadi ngendlela lengakalindzeleki.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Lithebula likhombisa sihloko semtsetfo, libhodi lawo, luhlobo lwesento sawo neluhlobo lwemsebenti wesicalisi sawo, imigca lengu-10 elikhasini, ihlelwe ngelibhodi. Bhala incenye yesihloko semtsetfo bese ucindzetela Enter kute usesha, bese usula libhokisi ucindzetele Enter kute uphindze ubone konkhe. Sigaba sifundvwa kuphela: kute ushintje umtsetfo, vula libhodi lawo bese uwuhlela emitsetfweni yalelo libhodi.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Lithebula lato tonkhe ema-webhook kusevha, ema-webhook elibhodi ngalinye nalawo emhlaba wonkhe: kutsi ngulinye ngelaliphi libhodi, ngubani lowaligeta nekutsi litfumela kuphi. Kuyasita ngaphambi kwekucima ema-webhook, emva kwesehlakalo, noma uma idatha iya lapho kute lokhumbula kutsi wakuhlela.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Umugca munye nge-webhook ngayinye, lokusha kucala, ukhombisa libhodi, umnikati, libito, likheli, luhlobo, kutsi livuliwe noma licinyiwe, kutsi litfumela miphi imisebenti, kutsi lithokheni libekiwe yini, nekutsi laligetwa nini. Hlunga Onkhe ema-webhook, Lavuliwe noma Lacinyiwe, bese usesha nge-Enter. Emathokheni nemaphasiwedi awakaze akhonjiswe. Chofoza sihloko selibhodi kute uvule libhodi bese ushintja i-webhook yalo lapho, kantsi ema-webhook emhlaba wonkhe akuPhaneli yemlawuli / Tilungiselelo / Ema-Webhook Emhlaba Wonkhe.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Kubhala onkhe emabhodi kusevha nekubonakala kwawo, emalunga, tinhlangano nemacembu. Kuphendvula kutsi ngumaphi emabhodi lakhona, ngubani longabona ngalinye nekutsi ngubani lokulo, ngaphandle kwekuvula onkhe emabhodi.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Umugca ngamunye ukhombisa sihloko, i-id, imvume, kutsi libhodi lisesigcinweni yini, emalunga lasebentako, kanye netinhlangano nemacembu lelabelwana nawo. Bhala incenye yesihloko bese ucindzetela Enter kute usesha, noma ukhetse Konkhe, Kwemphakatsi, Basebentisi labangenile noma Kwangasese ngaphansi kweMvume; kokubili kucala futsi elikhasini lekucala. Hamba emakhasini ngetinkinobho Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako. Kute lokungashintjwa lapha.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Kubhala onkhe emakhadi kusevha, nekutsi likuphi nekutsi ngubani lokulo, kuwo onkhe emabhodi nobe ulilunga noma cha. Kuphendvula kutsi likhadi likuphi nekutsi ngobani emalunga alo nalabanikwe umsebenti, ngaphandle kwekuvula emabhodi ngalinye ngalinye.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Umugca ngamunye ukhombisa sihloko selikhadi, libhodi lalo, umtsandvo neluhla, kanye nemabito ebasebentisi bemalunga alo nalabanikwe umsebenti. Bhala incenye yesihloko bese ucindzetela Enter kute usesha, lokucala futsi elikhasini lekucala, bese uhamba emakhasini ngetinkinobho Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako. Kute lokungashintjwa lapha.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Lapho ugcina khona i-database iphephile futsi ucedze umsebenti lowema esikhatsini. Kukhombisa umlandvo wekuhlola i-database, kulondvoloza nekubuyisela, futsi kukuvumela kutsi unqume kutsi kwentekani nge-imeyili lebambekile, tatiso, ema-imeyili emitsetfo, imisebenti yekuvumelanisa tinhla nekungeniswa kwemabhodi lokuphazamisekile.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Kusukela etulu ubona tinkinobho tekuhlola emafayela, bese tigaba letinjengemugca wekulindza kuletfwa kwe-imeyili, tatiso temisebenti letilindzile, ema-imeyili emitsetfo, imisebenti yekuvumelanisa tinhla nekungeniswa lokuphazamisekile, ngasinye netinkinobho letinjenga Misa kancane, Chubeka, Phindza, Lahla noma Gcina. Cinisekisa uma ucelwa, futsi uma umsebenti umatasatasa, cindzetela Vuselela bese uphindza ulinga. Lithebula ngaphansi libhala sonkhe sehlakalo sekubuyisela nesincumo; khombisa Konkhe, Kuphelile, Kwehlulekile noma Kususiwe bese usesha nge-Enter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Kubala kungena lokuphumelelako ngemuntfu nangelikheli, ngako ungabona kutsi i-akhawunti ngayinye ingena kusuka kuphi nekutsi ngumaphi emakheli labelwana ngawo ngema-akhawunti lamanyenti. Likheli labelwana ngalo lingaba lihhovisi, i-VPN noma kuchumana kwenethiwekhi lokutsintsetfwanako; alifakazeli kutsi ema-akhawunti angumuntfu munye.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Bantfu babhalwa ngamunye ngamunye, ngamunye nemugca ngelikheli ngalinye: i-IPv4, i-IPv6, kungena kwekucala nekwekugcina, linani lekungena, nendzawo uma i-proxy lengaphambi kwe-WeKan iyinika. Bhala libito lemsebentisi, libito lonkhe, likheli noma indzawo bese ucindzetela Enter kute usesha, bese uhamba emakhasini ngetinkinobho Lokwengcile naLokulandzelako. Kute lokuvinjwako ngenca yalombiko, ngako likheli labelwana ngalo alikaze livalele bantfu ngaphandle.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Kukhombisa kutsi ngumaphi emaphuzu ekugcina e-REST API lasetjentiswako, ngubani nekutsi kangakhi. Letinye tigaba tisho kutsi yini lengahambanga kahle; lesi sisho kutsi isevha icelwa kutsi yentani. Kusevha lapho i-REST API ingakavulwa, sihlala singenalutfo.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Umugca ngamunye yi-akhawunti neliphuzu lekugcina, lelimatasatasa kakhulu kucala: linani letingcingo, kutsi labitwa nini kwekucala nekwekugcina, nemakheli lamasha e-IPv4 ne-IPv6 nendzawo yawo. Libito lemsebentisi lelingenalutfo lisho tingcingo letivela kumuntfu longenayo i-akhawunti, lotfolakala ngemakheli. Bhala liphuzu lekugcina, indlela, libito lemsebentisi noma likheli kute uhlunge njengoba ubhala, bese uhamba emigceni lengu-10 ngesikhatsi.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Kuchaza kutsi i-database itsini. Liphutsa lelivela ku-MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB noma i-SAP HANA ngalokujwayelekile libhalelwa batfutfukisi bayo, ngako lesi sigaba sibiza i-database, sihlele inkinga ngeluhlobo lolunjengediski, kungena, kwakheka kwembhalo noma kuphelelwa sikhatsi, bese sengeta inchazelo lecacile nesinyatselo lesilandzelako.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Imigca ibhalwa lemisha kucala. Imininingwane isho kutsi inkinga isho kutsini nekutsi kufanele kwentiwe yini, kulandzelwe ngumlayeto we-database ngekwayo, kantsi lamanye emakholamu akhombisa i-database, luhlobo, kubi kwayo, umsebenti, ngubani nekutsi kusuka kuphi uma kwatiwa, nekutsi kangakhi. Kusesha kuhlunga njengoba ubhala, kufaka ekhatsi emagama e-database ngekwayo. Uma sekunakekelwe, kuvume noma ukusule ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Kukhombisa kutsi lesevha yema kahle yini, kutsi yini leyayiwisa, nekutsi kulondvoloza lokuchubekako kwehlulekile yini, kanye netinkinobho tekuhlola emafayela letifanako nalaseMbikweni weMafayela. Buka lapha emva kwekucinywa lokungakalindzeleki.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Umugca ubhalwa ngekucala kabusha ngaphandle kwekuma kahle, njengekucala kabusha lokusheshako uma isevha ibuye kungakapheli imizuzu lemitsatfu noma njengekuwa uma bekungasebenti sikhatsi lesidze, ngeliphutsa lelingakabanjwa nemlayeto walo, futsi uma kulondvoloza lokuchubekako kwehluleka. Imigca ilemisha kucala, lengu-10 elikhasini, futsi kusesha kuhlunga njengoba ubhala. Tinkinobho tekuhlola emafayela etulu atishintji lifayela nome lirekhodi. Kuvume noma ukusule ku-Tinkinga / Sifinyeto.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Iphaneli yeLifu likhasi lemsebentisi wekusingatsa lekuphatsa ema-domain e-WeKan emakhasimende lamanyenti endzaweni yinye: tinsuku tawo, ema-database, ema-invoyisi, emathikithi ekusekela nengcoco, emarekhodi e-DNS netindlela teisevha yewebhu. Ikhona kuphela uma tilungiselelo teisevha tiyivula kusizinda sayo, futsi balawuli beiwebhusayithi lapho kuphela, Balawuli beLifu, labayibonako.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Ngeta ema-domain emakhasimende netinsuku tawo nekutsi ngalinye line-WeKan yalo ne-database noma labelana ngalena, hlola kuchumana kwe-database, bese ubhala ema-invoyisi. Sizinda ngasinye sitfola libhodi lekusekela lemathikithi nengcoco. Hlola futsi ubuyekete emarekhodi e-DNS, layisha tindlela teisevha yewebhu, bese ubhala emakheli lavunyelwe kute ubeke umkhawulo wekutsi Balawuli beLifu bangangena kuphi. Emakhasimende ayangena kute abone sizinda sawo.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Onkhe emabhodi likhasi lelibhala emabhodi akho. Imenyu yesancele ikhetsa kutsi ngumaphi emabhodi lakhonjiswako, njengaLanenkhanyeti, Lasele, Ekhaya, Emathempuleti, Ingobolwane, indzawo yekusebentela noma inhlangano noma licembu, futsi libha lenhloko linekuhlela, kusesha, kutfumela naKukhetsa Lokunyenti.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Chofoza sigaba kuyimenyu yesancele bese uchofoza libhodi kute ulivule. Sebentisa Hlela Emabhodi kute uhlele ngekudvonsa ngendlela yakho noma ngesihloko, nemenyu yembono kute ushintje emkhatsini wetimphawu temabhodi nelithebula. Vula Kukhetsa Lokunyenti bese uphawula emabhodi kute uwayise esigcinweni, uwaphindze, uwatfumele noma ubeke linye njengelibhodi lakho laseKhaya, noma udvonse libhodi uliyise kuNgobolwane.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Umtfwalo wemsebenti nemandla kukhombisa, liviki ngeliviki, kutsi umuntfu ngamunye unemsebenti lomungakanani uma kucatsaniswa nemahora lanawo, kuwo onkhe emabhodi losebenta kuwo. Kukhombisa kutsi ngubani lowetfweswe kakhulu, ngubani longatsatsa lokunyenti, nekutsi umklamo lotako udzingani ngaphambi kwekutsi kubitwe nome ngubani.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Khetsa liviki lekucala, mangakhi emaviki nekutsi ukhombise emahora noma emaphuzu endzaba, bese uchofoza liviki kute ubone emakhadi alo. Emaviki lanemsebenti lomnyenti kunemahora abovu. Beka sikhatsi sakho sekusebenta, emakhono nekungabikho, balawuli belibhodi bangeta kwabiwa netindzawo tetindzima, kantsi balawuli bangeta emaholide emphakatsi.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Sabelomali nekukhokhisa kulapho balawuli belibhodi bahlela khona futsi bakhokhise umsebenti welibhodi: sabelomali salo, kutsi umsebenti ubite malini futsi utawubita malini, emanani emahora, timali letisetjentisiwe, timali letimisiwe, tilinganiso netinvoyisi, ngekuya ngesikhatsi lesilandzelelwe emakhadini.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Khetsa imali nemanani emahora ngelilunga ngalinye nelinani lelibhodi lelijwayelekile, beka sabelomali, bese ungeta timali letisetjentisiwe netimali. Sikhatsi lesibhalwe emakhadini sibe sesikhonjiswa njengalesisetjentisiwe nalesibikezelwako uma kucatsaniswa nesabelomali. Uma ufuna, vuma sikhatsi ngaphambi kwekukhokhisa. Gcwalisa imininingwane yakho yemkhokhisi kanye, bese udala ema-invoyisi esikhatsi, uwalayishe, uwaphawule njengalatfunyelwe futsi ubhale tinkhokhelo, noma udale silinganiso semsebenti losele kwentiwa.
gitea-not-configured: Kute lifolda le-Gitea lelisetiwe. Seta GITEA_APP_INI ekhasini leTilungiselelo.
gitea-not-sqlite: Omi ifundza kuphela i-Gitea lesebentisa SQLite. Le-Gitea isebentisa:
gitea-read-only: Lamakhasi afundza kuphela lifolda le-Gitea; kute lokulapha lokulishintjako.
gitea-dry-run: Kute lokushintjiwe kwanyalo; loku kungiko kusula bekungakwenta.
gitea-delete-confirm: Loku kusula unomphela umsebentisi noma inhlangano, emarepository ayo nayo yonkhe idatha yawo elifoldeni le-Gitea. Bhala libito kute uchubeke:
gitea-delete-wrong-name: Libito lelibhaliwe akusilo libito lemnikati. Kute lokusuliwe.
gitea-running: I-Gitea iyasebenta. Yimise kucala: Omi ibhala kuphela ku-Gitea lemisiwe.
gitea-backup-first: Kucala yenta likhophi: likhophi le-github-to-gitea lalomnikati, kusuka ku-GitHub kuya ku-BACKUPS_DIR. Kusula kuchubeka kuphela nangabe likhophi liphumelela.
gitea-import-help: Ingenisa inhlangano noma umsebentisi we-GitHub, noma lamanye emarepository ayo, ngco elifoldeni le-Gitea: git, tindzaba, ticelo tekudvonsa, imibono, emalebula, emagama ekuchubeka, kukhishwa netinamatselo. I-Gitea kufanele imiswe. Yisebentise futsi kute ulete kuphela lokusha noma lokushintjile.
gitea-github-token: Ithokheni ye-GitHub, igcinwa efayeleni futsi ayikaze ikhonjiswe
gitea-bad-name: Leli akusilo libito lelivumelekile lemnikati noma le-repository.
gitea-doer: Umsebentisi we-Gitea lokungenisa kwentiwa egameni lakhe
gitea-delete-repo-confirm: Loku kusula unomphela i-repository, i-wiki yayo nayo yonkhe idatha yayo elifoldeni le-Gitea. Bhala mnikati/libito kute uchubeke:
gitea-delete-repo-wrong-name: Libito lelibhaliwe akusilo mnikati/libito le-repository. Kute lokusuliwe.
gitea-exclude-too: Yikhiphe nasekuvumelaniseni, kute kuvumelanisa lokulandzelako kungayibuyisi
gitea-packages-unlinked: Emaphakheji laboshelwe kuyo ahlala nemnikati, angakaboshelwa:
gitea-index-stale: Akusesikhatsini kusukela kusulwa: linganisa futsi kute utfole bukhulu lobuncono.
